block:minecraft:blue_terracotta.what: Blue Terracotta is a colored hardened-clay building block.
block:minecraft:blue_terracotta.does: Use it for construction and decorative color palettes, or smelt compatible colored terracotta into its glazed form.

block:minecraft:blue_wool.what: Blue Wool is a soft fabric building block.

block:minecraft:blue_wool_stairs.what: Blue Wool Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.

block:minecraft:bone_block.what: A bone block is compact storage made from bone meal.

block:minecraft:border_block.what: A border block is a special Education or mapmaking boundary block.

block:minecraft:brick_block.what: A brick block is a fired-clay building material.

block:minecraft:brick_double_slab.what: Brick Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.

block:minecraft:brick_stairs.what: Brick Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.

block:minecraft:brick_wall.what: Brick Wall is a connecting wall block.

block:minecraft:brown_candle.what: Brown Candle is a small decorative light source.

block:minecraft:brown_concrete.does: Use it for vivid walls, floors, sculptures, and other decorative builds.

block:minecraft:brown_concrete_double_sl.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:brown_concrete_powder.what: Brown Concrete Powder is a gravity-affected building material.

block:minecraft:bush.what: Bush is decorative ground or hanging vegetation.
block:minecraft:bush.does: Use it for natural landscaping on suitable surfaces. Harvesting and planting requirements depend on the plant.

block:minecraft:cactus.what: A cactus is a prickly desert plant.
block:minecraft:cactus.does: Use it in decoration and farming, or smelt it for green dye. Touching it causes damage and it destroys many dropped items that contact it.

block:minecraft:cactus_flower.what: A cactus flower is a decorative flower associated with cactus growth.
block:minecraft:cactus_flower.does: Use it for desert gardens and compatible crafting or dye recipes.

block:minecraft:cake.what: A cake is a placeable food block eaten in slices.
block:minecraft:cake.does: Place it on a suitable surface and interact to eat portions; it is not eaten directly from your hand.

block:minecraft:calcite.what: Calcite is a pale decorative mineral block associated with amethyst geodes.
block:minecraft:calcite.does: Use it for white stone construction and decorative contrasts.

block:minecraft:calibrated_sculk_sensor.what: A calibrated sculk sensor is a sculk sensor whose detection can be filtered using redstone.
block:minecraft:calibrated_sculk_sensor.does: Supply a signal to its calibration side to select which vibration frequencies it responds to.

block:minecraft:camera.what: A camera is a special photography tool from compatible Minecraft Education features.
block:minecraft:camera.does: Use it in a supported Education world to capture images; it is not an ordinary Survival crafting station.

block:minecraft:campfire.what: A campfire is a fire block used for cooking, light, and smoke.
block:minecraft:campfire.does: Place food on it to cook without adding furnace fuel. Its smoke and heat have other uses, including calming bees when correctly positioned.

block:minecraft:candle.what: Candle is a small decorative light source.
block:minecraft:candle.does: Place candles on a suitable surface and light them with a fire-starting tool. Compatible candles can share a block space.

block:minecraft:candle_cake.what: Candle Cake is a cake with a candle placed on it.

block:minecraft:cartography_table.does: Use it to expand, copy, or lock maps with suitable materials. It is also a cartographer villager's job-site block.

block:minecraft:carved_pumpkin.what: A carved pumpkin is a pumpkin with a carved face.
block:minecraft:carved_pumpkin.does: Wear it as headgear, use it in golem construction, or combine it with a torch for a jack o'lantern.

block:minecraft:cauldron.what: A cauldron is a container block for liquids.
block:minecraft:cauldron.does: In Bedrock it can hold water, lava, potions, or dyed water, depending on what you put into it. Its contents can be useful for filling bottles, dyeing leather equipment, or collecting liquids.

block:minecraft:cave_vines.what: Cave Vines is a hanging cave-vine growth.

block:minecraft:cave_vines_body_with_ber.what: Cave Vines Body With Berries is a hanging cave-vine growth.
block:minecraft:cave_vines_body_with_ber.does: Grow it under suitable blocks and harvest glow berries from berry-bearing sections.

block:minecraft:cave_vines_head_with_ber.what: Cave Vines Head With Berries is a hanging cave-vine growth.

block:minecraft:chain_command_block.what: A chain command block can run commands as part of a command-block chain.

block:minecraft:chemical_heat.what: Chemical heat is an Education chemistry-related heat effect.
block:minecraft:chemical_heat.does: It belongs to special chemistry interactions rather than ordinary Survival construction.

block:minecraft:cherry_button.what: Cherry Button is a temporary redstone switch.
block:minecraft:cherry_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

block:minecraft:cherry_door.what: Cherry Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
block:minecraft:cherry_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

block:minecraft:cherry_double_slab.what: Cherry Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:cherry_double_slab.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:cherry_fence.what: Cherry Fence is a connecting fence block.
block:minecraft:cherry_fence.does: Use it to enclose animals or mark boundaries. Many mobs cannot jump over an ordinary fence, and leads can be tied to suitable fence posts.

block:minecraft:cherry_fence_gate.what: Cherry Fence Gate is an openable gate that connects to fences.
block:minecraft:cherry_fence_gate.does: Use it to enter an enclosure while keeping a fence-style barrier when closed. It can be controlled by hand or redstone.

block:minecraft:cherry_hanging_sign.what: Cherry Hanging Sign is a suspended sign for displaying written text.
block:minecraft:cherry_hanging_sign.does: Hang it from a suitable support and write a message. Dye changes the text color and glow ink can make the writing brighter.

block:minecraft:cherry_leaves.what: Cherry Leaves is foliage used by a tree or large plant.
block:minecraft:cherry_leaves.does: Use it for landscaping and hedges. Harvesting the intact block normally needs shears or Silk Touch; some leaves can drop plant materials when they decay.

block:minecraft:deepslate.what: Deepslate is a dark rock found deep underground.
block:minecraft:deepslate.does: Use it for dark stone construction. Mining ordinary deepslate without Silk Touch normally produces cobbled deepslate.

block:minecraft:deepslate_brick_double_s.what: Deepslate Brick Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:deepslate_brick_double_s.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:deepslate_brick_slab.what: Deepslate Brick Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:deepslate_brick_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:deepslate_brick_stairs.what: Deepslate Brick Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:deepslate_brick_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:deepslate_brick_wall.what: Deepslate Brick Wall is a connecting wall block.
block:minecraft:deepslate_brick_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

block:minecraft:deepslate_bricks.what: Deepslate Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
block:minecraft:deepslate_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

block:minecraft:deepslate_coal_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

block:minecraft:diamond_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

block:minecraft:dirt_with_roots.what: Rooted dirt is soil tangled with roots.

block:minecraft:dragon_head.what: Dragon Head is a mob-head decoration.
block:minecraft:dragon_head.does: Display it, wear compatible heads, or use it in a matching recipe or mechanism. Wither skeleton skulls are also used in summoning the Wither.

block:minecraft:dried_ghast.what: A dried ghast is a block that can develop into a ghastling when hydrated.
block:minecraft:dried_ghast.does: Place it in suitable water and give it time; the resulting ghastling can grow into a happy ghast.

block:minecraft:dried_kelp_block.what: A dried kelp block is compacted dried kelp and a furnace fuel.

block:minecraft:dripstone_block.what: A dripstone block is a cave building block associated with pointed dripstone.

block:minecraft:dropper.what: A dropper is a redstone-operated block that moves items out of its inventory.
block:minecraft:dropper.does: A pulse pushes an item into a facing container, or drops it into the world when no suitable container is there.

block:minecraft:element_constructor.does: Use it in compatible Education worlds to create elements by setting proton, neutron, and electron counts.

block:minecraft:emerald_block.what: Emerald Block is a compact mineral or metal storage block.
block:minecraft:emerald_block.does: Use it for construction or convert compatible storage blocks back into crafting materials. Some mineral blocks also work in beacon bases.

block:minecraft:emerald_ore.what: Emerald Ore is a rock containing emerald.
block:minecraft:emerald_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

block:minecraft:enchanting_table.what: An enchanting table adds enchantments to compatible equipment.
block:minecraft:enchanting_table.does: Use lapis lazuli and experience levels. Properly placed bookshelves improve the available enchantment levels.

block:minecraft:end_brick_stairs.what: End Brick Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:end_brick_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:end_bricks.what: End Bricks is a decorative stone building material.
block:minecraft:end_bricks.does: Use it for contrasting walls, floors, columns, and other architectural details.

block:minecraft:end_portal.what: An End portal is a gateway to or from the End.
block:minecraft:end_portal.does: Enter it to travel according to the portal's location and progression state; it is not a normal placeable Survival building block.

block:minecraft:end_portal_frame.what: An End portal frame is a special block surrounding an End portal.
block:minecraft:end_portal_frame.does: Find the correct frame arrangement and add the required eyes of ender to activate it. Ordinary Survival players cannot harvest the frame block.

block:minecraft:end_rod.what: An End rod is a slim decorative light source.
block:minecraft:end_rod.does: Attach it to suitable surfaces to illuminate builds and make thin supports or details.

block:minecraft:end_stone.what: End stone is the pale rock that forms much of the End.
block:minecraft:end_stone.does: Use it for construction and to craft End stone bricks.

block:minecraft:end_stone_brick_double_s.what: End Stone Brick Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:end_stone_brick_double_s.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:end_stone_brick_slab.what: End Stone Brick Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:end_stone_brick_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:end_stone_brick_wall.what: End Stone Brick Wall is a connecting wall block.
block:minecraft:end_stone_brick_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

block:minecraft:ender_chest.what: An ender chest accesses storage that belongs to each player, rather than to that particular chest.
block:minecraft:ender_chest.does: Your items are accessible from other ender chests, including across dimensions. Another player opening the same chest sees their own items.

block:minecraft:exposed_chiseled_copper.what: Exposed Chiseled Copper is a copper building block.
block:minecraft:exposed_chiseled_copper.does: Use it for construction and decoration. Unwaxed copper can oxidize to a different color; honeycomb prevents further oxidation.

block:minecraft:exposed_copper.what: Exposed Copper is a copper building block.
block:minecraft:exposed_copper.does: Use it for construction and decoration. Unwaxed copper can oxidize to a different color; honeycomb prevents further oxidation.

block:minecraft:exposed_copper_bars.what: Exposed Copper Bars is a thin copper building decoration.
block:minecraft:exposed_copper_bars.does: Use it for grilles, hanging details, and copper-themed construction; copper oxidation changes compatible unwaxed forms.

block:minecraft:exposed_copper_bulb.what: Exposed Copper Bulb is a copper light block switched by redstone pulses.
block:minecraft:exposed_copper_bulb.does: A pulse changes its on/off state, and its oxidation affects its brightness. Waxing stops further oxidation.

block:minecraft:exposed_copper_chain.what: Exposed Copper Chain is a thin copper building decoration.
block:minecraft:exposed_copper_chain.does: Use it for grilles, hanging details, and copper-themed construction; copper oxidation changes compatible unwaxed forms.

block:minecraft:exposed_copper_chest.what: Exposed Copper Chest is a copper storage container.
block:minecraft:exposed_copper_chest.does: Store items in it or use it as part of a suitable copper-golem item-sorting arrangement.

block:minecraft:exposed_copper_door.what: Exposed Copper Door is an openable copper doorway or hatch.
block:minecraft:exposed_copper_door.does: Use it by hand or with redstone. Its appearance changes with oxidation unless it is waxed.

block:minecraft:exposed_copper_golem_sta.what: Exposed Copper Golem Statue is a copper golem statue decoration.
block:minecraft:exposed_copper_golem_sta.does: Use it for decoration; its copper condition controls compatible oxidation and waxing interactions.

block:minecraft:exposed_copper_grate.what: Exposed Copper Grate is a copper mesh building block.
block:minecraft:exposed_copper_grate.does: Use it for grilles and decorative structures. Copper oxidation changes its appearance unless it is waxed.

block:minecraft:exposed_copper_lantern.what: Exposed Copper Lantern is a copper-colored light source.
block:minecraft:exposed_copper_lantern.does: Use it for lighting and decorative copper-themed builds.

block:minecraft:exposed_copper_trapdoor.what: Exposed Copper Trapdoor is an openable copper doorway or hatch.
block:minecraft:exposed_copper_trapdoor.does: Use it by hand or with redstone. Its appearance changes with oxidation unless it is waxed.

block:minecraft:exposed_cut_copper.what: Exposed Cut Copper is a copper building block.
block:minecraft:exposed_cut_copper.does: Use it for construction and decoration. Unwaxed copper can oxidize to a different color; honeycomb prevents further oxidation.

block:minecraft:exposed_cut_copper_slab.what: Exposed Cut Copper Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:exposed_cut_copper_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:exposed_cut_copper_stair.what: Exposed Cut Copper Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:exposed_cut_copper_stair.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:exposed_double_cut_coppe.what: Exposed Double Cut Copper Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:exposed_double_cut_coppe.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:exposed_lightning_rod.what: Exposed Lightning Rod is a copper lightning rod.
block:minecraft:exposed_lightning_rod.does: Use it to attract nearby lightning strikes toward a chosen location and obtain a short redstone signal when struck.

block:minecraft:farmland.what: Farmland is soil prepared with a hoe for growing crops.
block:minecraft:farmland.does: Plant suitable seeds or crops on it and keep water nearby to hydrate it. Trampling can turn it back into dirt.

block:minecraft:fence_gate.what: An oak fence gate is an openable entrance for a fence enclosure.
block:minecraft:fence_gate.does: Open it by hand or redstone while keeping a fence-style barrier when closed.

block:minecraft:fern.what: Fern is decorative ground or hanging vegetation.
block:minecraft:fern.does: Use it for natural landscaping on suitable surfaces. Harvesting and planting requirements depend on the plant.

block:minecraft:fire.what: Fire is a damaging flame that can spread to flammable materials.
block:minecraft:fire.does: Use it cautiously for controlled burning; extinguish unwanted flames before they spread through wooden builds.

block:minecraft:fire_coral.what: Fire Coral is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
block:minecraft:fire_coral.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

block:minecraft:fire_coral_block.what: Fire Coral Block is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
block:minecraft:fire_coral_block.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

block:minecraft:fire_coral_fan.what: Fire Coral Fan is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
block:minecraft:fire_coral_fan.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

block:minecraft:fire_coral_wall_fan.what: Fire Coral Wall Fan is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
block:minecraft:fire_coral_wall_fan.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

block:minecraft:firefly_bush.what: A firefly bush is a decorative bush associated with firefly-like ambient particles.
block:minecraft:firefly_bush.does: Use it to add natural atmosphere to a garden or waterside build.

block:minecraft:fletching_table.what: A fletching table is a job-site block for fletcher villagers.
block:minecraft:fletching_table.does: Place it for an eligible unemployed villager to become a fletcher. It does not provide a normal player crafting interface.

block:minecraft:flower_pot.what: A flower pot holds a small plant for decoration.
block:minecraft:flower_pot.does: Place a compatible flower, sapling, fungus, or other small plant in it.

block:minecraft:flowering_azalea.what: Flowering Azalea is a small azalea plant.
block:minecraft:flowering_azalea.does: Use it for garden decoration or grow it with bone meal under suitable conditions to form an azalea tree.

block:minecraft:flowing_lava.what: Flowing lava is lava spreading outward from a source.
block:minecraft:flowing_lava.does: It burns and damages many entities. A flowing section is not necessarily a collectible source block.

block:minecraft:flowing_water.what: Flowing water is water spreading from a source.
block:minecraft:flowing_water.does: Use its current to move items and mobs; a flowing section is not necessarily a collectible source block.

block:minecraft:frame.what: An item frame is a display for an item or map.
block:minecraft:frame.does: Attach it to a suitable surface and place an item inside, then rotate the displayed item as needed.

block:minecraft:frog_spawn.what: Frogspawn is a floating cluster of frog eggs.
block:minecraft:frog_spawn.does: It develops into tadpoles in suitable water after frogs breed.

block:minecraft:frosted_ice.what: Frosted ice is temporary ice created by the Frost Walker enchantment.
block:minecraft:frosted_ice.does: Walk across suitable water while wearing the enchantment to create it; it eventually breaks or melts away rather than becoming permanent packed ice.

block:minecraft:furnace.what: A furnace is a workstation that smelts or cooks items using fuel.
block:minecraft:furnace.does: Put a suitable item in its input and fuel in its fuel slot to make products such as iron ingots, glass, or cooked food.

block:minecraft:gilded_blackstone.what: Gilded blackstone is a dark Nether block with gold-colored inclusions.
block:minecraft:gilded_blackstone.does: Use it in decoration; mining it can yield gold nuggets under suitable drop conditions.

block:minecraft:glass.what: Glass is a transparent building block made by smelting sand.
block:minecraft:glass.does: Use it for windows and enclosures. Harvesting the intact block normally requires Silk Touch.

block:minecraft:glass_pane.what: A glass pane is a thin transparent building block.
block:minecraft:glass_pane.does: Use connected panes for windows and dividers that take up less space than full glass blocks.

block:minecraft:glow_frame.what: A glow item frame is an item frame whose displayed contents appear bright.
block:minecraft:glow_frame.does: Use it to display items or maps clearly in dark rooms. It does not light nearby blocks like a lamp.

block:minecraft:glow_lichen.what: Glow lichen is a thin plant-like growth that emits light.
block:minecraft:glow_lichen.does: Place it on suitable surfaces for subtle natural lighting and spread it with bone meal.

block:minecraft:glowstone.what: Glowstone is a bright block associated with the Nether.
block:minecraft:glowstone.does: Use it for lighting or break it to obtain glowstone dust.

block:minecraft:gold_block.what: Gold Block is a compact mineral or metal storage block.
block:minecraft:gold_block.does: Use it for construction or convert compatible storage blocks back into crafting materials. Some mineral blocks also work in beacon bases.

block:minecraft:gold_ore.what: Gold Ore is a rock containing gold.
block:minecraft:gold_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

block:minecraft:golden_dandelion.what: A golden dandelion is a special flower used in baby-animal growth interactions.
block:minecraft:golden_dandelion.does: Use it on supported baby animals to control their growth; support depends on the animal.

block:minecraft:golden_rail.what: A powered rail is a track that accelerates or brakes minecarts.
block:minecraft:golden_rail.does: Power it with redstone to propel carts; unpowered sections slow them down.

block:minecraft:granite.what: Granite is a decorative stone building material.
block:minecraft:granite.does: Use it for contrasting walls, floors, columns, and other architectural details.

block:minecraft:granite_double_slab.what: Granite Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:granite_double_slab.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:granite_slab.what: Granite Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:granite_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:granite_stairs.what: Granite Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:granite_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:granite_wall.what: Granite Wall is a connecting wall block.
block:minecraft:granite_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

block:minecraft:grass_block.what: A grass block is dirt with a grassy surface.
block:minecraft:grass_block.does: It supports many Overworld plants and can spread grass to suitable nearby dirt under the right conditions.

block:minecraft:grass_path.what: A dirt path is a lowered soil block used for walkways.
block:minecraft:grass_path.does: Use a shovel on suitable soil to make paths through gardens and villages.

block:minecraft:gravel.what: Gravel is a loose block that falls when unsupported.
block:minecraft:gravel.does: Use it in construction and concrete powder recipes. Breaking it can produce flint.

block:minecraft:gray_candle.what: Gray Candle is a small decorative light source.
block:minecraft:gray_candle.does: Place candles on a suitable surface and light them with a fire-starting tool. Compatible candles can share a block space.

block:minecraft:gray_candle_cake.what: Gray Candle Cake is a cake with a candle placed on it.
block:minecraft:gray_candle_cake.does: Light the candle for decoration or eat cake slices; eating the cake removes its candle arrangement.

block:minecraft:gray_carpet.what: Gray Carpet is a thin floor covering.
block:minecraft:gray_carpet.does: Use it for decorating floors and some spawn-proofing setups. A carpet is not the same as a full wool block.

block:minecraft:gray_concrete.what: Gray Concrete is a solid colored building block.
block:minecraft:gray_concrete.does: Use it for vivid walls, floors, sculptures, and other decorative builds.

block:minecraft:gray_concrete_double_sla.what: Gray Concrete Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:gray_concrete_double_sla.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:gray_concrete_powder.what: Gray Concrete Powder is a gravity-affected building material.
block:minecraft:gray_concrete_powder.does: Place it in contact with suitable water to turn it into solid concrete, or use it as colored falling material.

block:minecraft:gray_concrete_slab.what: Gray Concrete Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:gray_concrete_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:gray_concrete_stairs.what: Gray Concrete Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:gray_concrete_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:gray_glazed_terracotta.what: Gray Glazed Terracotta is a patterned ceramic building block.
block:minecraft:gray_glazed_terracotta.does: Use its directional placement to create repeating floor and wall designs.

block:minecraft:gray_shulker_box.what: Gray Shulker Box is a portable storage container.
block:minecraft:gray_shulker_box.does: Store items inside, break the box, and carry it with its contents preserved. You cannot put a shulker box inside another shulker box.

block:minecraft:gray_stained_glass.what: Gray Stained Glass is a colored transparent building block.
block:minecraft:gray_stained_glass.does: Use it for tinted windows, decorative enclosures, or to color a beacon beam passing through it.

block:minecraft:gray_stained_glass_pane.what: Gray Stained Glass Pane is a thin colored glass block.
block:minecraft:gray_stained_glass_pane.does: Use connected panes for tinted windows and dividers. It is not a full glass block.

block:minecraft:gray_terracotta.what: Gray Terracotta is a colored hardened-clay building block.
block:minecraft:gray_terracotta.does: Use it for construction and decorative color palettes, or smelt compatible colored terracotta into its glazed form.

block:minecraft:gray_wool.what: Gray Wool is a soft fabric building block.
block:minecraft:gray_wool.does: Use it for decoration, beds, and compatible crafting recipes. Wool also helps block certain sculk vibration paths.

block:minecraft:gray_wool_double_slab.what: Gray Wool Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:gray_wool_double_slab.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:gray_wool_slab.what: Gray Wool Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:gray_wool_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:gray_wool_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:green_glazed_terracotta.does: Use its directional placement to create repeating floor and wall designs.

block:minecraft:green_shulker_box.what: Green Shulker Box is a portable storage container.
block:minecraft:green_shulker_box.does: Store items inside, break the box, and carry it with its contents preserved. You cannot put a shulker box inside another shulker box.

block:minecraft:green_stained_glass.what: Green Stained Glass is a colored transparent building block.
block:minecraft:green_stained_glass.does: Use it for tinted windows, decorative enclosures, or to color a beacon beam passing through it.

block:minecraft:green_stained_glass_pane.what: Green Stained Glass Pane is a thin colored glass block.
block:minecraft:green_stained_glass_pane.does: Use connected panes for tinted windows and dividers. It is not a full glass block.

block:minecraft:green_terracotta.what: Green Terracotta is a colored hardened-clay building block.
block:minecraft:green_terracotta.does: Use it for construction and decorative color palettes, or smelt compatible colored terracotta into its glazed form.

block:minecraft:green_wool.what: Green Wool is a soft fabric building block.

block:minecraft:green_wool_double_slab.what: Green Wool Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:green_wool_double_slab.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:green_wool_slab.what: Green Wool Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:green_wool_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:green_wool_stairs.what: Green Wool Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:green_wool_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:grindstone.what: A grindstone repairs equipment and removes most enchantments.
block:minecraft:grindstone.does: Use it to combine compatible equipment or recover some experience from unwanted enchantments. It does not remove curses and is a weaponsmith villager's job-site block.

block:minecraft:hanging_roots.what: Hanging Roots is decorative ground or hanging vegetation.
block:minecraft:hanging_roots.does: Use it for natural landscaping on suitable surfaces. Harvesting and planting requirements depend on the plant.

block:minecraft:hardened_clay.what: Terracotta is hardened clay used as a building material.
block:minecraft:hardened_clay.does: Use it in construction or dye it to create colored terracotta.

block:minecraft:hay_block.what: A hay bale is a block of compacted wheat.
block:minecraft:hay_block.does: Use it for storage, decoration, certain animal interactions, or to reduce fall damage when landing on it.

block:minecraft:heavy_core.what: A heavy core is a rare component used to make a mace.
block:minecraft:heavy_core.does: Combine it with a breeze rod in the appropriate recipe.

block:minecraft:heavy_weighted_pressure_.what: A heavy weighted pressure plate is an iron plate that measures how many entities are on it.
block:minecraft:heavy_weighted_pressure_.does: It produces a redstone signal whose strength increases with larger groups of entities. Its weighting differs from the light weighted plate.

block:minecraft:honey_block.what: A honey block is a sticky block that slows movement and can be pushed by pistons.
block:minecraft:honey_block.does: Use it in moving machines and sliding mechanisms; it does not stick to slime blocks.

block:minecraft:honeycomb_block.what: A honeycomb block is a decorative block made from honeycomb.
block:minecraft:honeycomb_block.does: Use it for golden-orange textures in builds. It does not produce honey like a hive.

block:minecraft:hopper.what: A hopper is a block that collects and moves items automatically.
block:minecraft:hopper.does: It picks up dropped items above it, pulls items from a container above it, and transfers items into the container its spout points toward. Power it with redstone to lock its transfers. It is useful for automatic storage, furnaces, and collection systems.

block:minecraft:horn_coral.what: Horn Coral is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
block:minecraft:horn_coral.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

block:minecraft:horn_coral_block.what: Horn Coral Block is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
block:minecraft:horn_coral_block.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

block:minecraft:horn_coral_fan.what: Horn Coral Fan is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
block:minecraft:horn_coral_fan.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

block:minecraft:horn_coral_wall_fan.what: Horn Coral Wall Fan is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
block:minecraft:horn_coral_wall_fan.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

block:minecraft:ice.what: Ice is a slippery frozen-water block.
block:minecraft:ice.does: Use it for transport and cold-themed builds. Ordinary ice can melt under suitable conditions.

block:minecraft:infested_chiseled_stone_.what: Infested Chiseled Stone Bricks is a block containing silverfish.
block:minecraft:infested_chiseled_stone_.does: Disturbing it can release hostile silverfish, so take care when mining suspicious stone in affected areas.

block:minecraft:infested_cobblestone.what: Infested Cobblestone is a block containing silverfish.
block:minecraft:infested_cobblestone.does: Disturbing it can release hostile silverfish, so take care when mining suspicious stone in affected areas.

block:minecraft:infested_cracked_stone_b.what: Infested Cracked Stone Bricks is a block containing silverfish.
block:minecraft:infested_cracked_stone_b.does: Disturbing it can release hostile silverfish, so take care when mining suspicious stone in affected areas.

block:minecraft:infested_deepslate.what: Infested Deepslate is a block containing silverfish.
block:minecraft:infested_deepslate.does: Disturbing it can release hostile silverfish, so take care when mining suspicious stone in affected areas.

block:minecraft:infested_mossy_stone_bri.what: Infested Mossy Stone Bricks is a block containing silverfish.
block:minecraft:infested_mossy_stone_bri.does: Disturbing it can release hostile silverfish, so take care when mining suspicious stone in affected areas.

block:minecraft:infested_stone.what: Infested Stone is a block containing silverfish.
block:minecraft:infested_stone.does: Disturbing it can release hostile silverfish, so take care when mining suspicious stone in affected areas.

block:minecraft:infested_stone_bricks.what: Infested Stone Bricks is a block containing silverfish.
block:minecraft:infested_stone_bricks.does: Disturbing it can release hostile silverfish, so take care when mining suspicious stone in affected areas.

block:minecraft:iron_bars.what: Iron Bars is a thin iron construction block.
block:minecraft:iron_bars.does: Use it for barriers, supports, hanging details, and decorative metalwork.

block:minecraft:iron_block.what: Iron Block is a compact mineral or metal storage block.
block:minecraft:iron_block.does: Use it for construction or convert compatible storage blocks back into crafting materials. Some mineral blocks also work in beacon bases.

block:minecraft:iron_chain.what: Iron Chain is a thin iron construction block.
block:minecraft:iron_chain.does: Use it for barriers, supports, hanging details, and decorative metalwork.

block:minecraft:iron_door.what: Iron Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
block:minecraft:iron_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

block:minecraft:iron_ore.what: Iron Ore is a rock containing iron.
block:minecraft:iron_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

block:minecraft:iron_trapdoor.what: Iron Trapdoor is a small hinged hatch.
block:minecraft:iron_trapdoor.does: Use it for floor or ceiling openings and decorative details. Redstone can control it; iron trapdoors require redstone rather than hand opening.

block:minecraft:jigsaw.what: A jigsaw block is a world-generation and structure-connection tool.
block:minecraft:jigsaw.does: It is used in structure systems and mapmaking, rather than ordinary Survival crafting.

block:minecraft:jukebox.what: A jukebox is a block that plays music discs.
block:minecraft:jukebox.does: Insert a compatible disc to play its music, then remove it when you want to change the track.

block:minecraft:jungle_button.what: Jungle Button is a temporary redstone switch.
block:minecraft:jungle_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

block:minecraft:jungle_door.what: Jungle Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
block:minecraft:jungle_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

block:minecraft:jungle_double_slab.what: Jungle Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:jungle_double_slab.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:jungle_fence.what: Jungle Fence is a connecting fence block.
block:minecraft:jungle_fence.does: Use it to enclose animals or mark boundaries. Many mobs cannot jump over an ordinary fence, and leads can be tied to suitable fence posts.

block:minecraft:jungle_fence_gate.what: Jungle Fence Gate is an openable gate that connects to fences.
block:minecraft:jungle_fence_gate.does: Use it to enter an enclosure while keeping a fence-style barrier when closed. It can be controlled by hand or redstone.

block:minecraft:jungle_hanging_sign.what: Jungle Hanging Sign is a suspended sign for displaying written text.
block:minecraft:jungle_hanging_sign.does: Hang it from a suitable support and write a message. Dye changes the text color and glow ink can make the writing brighter.

block:minecraft:jungle_leaves.what: Jungle Leaves is foliage used by a tree or large plant.
block:minecraft:jungle_leaves.does: Use it for landscaping and hedges. Harvesting the intact block normally needs shears or Silk Touch; some leaves can drop plant materials when they decay.

block:minecraft:jungle_log.what: Jungle Log is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
block:minecraft:jungle_log.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

block:minecraft:jungle_planks.what: Jungle Planks is a processed wood building material.
block:minecraft:jungle_planks.does: Use it for construction and compatible recipes such as crafting tables, sticks, doors, and wooden components.

block:minecraft:jungle_pressure_plate.what: Jungle Pressure Plate is a switch activated when suitable entities stand on it.
block:minecraft:jungle_pressure_plate.does: Use it to trigger redstone mechanisms. Wooden and stone plates detect different kinds of entities.

block:minecraft:jungle_sapling.what: Jungle Sapling is a young plant that can grow into its corresponding tree.
block:minecraft:jungle_sapling.does: Plant it on suitable ground with enough space and appropriate conditions. Bone meal can speed up compatible growth.

block:minecraft:jungle_shelf.what: Jungle Shelf is a shelf block for displaying and storing items.
block:minecraft:jungle_shelf.does: Use it to organize items visibly on a wall or as part of a storage area.

block:minecraft:jungle_slab.what: Jungle Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:jungle_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:jungle_stairs.what: Jungle Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:jungle_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:jungle_standing_sign.what: Jungle Standing Sign is a sign for displaying written text.
block:minecraft:jungle_standing_sign.does: Place it on a suitable surface and enter a message. Use dye to recolor the text or glow ink to brighten it.

block:minecraft:jungle_trapdoor.what: Jungle Trapdoor is a small hinged hatch.
block:minecraft:jungle_trapdoor.does: Use it for floor or ceiling openings and decorative details. Redstone can control it; iron trapdoors require redstone rather than hand opening.

block:minecraft:jungle_wall_sign.what: Jungle Wall Sign is a sign for displaying written text.
block:minecraft:jungle_wall_sign.does: Place it on a suitable surface and enter a message. Use dye to recolor the text or glow ink to brighten it.

block:minecraft:jungle_wood.what: Jungle Wood is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
block:minecraft:jungle_wood.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

block:minecraft:kelp.does: Grow it in water, cook it into dried kelp, or use compatible kelp products as food and fuel.

block:minecraft:lab_table.what: A lab table is an Education chemistry workstation.
block:minecraft:lab_table.does: Use compatible ingredients in Education worlds to perform chemistry recipes and produce experiment results.

block:minecraft:ladder.what: A ladder is a climbable block attached to a supporting surface.
block:minecraft:ladder.does: Use it for vertical access in shafts, towers, and buildings.

block:minecraft:lantern.what: A lantern is a decorative light source that can stand on a surface or hang below a block.
block:minecraft:lantern.does: Use it to illuminate buildings, paths, and interiors.

block:minecraft:lapis_block.what: Lapis Block is a compact mineral or metal storage block.
block:minecraft:lapis_block.does: Use it for construction or convert compatible storage blocks back into crafting materials. Some mineral blocks also work in beacon bases.

block:minecraft:lapis_ore.what: Lapis Ore is a rock containing lapis.
block:minecraft:lapis_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

block:minecraft:large_amethyst_bud.what: Large Amethyst Bud is a developing amethyst crystal.
block:minecraft:large_amethyst_bud.does: Leave it on budding amethyst so it can continue growing into a cluster. An immature bud is not a full-grown shard harvest.

block:minecraft:large_fern.what: Large Fern is decorative ground or hanging vegetation.
block:minecraft:large_fern.does: Use it for natural landscaping on suitable surfaces. Harvesting and planting requirements depend on the plant.

block:minecraft:lava.what: Lava is a hot liquid that burns and damages many entities.
block:minecraft:lava.does: Use a bucket to move a source block or use lava as furnace fuel. Keep flammable builds and unprotected players away from it.

block:minecraft:leaf_litter.what: Leaf litter is a decorative layer of fallen leaves.
block:minecraft:leaf_litter.does: Use it to give forest floors and gardens a natural leaf-covered appearance.

block:minecraft:lectern.what: A lectern displays a written book or book and quill.
block:minecraft:lectern.does: Place a book on it for reading; page changes can be detected with redstone. It is also a librarian villager's job-site block.

block:minecraft:lever.what: A lever is a switch that stays on or off until you use it again.
block:minecraft:lever.does: Use it to control redstone wiring, doors, lamps, and other mechanisms.

block:minecraft:light_block_0.does: Use it with suitable commands or Creative access to illuminate an area without a visible lamp.

block:minecraft:light_blue_candle.what: Light Blue Candle is a small decorative light source.
block:minecraft:light_blue_candle.does: Place candles on a suitable surface and light them with a fire-starting tool. Compatible candles can share a block space.

block:minecraft:light_blue_candle_cake.what: Light Blue Candle Cake is a cake with a candle placed on it.
block:minecraft:light_blue_candle_cake.does: Light the candle for decoration or eat cake slices; eating the cake removes its candle arrangement.

block:minecraft:light_blue_carpet.what: Light Blue Carpet is a thin floor covering.
block:minecraft:light_blue_carpet.does: Use it for decorating floors and some spawn-proofing setups. A carpet is not the same as a full wool block.

block:minecraft:light_blue_concrete.what: Light Blue Concrete is a solid colored building block.
block:minecraft:light_blue_concrete.does: Use it for vivid walls, floors, sculptures, and other decorative builds.

block:minecraft:light_blue_concrete_doub.what: Light Blue Concrete Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:light_blue_concrete_doub.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:light_blue_concrete_powd.what: Light Blue Concrete Powder is a gravity-affected building material.

block:minecraft:raw_iron_block.what: Raw Iron Block is compact storage for raw metal.

block:minecraft:red_candle_cake.what: Red Candle Cake is a cake with a candle placed on it.
block:minecraft:red_candle_cake.does: Light the candle for decoration or eat cake slices; eating the cake removes its candle arrangement.

block:minecraft:red_carpet.what: Red Carpet is a thin floor covering.
block:minecraft:red_carpet.does: Use it for decorating floors and some spawn-proofing setups. A carpet is not the same as a full wool block.

block:minecraft:red_concrete.what: Red Concrete is a solid colored building block.
block:minecraft:red_concrete.does: Use it for vivid walls, floors, sculptures, and other decorative builds.

block:minecraft:red_concrete_double_slab.what: Red Concrete Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:red_concrete_double_slab.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:red_concrete_powder.what: Red Concrete Powder is a gravity-affected building material.
block:minecraft:red_concrete_powder.does: Place it in contact with suitable water to turn it into solid concrete, or use it as colored falling material.

block:minecraft:red_concrete_slab.what: Red Concrete Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:red_concrete_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:red_concrete_stairs.what: Red Concrete Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:red_concrete_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:red_glazed_terracotta.what: Red Glazed Terracotta is a patterned ceramic building block.
block:minecraft:red_glazed_terracotta.does: Use its directional placement to create repeating floor and wall designs.

block:minecraft:red_mushroom.what: A red mushroom is a fungus used in food and crafting.
block:minecraft:red_mushroom.does: Use it in mushroom stew and other compatible recipes, or grow a huge mushroom under suitable conditions.

block:minecraft:red_mushroom_block.what: A red mushroom block is part of a huge red mushroom.
block:minecraft:red_mushroom_block.does: Use it for colorful mushroom builds; intact harvesting requires a suitable Silk Touch tool.

block:minecraft:red_nether_brick.what: Red Nether Brick is a shaped masonry building block.
block:minecraft:red_nether_brick.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

block:minecraft:red_nether_brick_double_.what: Red Nether Brick Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.

block:minecraft:red_nether_brick_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

block:minecraft:red_poplar_leaves.what: Red Poplar Leaves is foliage used by a tree or large plant.
block:minecraft:red_poplar_leaves.does: Use it for landscaping and hedges. Harvesting the intact block normally needs shears or Silk Touch; some leaves can drop plant materials when they decay.

block:minecraft:red_sand.what: Red sand is an orange-red variant of sand that falls when unsupported.
block:minecraft:red_sand.does: Use it for landscaping, glass smelting, and compatible sand recipes.

block:minecraft:red_sandstone.what: Red Sandstone is a decorative stone building material.
block:minecraft:red_sandstone.does: Use it for contrasting walls, floors, columns, and other architectural details.

block:minecraft:red_shrub.what: Red Shrub is decorative ground or hanging vegetation.
block:minecraft:red_shrub.does: Use it for natural landscaping on suitable surfaces. Harvesting and planting requirements depend on the plant.

block:minecraft:red_shulker_box.what: Red Shulker Box is a portable storage container.
block:minecraft:red_shulker_box.does: Store items inside, break the box, and carry it with its contents preserved. You cannot put a shulker box inside another shulker box.

block:minecraft:red_stained_glass.what: Red Stained Glass is a colored transparent building block.
block:minecraft:red_stained_glass.does: Use it for tinted windows, decorative enclosures, or to color a beacon beam passing through it.

block:minecraft:red_stained_glass_pane.what: Red Stained Glass Pane is a thin colored glass block.
block:minecraft:red_stained_glass_pane.does: Use connected panes for tinted windows and dividers. It is not a full glass block.

block:minecraft:red_terracotta.what: Red Terracotta is a colored hardened-clay building block.
block:minecraft:red_terracotta.does: Use it for construction and decorative color palettes, or smelt compatible colored terracotta into its glazed form.

block:minecraft:red_tulip.what: Red Tulip is a decorative flower.
block:minecraft:red_tulip.does: Plant it on suitable ground for decoration or use it in compatible dye, composting, or crafting recipes.

block:minecraft:red_wool.what: Red Wool is a soft fabric building block.
block:minecraft:red_wool.does: Use it for decoration, beds, and compatible crafting recipes. Wool also helps block certain sculk vibration paths.

block:minecraft:red_wool_double_slab.what: Red Wool Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:red_wool_double_slab.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:red_wool_stairs.what: Red Wool Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:red_wool_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:redstone_block.what: Redstone Block is a compact mineral or metal storage block.
block:minecraft:redstone_block.does: Use it for construction or convert compatible storage blocks back into crafting materials. Some mineral blocks also work in beacon bases.

block:minecraft:redstone_lamp.what: A redstone lamp is a light block controlled by redstone.
block:minecraft:redstone_lamp.does: Power it to turn the light on and remove power to turn it off.

block:minecraft:redstone_ore.what: Redstone Ore is a rock containing redstone.
block:minecraft:redstone_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

block:minecraft:redstone_torch.what: A redstone torch is a small redstone power source that also emits light.
block:minecraft:redstone_torch.does: It usually powers nearby connections, but turns off when its attached block receives power, making it useful in logic circuits.

block:minecraft:redstone_wire.what: Redstone wire is placed redstone dust connecting mechanisms.
block:minecraft:redstone_wire.does: Use it to carry redstone signals between switches, circuits, and machines.

block:minecraft:reeds.what: Sugar cane is a tall plant that grows beside water.
block:minecraft:reeds.does: Harvest it for paper and sugar while leaving the bottom segment to regrow.

block:minecraft:reinforced_deepslate.what: Reinforced deepslate is an unusually tough decorative block associated with ancient cities.
block:minecraft:reinforced_deepslate.does: It forms part of ancient-city structures and is not normally obtainable as a block in ordinary Survival.

block:minecraft:repeating_command_block.what: A repeating command block runs its command repeatedly while active.
block:minecraft:repeating_command_block.does: Use it for mapmaking systems, keeping its activation conditions and performance cost in mind.

block:minecraft:resin_block.what: A resin block is a building and storage block made from resin clumps.
block:minecraft:resin_block.does: Use it for orange construction or convert it into suitable resin materials.

block:minecraft:resin_brick_double_slab.what: Resin Brick Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:resin_brick_double_slab.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:resin_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

block:minecraft:resin_clump.what: A resin clump is a material associated with creaking-heart interactions.
block:minecraft:resin_clump.does: Collect it for resin building and crafting recipes.

block:minecraft:respawn_anchor.what: A respawn anchor lets a player set a respawn point in the Nether.
block:minecraft:respawn_anchor.does: Charge it with glowstone. Trying to use it as a respawn point in an unsuitable dimension causes an explosion.

block:minecraft:rose_bush.what: Rose Bush is a decorative flower.
block:minecraft:rose_bush.does: Plant it on suitable ground for decoration or use it in compatible dye, composting, or crafting recipes.

block:minecraft:sculk.what: Sculk is a dark block associated with the deep dark.

block:minecraft:sculk_catalyst.does: Use it in sculk-growth and experience-related setups, remembering that the growth consumes the experience involved.

block:minecraft:sculk_sensor.what: A sculk sensor detects nearby vibrations and produces redstone signals.
block:minecraft:sculk_sensor.does: Use it for wireless detection, but remember that nearby movement and other actions can trigger it. Wool can block certain vibration paths.

block:minecraft:shroomlight.what: A shroomlight is a light-emitting block from huge Nether fungi.

block:minecraft:silver_glazed_terracotta.what: Silver Glazed Terracotta is a patterned ceramic building block.

block:minecraft:slime.what: A slime block is a bouncy block made from slimeballs.
block:minecraft:slime.does: Use it to reduce fall impact in suitable landings or move groups of compatible blocks with pistons.

block:minecraft:small_dripleaf_block.what: A small dripleaf is a water-associated plant.
block:minecraft:small_dripleaf_block.does: Use it in lush-cave decoration or grow it into big dripleaf with bone meal under suitable conditions.

block:minecraft:smithing_table.does: Use the appropriate smithing template and materials for netherite upgrades or armor trims. It is a toolsmith villager's job-site block.

block:minecraft:smoker.what: A smoker is a workstation that cooks food faster than a regular furnace.
block:minecraft:smoker.does: Use it with fuel for compatible food recipes. It is also a butcher villager's job-site block.

block:minecraft:smooth_basalt.does: Use it for dark stone walls, floors, and geode-themed builds.

block:minecraft:smooth_stone_double_slab.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:smooth_stone_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:sniffer_egg.what: A sniffer egg hatches into a young sniffer.
block:minecraft:sniffer_egg.does: Place it in a suitable location and wait; a moss block helps it hatch faster.

block:minecraft:snow.what: Snow is a full block made from snowballs.
block:minecraft:snow.does: Use it for snowy builds and making snow golems with the other required block.

block:minecraft:snow_layer.what: Snow layers are thin coverings of snow.
block:minecraft:snow_layer.does: Use them to create snowy ground and varying snow depths; heat can melt them.

block:minecraft:soul_campfire.what: A soul campfire is a blue-flamed campfire.
block:minecraft:soul_campfire.does: It cooks food and produces smoke like a campfire, while also being dangerous to touch.

block:minecraft:soul_fire.what: Soul fire is a blue flame associated with soul sand and soul soil.
block:minecraft:soul_fire.does: It damages entities and repels piglins; treat it as a hazard rather than safe decoration.

block:minecraft:soul_lantern.what: A soul lantern is a hanging or standing light source with a blue flame.
block:minecraft:soul_lantern.does: Use it for dimmer blue lighting and to help keep piglins away.

block:minecraft:soul_sand.what: Soul sand is a Nether block that slows entities walking on it.
block:minecraft:soul_sand.does: Use it to grow Nether wart, build parts of a Wither-summoning structure, or create upward bubble columns in source water.

block:minecraft:soul_soil.what: Soul soil is a Nether ground block associated with soul fire.
block:minecraft:soul_soil.does: Use it in soul-fire constructions and certain basalt-generation arrangements. It is not the same as soul sand for bubble columns.

block:minecraft:soul_torch.what: A soul torch is a blue-flamed light source.
block:minecraft:soul_torch.does: Use it for lighting and decoration; its soul-fire light also repels piglins.

block:minecraft:sponge.what: A sponge is a block that absorbs nearby water.
block:minecraft:sponge.does: Place it to help drain an area; once wet, it must be dried before it can absorb water again.

block:minecraft:spore_blossom.what: A spore blossom is a hanging flower from lush caves.
block:minecraft:spore_blossom.does: Place it on the underside of a suitable block for decoration and drifting particles.

block:minecraft:spruce_button.what: Spruce Button is a temporary redstone switch.
block:minecraft:spruce_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

block:minecraft:spruce_door.what: Spruce Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
block:minecraft:spruce_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

block:minecraft:spruce_double_slab.what: Spruce Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:spruce_double_slab.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:spruce_fence.what: Spruce Fence is a connecting fence block.
block:minecraft:spruce_fence.does: Use it to enclose animals or mark boundaries. Many mobs cannot jump over an ordinary fence, and leads can be tied to suitable fence posts.

block:minecraft:spruce_fence_gate.what: Spruce Fence Gate is an openable gate that connects to fences.
block:minecraft:spruce_fence_gate.does: Use it to enter an enclosure while keeping a fence-style barrier when closed. It can be controlled by hand or redstone.

block:minecraft:spruce_hanging_sign.what: Spruce Hanging Sign is a suspended sign for displaying written text.
block:minecraft:spruce_hanging_sign.does: Hang it from a suitable support and write a message. Dye changes the text color and glow ink can make the writing brighter.

block:minecraft:spruce_leaves.what: Spruce Leaves is foliage used by a tree or large plant.
block:minecraft:spruce_leaves.does: Use it for landscaping and hedges. Harvesting the intact block normally needs shears or Silk Touch; some leaves can drop plant materials when they decay.

block:minecraft:spruce_log.what: Spruce Log is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
block:minecraft:spruce_log.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

block:minecraft:spruce_planks.what: Spruce Planks is a processed wood building material.
block:minecraft:spruce_planks.does: Use it for construction and compatible recipes such as crafting tables, sticks, doors, and wooden components.

block:minecraft:spruce_pressure_plate.what: Spruce Pressure Plate is a switch activated when suitable entities stand on it.
block:minecraft:spruce_pressure_plate.does: Use it to trigger redstone mechanisms. Wooden and stone plates detect different kinds of entities.

block:minecraft:spruce_sapling.what: Spruce Sapling is a young plant that can grow into its corresponding tree.
block:minecraft:spruce_sapling.does: Plant it on suitable ground with enough space and appropriate conditions. Bone meal can speed up compatible growth.

block:minecraft:spruce_shelf.what: Spruce Shelf is a shelf block for displaying and storing items.
block:minecraft:spruce_shelf.does: Use it to organize items visibly on a wall or as part of a storage area.

block:minecraft:spruce_slab.what: Spruce Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:spruce_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:spruce_stairs.what: Spruce Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:spruce_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:spruce_standing_sign.what: Spruce Standing Sign is a sign for displaying written text.
block:minecraft:spruce_standing_sign.does: Place it on a suitable surface and enter a message. Use dye to recolor the text or glow ink to brighten it.

block:minecraft:spruce_trapdoor.what: Spruce Trapdoor is a small hinged hatch.
block:minecraft:spruce_trapdoor.does: Use it for floor or ceiling openings and decorative details. Redstone can control it; iron trapdoors require redstone rather than hand opening.

block:minecraft:spruce_wall_sign.what: Spruce Wall Sign is a sign for displaying written text.
block:minecraft:spruce_wall_sign.does: Place it on a suitable surface and enter a message. Use dye to recolor the text or glow ink to brighten it.

block:minecraft:spruce_wood.what: Spruce Wood is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
block:minecraft:spruce_wood.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

block:minecraft:standing_banner.what: A banner is a tall decorative flag that can display dyed patterns.
block:minecraft:standing_banner.does: Place it in a build and use a loom to add compatible designs.

block:minecraft:standing_sign.what: Standing Sign is a sign for displaying written text.
block:minecraft:standing_sign.does: Place it on a suitable surface and enter a message. Use dye to recolor the text or glow ink to brighten it.

block:minecraft:sticky_piston.what: A sticky piston pushes blocks and can pull a block back when it retracts.
block:minecraft:sticky_piston.does: Use it for retracting doors and other moving mechanisms. Bedrock piston behavior differs from Java in some situations.

block:minecraft:sticky_piston_arm_collis.what: A sticky piston head is the moving extension of a sticky piston.
block:minecraft:sticky_piston_arm_collis.does: It participates in the piston pushing and pulling its attached block. It is part of the mechanism, not a normal separate Survival building item.

block:minecraft:stone.what: Stone is a common solid rock found throughout the Overworld.
block:minecraft:stone.does: Mine it for building materials; without Silk Touch it normally drops cobblestone. It is used in many construction and crafting recipes.

block:minecraft:stone_brick_double_slab.what: Stone Brick Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:stone_brick_double_slab.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:stone_brick_slab.what: Stone Brick Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:stone_brick_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:stone_brick_stairs.what: Stone Brick Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:stone_brick_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:stone_brick_wall.what: Stone Brick Wall is a connecting wall block.
block:minecraft:stone_brick_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

block:minecraft:stone_bricks.what: Stone Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
block:minecraft:stone_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

block:minecraft:stone_button.what: Stone Button is a temporary redstone switch.
block:minecraft:stone_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

block:minecraft:stone_pressure_plate.what: Stone Pressure Plate is a switch activated when suitable entities stand on it.
block:minecraft:stone_pressure_plate.does: Use it to trigger redstone mechanisms. Wooden and stone plates detect different kinds of entities.

block:minecraft:stone_stairs.what: Stone Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:stone_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:stonecutter_block.what: A stonecutter turns compatible stone into building shapes.
block:minecraft:stonecutter_block.does: Use its menu for efficient stone stairs, slabs, and other shapes. It is also a mason villager's job-site block.

block:minecraft:straw_bed.what: Straw Bed is a colored bed for sleeping and setting an Overworld respawn point.
block:minecraft:straw_bed.does: Use it when the world's sleep conditions are met. Trying to sleep in the Nether or End causes an explosion.

block:minecraft:suspicious_sand.what: Suspicious sand is a fragile archaeology block containing a hidden item.
block:minecraft:suspicious_sand.does: Use a brush to uncover the item; breaking it normally destroys the chance to recover the contents.

block:minecraft:sweet_berry_bush.what: Sweet berries are food harvested from sweet berry bushes.
block:minecraft:sweet_berry_bush.does: Eat them or plant them to grow a bush. The bush can slow and hurt entities moving through it.

block:minecraft:tall_dry_grass.what: Tall Dry Grass is decorative ground or hanging vegetation.
block:minecraft:tall_dry_grass.does: Use it for natural landscaping on suitable surfaces. Harvesting and planting requirements depend on the plant.

block:minecraft:tall_grass.what: Tall Grass is decorative ground or hanging vegetation.
block:minecraft:tall_grass.does: Use it for natural landscaping on suitable surfaces. Harvesting and planting requirements depend on the plant.

block:minecraft:target.what: A target block detects hits from suitable projectiles.
block:minecraft:target.does: It produces a redstone signal, with stronger output for hits closer to the center of its target face.

block:minecraft:tinted_glass.what: Tinted glass is transparent-looking glass that blocks light transmission.
block:minecraft:tinted_glass.does: Use it to see into dark spaces while keeping them dark for suitable farms or decorative effects.

block:minecraft:tnt.what: TNT is an explosive block that becomes a primed explosive entity when ignited.
block:minecraft:tnt.does: Use it for controlled explosions, keeping people, pets, and important builds well away from the blast.

block:minecraft:torch.what: A torch is a placeable light source.
block:minecraft:torch.does: Use it to light paths and rooms and reduce normal hostile-mob spawning in dark areas.

block:minecraft:torchflower.what: A torchflower is an ancient decorative flower grown from seeds found by sniffers.
block:minecraft:torchflower.does: Use it for decoration and compatible crafting. Despite its name, it does not light up nearby blocks like a torch.

block:minecraft:torchflower_crop.what: A torchflower is an ancient decorative flower grown from seeds found by sniffers.
block:minecraft:torchflower_crop.does: Use it for decoration and compatible crafting. Despite its name, it does not light up nearby blocks like a torch.

block:minecraft:trapdoor.what: An oak trapdoor is a small hinged wooden hatch.
block:minecraft:trapdoor.does: Open it by hand or redstone for floor and ceiling access or decorative details.

block:minecraft:trapped_chest.what: A trapped chest is a storage container that sends a redstone signal while players open it.
block:minecraft:trapped_chest.does: Use it to trigger a mechanism when someone opens the chest. It does not automatically harm anyone.

block:minecraft:trial_spawner.what: A trial spawner is a combat encounter block found in trial chambers.
block:minecraft:trial_spawner.does: It spawns waves of mobs for nearby players and awards rewards after the trial. Ominous conditions change the encounter.

block:minecraft:trip_wire.what: Tripwire is placed string used with tripwire hooks.
block:minecraft:trip_wire.does: Create a connected line between hooks to detect entities crossing the string.

block:minecraft:tripwire_hook.what: A tripwire hook forms a tripwire detector when connected to another hook by string.
block:minecraft:tripwire_hook.does: Entities touching the connecting string trigger a redstone signal.

block:minecraft:tube_coral.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

block:minecraft:tube_coral_block.what: Tube Coral Block is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
block:minecraft:tube_coral_block.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

block:minecraft:unknown.does: It is not a normal Survival resource. If it appears in a world unexpectedly, a required add-on or block definition may be missing.

block:minecraft:unlit_redstone_torch.does: It usually powers nearby connections, but turns off when its attached block receives power, making it useful in logic circuits.
