block:minecraft:wither_rose.does: Use it carefully for decoration, black-dye production, or suitable farm mechanisms.

block:minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull.what: Wither Skeleton Skull is a mob-head decoration.
block:minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull.does: Display it, wear compatible heads, or use it in a matching recipe or mechanism. Wither skeleton skulls are also used in summoning the Wither.

block:minecraft:wooden_button.what: Wooden Button is a temporary redstone switch.
block:minecraft:wooden_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

block:minecraft:wooden_door.what: Wooden Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
block:minecraft:wooden_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

block:minecraft:wooden_pressure_plate.what: Wooden Pressure Plate is a switch activated when suitable entities stand on it.
block:minecraft:wooden_pressure_plate.does: Use it to trigger redstone mechanisms. Wooden and stone plates detect different kinds of entities.

block:minecraft:yellow_candle.what: Yellow Candle is a small decorative light source.
block:minecraft:yellow_candle.does: Place candles on a suitable surface and light them with a fire-starting tool. Compatible candles can share a block space.

block:minecraft:yellow_candle_cake.what: Yellow Candle Cake is a cake with a candle placed on it.
block:minecraft:yellow_candle_cake.does: Light the candle for decoration or eat cake slices; eating the cake removes its candle arrangement.

block:minecraft:yellow_carpet.what: Yellow Carpet is a thin floor covering.
block:minecraft:yellow_carpet.does: Use it for decorating floors and some spawn-proofing setups. A carpet is not the same as a full wool block.

block:minecraft:yellow_concrete.what: Yellow Concrete is a solid colored building block.
block:minecraft:yellow_concrete.does: Use it for vivid walls, floors, sculptures, and other decorative builds.

block:minecraft:yellow_concrete_double_s.what: Yellow Concrete Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:yellow_concrete_double_s.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:yellow_concrete_powder.what: Yellow Concrete Powder is a gravity-affected building material.
block:minecraft:yellow_concrete_powder.does: Place it in contact with suitable water to turn it into solid concrete, or use it as colored falling material.

block:minecraft:yellow_concrete_slab.what: Yellow Concrete Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:yellow_concrete_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:yellow_concrete_stairs.what: Yellow Concrete Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:yellow_concrete_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:yellow_glazed_terracotta.what: Yellow Glazed Terracotta is a patterned ceramic building block.
block:minecraft:yellow_glazed_terracotta.does: Use its directional placement to create repeating floor and wall designs.

block:minecraft:yellow_poplar_leaves.what: Yellow Poplar Leaves is foliage used by a tree or large plant.
block:minecraft:yellow_poplar_leaves.does: Use it for landscaping and hedges. Harvesting the intact block normally needs shears or Silk Touch; some leaves can drop plant materials when they decay.

block:minecraft:yellow_shulker_box.what: Yellow Shulker Box is a portable storage container.
block:minecraft:yellow_shulker_box.does: Store items inside, break the box, and carry it with its contents preserved. You cannot put a shulker box inside another shulker box.

block:minecraft:yellow_stained_glass.what: Yellow Stained Glass is a colored transparent building block.
block:minecraft:yellow_stained_glass.does: Use it for tinted windows, decorative enclosures, or to color a beacon beam passing through it.

block:minecraft:yellow_stained_glass_pan.what: Yellow Stained Glass Pane is a thin colored glass block.
block:minecraft:yellow_stained_glass_pan.does: Use connected panes for tinted windows and dividers. It is not a full glass block.

block:minecraft:yellow_terracotta.what: Yellow Terracotta is a colored hardened-clay building block.
block:minecraft:yellow_terracotta.does: Use it for construction and decorative color palettes, or smelt compatible colored terracotta into its glazed form.

block:minecraft:yellow_wool.what: Yellow Wool is a soft fabric building block.
block:minecraft:yellow_wool.does: Use it for decoration, beds, and compatible crafting recipes. Wool also helps block certain sculk vibration paths.

block:minecraft:yellow_wool_double_slab.what: Yellow Wool Double Slab is the full-height form made by combining two matching slabs.
block:minecraft:yellow_wool_double_slab.does: Use it for construction where you want a full block with the slab material's appearance.

block:minecraft:yellow_wool_slab.what: Yellow Wool Slab is a half-height building block.
block:minecraft:yellow_wool_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

block:minecraft:yellow_wool_stairs.what: Yellow Wool Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
block:minecraft:yellow_wool_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

block:minecraft:zombie_head.what: Zombie Head is a mob-head decoration.
block:minecraft:zombie_head.does: Display it, wear compatible heads, or use it in a matching recipe or mechanism. Wither skeleton skulls are also used in summoning the Wither.

entity:minecraft:agent.what: An Agent is a programmable helper from compatible Minecraft Education features.
entity:minecraft:agent.does: Use compatible coding tools to direct it through building, moving, or other supported actions; it is not an ordinary Survival pet.

entity:minecraft:allay.what: An allay is a friendly flying helper mob.
entity:minecraft:allay.does: Give it an item and it looks for dropped matching items to bring back. It does not mine blocks or create items for you.

entity:minecraft:area_effect_cloud.what: An area-effect cloud is an invisible or particle-marked area that applies configured effects.
entity:minecraft:area_effect_cloud.does: It is used by mechanics such as lingering potions and dragon breath. Entering it can apply the corresponding effect.

entity:minecraft:armadillo.what: An armadillo is a passive animal that rolls up when it senses certain threats.
entity:minecraft:armadillo.does: Collect its scutes, including by brushing it, to make and repair wolf armor.

entity:minecraft:armor_stand.what: An armor stand is a display entity for equipment.
entity:minecraft:armor_stand.does: Use it to display armor and compatible equipment; Bedrock armor stands support posing and additional held items.

entity:minecraft:arrow.what: An arrow is ammunition for bows, crossbows, and dispensers.
entity:minecraft:arrow.does: Fire it at a target to deal damage; tipped arrows can also apply effects.

entity:minecraft:axolotl.what: An axolotl is an aquatic animal that can help fight certain underwater mobs.
entity:minecraft:axolotl.does: Carry it in a water bucket and use buckets of tropical fish for breeding. It cannot stay out of water indefinitely.

entity:minecraft:bat.what: A bat is a small passive flying cave animal.
entity:minecraft:bat.does: It adds atmosphere to dark areas and is not a tameable companion or a useful loot source.

entity:minecraft:bee.what: A bee is a flying animal that visits flowers and returns to a nest or hive.
entity:minecraft:bee.does: It helps produce honey and can pollinate crops. Disturbing bees or harvesting carelessly can make them attack.

entity:minecraft:blaze.what: A blaze is a flying hostile Nether mob that attacks with fireballs.
entity:minecraft:blaze.does: Fight it carefully to obtain blaze rods, which are important for brewing and eyes of ender.

entity:minecraft:boat.what: A boat is a rideable vehicle for travelling across water.
entity:minecraft:boat.does: Place it on water, board it, and steer; it can also carry suitable passengers.

entity:minecraft:bogged.what: A bogged is a skeleton-like hostile mob that fires poisoned arrows.
entity:minecraft:bogged.does: Use cover against its ranged attacks; shearing it can remove its mushrooms.

entity:minecraft:breeze.what: A breeze is a jumping hostile mob found in trial chambers.
entity:minecraft:breeze.does: It fires wind charges that knock entities around and interact with certain mechanisms. Its drops are used in wind-related crafting.

entity:minecraft:breeze_wind_charge_proj.what: A breeze wind charge is the projectile fired by a breeze.
entity:minecraft:breeze_wind_charge_proj.does: Its wind burst can knock entities around and activate certain blocks when it hits.

entity:minecraft:camel.what: A camel is a tall rideable desert animal.
entity:minecraft:camel.does: Use a saddle to ride it with up to two players, and use its dash to cross suitable gaps.

entity:minecraft:camel_husk.what: A camel husk is an undead camel variant.
entity:minecraft:camel_husk.does: It can carry riders, including hostile ones under suitable conditions. Its undead behavior differs from an ordinary camel.

entity:minecraft:cat.what: A cat is a tameable animal often found around villages.
entity:minecraft:cat.does: Tame it with suitable raw fish to gain a companion. Cats also help keep creepers away.

entity:minecraft:cave_spider.what: A cave spider is a small hostile spider associated with abandoned mineshafts.
entity:minecraft:cave_spider.does: Its attacks can poison players under suitable difficulty settings. Keep distance and watch for webs.

entity:minecraft:chest_boat.what: A chest boat is a boat with built-in item storage.
entity:minecraft:chest_boat.does: Use it to transport yourself and supplies across water; its chest takes the place of an extra passenger seat.

entity:minecraft:chest_minecart.what: A chest minecart is a rail vehicle with item storage.
entity:minecraft:chest_minecart.does: Use it to carry supplies along tracks and connect it to loading or unloading systems.

entity:minecraft:chicken.what: A chicken is a passive farm animal that lays eggs.
entity:minecraft:chicken.does: Raise chickens for eggs, feathers, and food, and breed compatible adults using seeds.

entity:minecraft:cod.what: A cod is a small aquatic fish.
entity:minecraft:cod.does: Catch it for food or collect the live fish in a water bucket for transport.

entity:minecraft:command_block_minecart.what: A command block minecart is a rail vehicle that can run commands.
entity:minecraft:command_block_minecart.does: Use it in mapmaking systems with the appropriate permissions and powered activator-rail setup.

entity:minecraft:copper_golem.what: A copper golem is a helper mob associated with copper storage.
entity:minecraft:copper_golem.does: It sorts items by moving them from copper chests into suitable chests, making it useful in storage rooms. Its copper body oxidizes over time.

entity:minecraft:cow.what: A cow is a passive farm animal.
entity:minecraft:cow.does: Milk it with a bucket, breed adults with wheat, and raise cows as a source of leather and beef.

entity:minecraft:creaking.what: A creaking is a hostile tree-like mob linked to a creaking heart.
entity:minecraft:creaking.does: It moves when players are not looking at it. Deal with the linked heart rather than relying on ordinary attacks against the mob.

entity:minecraft:creeper.what: A creeper is a hostile mob that approaches players and explodes.
entity:minecraft:creeper.does: Its explosion can damage you and nearby blocks. Keep your distance; cats and ocelots help deter it.

entity:minecraft:cushion.what: A cushion is a seat-like decorative entity.
entity:minecraft:cushion.does: Place and interact with it as a seat in compatible builds.

entity:minecraft:dolphin.what: A dolphin is a neutral aquatic mammal found in oceans.
entity:minecraft:dolphin.does: Swimming nearby can help with movement in water, and feeding it raw fish can help guide you toward certain underwater loot locations. It needs air as well as water.

entity:minecraft:donkey.what: A donkey is a tameable riding animal.
entity:minecraft:donkey.does: Equip it with a saddle to ride and a chest to carry supplies. It can breed with a horse to produce a mule.

entity:minecraft:dragon_fireball.what: A dragon fireball is a projectile fired by the Ender Dragon.
entity:minecraft:dragon_fireball.does: It creates a dangerous effect cloud, so move away from the impact area.

entity:minecraft:drowned.what: A drowned is an underwater zombie that can also move on land.
entity:minecraft:drowned.does: Watch for trident-wielding drowned during water travel. Its available equipment and drops vary.

entity:minecraft:egg.what: An egg is an item laid by chickens that can also be thrown as a projectile.
entity:minecraft:egg.does: Use it in food recipes or throw it for a chance of hatching a chicken.

entity:minecraft:elder_guardian.what: An elder guardian is a large hostile aquatic mob found in ocean monuments.
entity:minecraft:elder_guardian.does: It uses a beam attack and can inflict Mining Fatigue, making monument exploration harder.

entity:minecraft:ender_crystal.what: An End crystal is an explosive crystal that can heal the Ender Dragon.
entity:minecraft:ender_crystal.does: It is used in the dragon-respawning arrangement. Breaking or attacking it causes a dangerous explosion.

entity:minecraft:ender_dragon.what: The Ender Dragon is a flying boss associated with the End's central island.
entity:minecraft:ender_dragon.does: It attacks players and can heal from End crystals. Defeating it opens important progression routes in the End.

entity:minecraft:ender_pearl.what: An ender pearl is a throwable teleportation item.
entity:minecraft:ender_pearl.does: Throw it to teleport to its landing location, usually taking teleportation damage. It is also used to craft eyes of ender.

entity:minecraft:enderman.what: An enderman is a tall neutral mob that can teleport and move certain blocks.
entity:minecraft:enderman.does: It becomes hostile when provoked, including by looking into its eyes under suitable conditions. Water is dangerous to it.

entity:minecraft:endermite.what: An endermite is a small hostile creature that can appear after ender-pearl use.
entity:minecraft:endermite.does: It attacks at close range and can attract the attention of endermen under the right conditions.

entity:minecraft:evocation_illager.what: An evoker is a spellcasting hostile illager.
entity:minecraft:evocation_illager.does: It summons vexes and magical fangs. It can drop a totem of undying when defeated.

entity:minecraft:eye_of_ender_signal.what: A thrown eye of ender is a moving entity that points toward a stronghold.
entity:minecraft:eye_of_ender_signal.does: Follow its direction to search for a stronghold, collecting it again if it survives the throw.

entity:minecraft:fireball.what: A large fireball is an explosive projectile commonly fired by ghasts.
entity:minecraft:fireball.does: Avoid its impact or deflect it with a well-timed attack.

entity:minecraft:fireworks_rocket.what: A firework rocket is a launched firework entity.
entity:minecraft:fireworks_rocket.does: It can display crafted firework effects or propel a player gliding with elytra, depending on how it was made and used.

entity:minecraft:fishing_hook.what: A fishing hook is the cast end of a fishing rod.
entity:minecraft:fishing_hook.does: It waits for fishing bites and can hook certain entities when you cast and reel it.

entity:minecraft:fox.what: A fox is an animal that can carry an item in its mouth.
entity:minecraft:fox.does: It hunts some smaller animals and can pick up dropped items. A fox bred by players can trust them, but is not a wolf-style tamed follower.

entity:minecraft:frog.what: A frog is an amphibian that can eat small slimes and small magma cubes.
entity:minecraft:frog.does: When it eats a small magma cube it produces a froglight; the frog variant determines the light's color.

entity:minecraft:ghast.what: A ghast is a large flying hostile Nether mob.
entity:minecraft:ghast.does: It fires explosive fireballs and can drop ghast tears, which are used in brewing and crafting.

entity:minecraft:glow_squid.what: A glow squid is a passive aquatic animal with a glowing-looking body.
entity:minecraft:glow_squid.does: It drops glow ink sacs used to brighten signs and make glow item frames. It does not illuminate nearby blocks like a torch.

entity:minecraft:goat.what: A goat is a mountain animal that jumps and sometimes rams entities.
entity:minecraft:goat.does: Give it space near cliffs. Certain ramming interactions can produce goat horns.

entity:minecraft:guardian.what: A guardian is a hostile aquatic mob associated with ocean monuments.
entity:minecraft:guardian.does: It attacks with a damaging beam and can hurt attackers with its defensive spikes.

entity:minecraft:happy_ghast.what: A happy ghast is a large friendly flying mob that players can ride with a harness.
entity:minecraft:happy_ghast.does: Use it for aerial transport and building work; it can carry multiple players.

entity:minecraft:hoglin.what: A hoglin is a hostile Nether animal found in crimson environments.
entity:minecraft:hoglin.does: It attacks at close range and can be bred with crimson fungus. Outside the Nether it can transform into a zoglin.

entity:minecraft:hopper_minecart.what: A hopper minecart is a rail vehicle that collects items.
entity:minecraft:hopper_minecart.does: Use it to gather dropped items and move them along tracks, often underneath farms. A powered activator rail changes its collection state.

entity:minecraft:horse.what: A horse is a tameable riding animal.
entity:minecraft:horse.does: Tame it, equip a saddle to control riding, and use it for fast ground travel. Compatible horses can also wear horse armor.

entity:minecraft:husk.what: A husk is a desert zombie variant that does not burn in sunlight.
entity:minecraft:husk.does: Its attacks can inflict Hunger, so it remains dangerous even in daytime.

entity:minecraft:iron_golem.what: An iron golem is a strong guardian mob often associated with villages.
entity:minecraft:iron_golem.does: It attacks many hostile mobs and can protect a settlement. Attacking villagers or golems can make some golems hostile to you.

entity:minecraft:lightning_bolt.what: A lightning bolt is a weather event that can also be summoned as an entity.
entity:minecraft:lightning_bolt.does: It can damage entities, ignite blocks, and transform certain mobs. Lightning rods help direct nearby strikes.

entity:minecraft:lingering_potion.what: A lingering potion is a throwable potion that leaves an effect cloud.
entity:minecraft:lingering_potion.does: Entities entering the cloud can receive the potion's effect while the cloud lasts.

entity:minecraft:llama.what: A llama is a tameable pack animal.
entity:minecraft:llama.does: Equip it with a chest for cargo and use a lead to guide a caravan. It can spit at targets when provoked.

entity:minecraft:llama_spit.what: Llama spit is the projectile a llama spits at a target.
entity:minecraft:llama_spit.does: It is a defensive ranged attack rather than an item you normally collect.

entity:minecraft:magma_cube.what: A magma cube is a bouncing hostile Nether mob.
entity:minecraft:magma_cube.does: Larger cubes split into smaller ones when killed. Their drops are used for magma cream and related recipes.

entity:minecraft:minecart.what: A minecart is a rail vehicle for transporting entities.
entity:minecraft:minecart.does: Place it on rails and use powered track or other mechanisms to move riders along a route.

entity:minecraft:mooshroom.what: A mooshroom is a mushroom-covered cow variant.
entity:minecraft:mooshroom.does: It can be milked and can provide mushroom stew when used with a bowl. Shearing it changes it into an ordinary cow.

entity:minecraft:mule.what: A mule is a rideable pack animal produced by breeding a horse and donkey.
entity:minecraft:mule.does: Tame and saddle it for travel, or add a chest for supplies. Mules cannot breed.

entity:minecraft:nautilus.what: A nautilus is an aquatic animal that can become a rideable mount.
entity:minecraft:nautilus.does: Tame and equip a suitable adult to travel underwater; keep it in appropriate water conditions.

entity:minecraft:npc.what: An NPC is a special character entity used in compatible Education and mapmaking worlds.
entity:minecraft:npc.does: Creators can configure dialogue and actions; it is not an ordinary naturally spawning Survival villager.

entity:minecraft:ocelot.what: An ocelot is a wild jungle cat.
entity:minecraft:ocelot.does: Feeding suitable raw fish can gain its trust, but it does not become a domestic cat. Ocelots help keep creepers away.

entity:minecraft:ominous_item_spawner.what: An ominous item spawner is a special entity used in ominous-trial encounters.
entity:minecraft:ominous_item_spawner.does: It creates falling items or projectiles as part of trial mechanics, rather than acting as a normal tameable mob.

entity:minecraft:panda.what: A panda is a jungle animal with several personality variants.
entity:minecraft:panda.does: It eats bamboo and has special breeding conditions involving nearby bamboo and willing adults.

entity:minecraft:parched.what: A parched is a hostile undead skeleton variant.
entity:minecraft:parched.does: It can use ranged attacks, so use cover and avoid treating it as a passive desert animal.

entity:minecraft:parrot.what: A parrot is a tameable jungle bird.
entity:minecraft:parrot.does: Tame it with suitable seeds, let it perch on your shoulder, and listen to its imitations of nearby mobs. Cookies are poisonous to parrots.

entity:minecraft:phantom.what: A phantom is a flying hostile mob associated with players going too long without rest.
entity:minecraft:phantom.does: Sleep or rest to avoid attracting more phantoms, and watch for diving attacks at night.

entity:minecraft:pig.what: A pig is a passive farm animal.
entity:minecraft:pig.does: Raise it for porkchops or ride a saddled pig using a carrot on a stick to steer.

entity:minecraft:piglin.what: A piglin is a Nether mob that can barter gold ingots for items.
entity:minecraft:piglin.does: Wearing gold armor helps avoid ordinary piglin hostility, but certain actions still anger it. Piglin brutes do not follow the same rules.

entity:minecraft:piglin_brute.what: A piglin brute is an aggressive axe-wielding mob found in bastion remnants.
entity:minecraft:piglin_brute.does: It does not become friendly because you wear gold and does not barter like ordinary piglins.

entity:minecraft:pillager.what: A pillager is a hostile illager armed with a crossbow.
entity:minecraft:pillager.does: It attacks from range and appears in patrols, outposts, and raids.

entity:minecraft:player.what: A player is a person-controlled character in the world.
entity:minecraft:player.does: Players explore, build, craft, fight, and interact with the world according to their game mode and permissions.

entity:minecraft:polar_bear.what: A polar bear is a large animal found in cold regions.
entity:minecraft:polar_bear.does: Adults may become hostile when provoked or when a cub is threatened; it is not a tameable riding animal.

entity:minecraft:pufferfish.what: A pufferfish is an aquatic fish that inflates when threatened.
entity:minecraft:pufferfish.does: Its defenses can poison nearby entities. Collect it in a bucket or use its item form in compatible brewing recipes.

entity:minecraft:rabbit.what: A rabbit is a small passive animal.
entity:minecraft:rabbit.does: Breed it with suitable food and raise rabbits for hide, meat, and occasional rabbit's feet.

entity:minecraft:ravager.what: A ravager is a large hostile beast found in raids.
entity:minecraft:ravager.does: It attacks with powerful close-range strikes and can damage certain plants, so keep your distance and use cover.

entity:minecraft:salmon.what: A salmon is an aquatic fish found in suitable water areas.
entity:minecraft:salmon.does: Catch it for food or collect it alive in a water bucket.

entity:minecraft:sheep.what: A sheep is a passive farm animal that provides wool.
entity:minecraft:sheep.does: Use shears to collect wool, dye it to change wool color, and feed adult sheep wheat to breed them.

entity:minecraft:shulker.what: A shulker is a hostile shell-covered mob found in End cities.
entity:minecraft:shulker.does: Its projectiles cause Levitation, and its shells are used to craft portable shulker boxes.

entity:minecraft:shulker_bullet.what: A shulker bullet is a homing projectile fired by a shulker.
entity:minecraft:shulker_bullet.does: A hit can cause Levitation; destroy it or use cover to avoid being lifted into a dangerous fall.

entity:minecraft:silverfish.what: A silverfish is a small hostile mob associated with infested stone and strongholds.
entity:minecraft:silverfish.does: Disturbing infested blocks can release it, and nearby infested blocks can make a fight worse.

entity:minecraft:skeleton.what: A skeleton is a hostile undead mob that usually fires arrows.
entity:minecraft:skeleton.does: Use cover or a shield against it. Ordinary exposed skeletons burn in sunlight unless protected.

entity:minecraft:skeleton_horse.what: A skeleton horse is an undead rideable horse.
entity:minecraft:skeleton_horse.does: Certain skeleton-trap encounters can produce them. It is not an ordinary breedable horse.

entity:minecraft:slime.what: A slime is a bouncing hostile mob that divides into smaller slimes when killed.
entity:minecraft:slime.does: Its smaller forms can provide slimeballs used for sticky pistons and other recipes.

entity:minecraft:small_fireball.what: A small fireball is a fiery projectile used by mobs such as blazes.
entity:minecraft:small_fireball.does: It can burn targets and ignite suitable surfaces, so use cover rather than trying to collect it.

entity:minecraft:sniffer.what: A sniffer is an ancient passive animal hatched from a sniffer egg.
entity:minecraft:sniffer.does: It digs up special ancient plant seeds or pods from suitable ground, helping players grow decorative plants.

entity:minecraft:snow_golem.what: A snow golem is a player-built mob made using snow blocks and a carved pumpkin or suitable equivalent.
entity:minecraft:snow_golem.does: It throws snowballs at many hostile mobs and can leave snow trails in suitable conditions. Heat and water can harm it.

entity:minecraft:snowball.what: A snowball is a throwable item and projectile.
entity:minecraft:snowball.does: Throw it to knock or distract suitable targets; it also has special interactions with some mobs, including blazes.

entity:minecraft:spider.what: A spider is a climbing mob that can become hostile depending on conditions.
entity:minecraft:spider.does: It climbs walls and attacks at close range. Brightness affects its ordinary aggression.

entity:minecraft:splash_potion.what: A splash potion is a throwable potion.
entity:minecraft:splash_potion.does: Throw it to apply its effect around the impact point; the effect depends on the potion's contents.

entity:minecraft:squid.what: A squid is a passive aquatic animal.
entity:minecraft:squid.does: It provides ink sacs when killed; it is not a tameable riding animal.

entity:minecraft:stray.what: A stray is a cold-region skeleton variant.
entity:minecraft:stray.does: It fires arrows that inflict Slowness, making it harder to escape follow-up attacks.

entity:minecraft:strider.what: A strider is a passive Nether animal that walks on lava.
entity:minecraft:strider.does: Saddle it and steer with a warped fungus on a stick for lava travel. It becomes cold and slower away from lava.

entity:minecraft:sulfur_cube.what: A sulfur cube is a cube-shaped animal that can carry a suitable block.
entity:minecraft:sulfur_cube.does: The block it holds can change its movement and other behavior. Some interactions can make it dangerous, including explosive behavior.

entity:minecraft:tadpole.what: A tadpole is the young aquatic stage of a frog.
entity:minecraft:tadpole.does: Carry it in a water bucket and raise it into a frog. Its growing environment affects which frog variant it becomes.

entity:minecraft:thrown_trident.what: A thrown trident is a trident travelling as a projectile.
entity:minecraft:thrown_trident.does: It deals damage on impact; recovery and return behavior depend on the trident and its enchantments.

entity:minecraft:tnt.what: TNT is an explosive block that becomes a primed explosive entity when ignited.
entity:minecraft:tnt.does: Use it for controlled explosions, keeping people, pets, and important builds well away from the blast.

entity:minecraft:tnt_minecart.what: A TNT minecart is an explosive rail vehicle.
entity:minecraft:tnt_minecart.does: Certain activations and impacts can trigger it. Use it only where an explosion is intended.

entity:minecraft:trader_llama.what: A trader llama is a llama associated with a wandering trader.
entity:minecraft:trader_llama.does: It carries the trader's decorations and can defend itself by spitting. It follows llama-style handling rules rather than villager trading rules.

entity:minecraft:tripod_camera.what: A tripod camera is a special camera entity used in compatible Education features.
entity:minecraft:tripod_camera.does: It is not a normal Survival mob or a general-purpose companion.

entity:minecraft:tropicalfish.what: A tropical fish is a colorful aquatic fish with many appearance variants.
entity:minecraft:tropicalfish.does: Collect it alive in a water bucket for aquariums or use a bucket of tropical fish for compatible axolotl interactions.

entity:minecraft:turtle.what: A turtle is a passive coastal animal.
entity:minecraft:turtle.does: Breed it with seagrass to produce eggs on its home beach. Babies shed turtle scutes when they grow up.

entity:minecraft:vex.what: A vex is a small flying hostile spirit summoned by evokers.
entity:minecraft:vex.does: It can pass through blocks and attack with a sword, so ordinary walls are not reliable protection.

entity:minecraft:villager.what: A villager is a village inhabitant that can trade with players.
entity:minecraft:villager.does: Eligible villagers take professions from job-site blocks. Their trades depend on profession, level, and world settings.

entity:minecraft:villager_v2.what: A villager is a village inhabitant that can trade with players.
entity:minecraft:villager_v2.does: Eligible villagers take professions from job-site blocks. Their trades depend on profession, level, and world settings.

entity:minecraft:vindicator.what: A vindicator is a hostile axe-wielding illager.
entity:minecraft:vindicator.does: It attacks at close range and appears in raids and certain structures.

entity:minecraft:wandering_trader.what: A wandering trader is a travelling merchant that appears with trader llamas.
entity:minecraft:wandering_trader.does: Trade emeralds for its rotating selection of goods before it leaves.

entity:minecraft:warden.what: The Warden is a powerful hostile mob associated with the deep dark and sculk shriekers.
entity:minecraft:warden.does: It uses vibrations, smell, and a sonic attack to find and fight threats. Sneak away and avoid summoning it rather than treating it as an ordinary fight.

entity:minecraft:wind_charge_projectile.what: A wind charge is a projectile that creates a gust on impact.
entity:minecraft:wind_charge_projectile.does: Use wind bursts for movement tricks and activating compatible mechanisms; be careful about landing damage.

entity:minecraft:witch.what: A witch is a hostile potion-using mob.
entity:minecraft:witch.does: It throws harmful potions and drinks useful potions to protect or heal itself.

entity:minecraft:wither.what: The Wither is a powerful summoned undead boss.
entity:minecraft:wither.does: It flies, fires explosive skulls, and causes destructive fights. Defeating it provides a Nether star.

entity:minecraft:wither_skeleton.what: A wither skeleton is a hostile Nether skeleton that usually fights with a sword.
entity:minecraft:wither_skeleton.does: Its attacks inflict the Wither effect, and its rare skull drop is used to summon the Wither.

entity:minecraft:wither_skull.what: A Wither skull projectile is an explosive attack fired by the Wither.
entity:minecraft:wither_skull.does: Avoid the impact and resulting harmful effects; it is not the same thing as a collectible wither skeleton skull.

entity:minecraft:wither_skull_dangerous.what: A blue Wither skull is a dangerous variant of the Wither's explosive projectile.
entity:minecraft:wither_skull_dangerous.does: It can break blocks that resist many ordinary explosions, so do not rely on a simple wall for protection.

entity:minecraft:wolf.what: A wolf is a neutral animal that can be tamed into a companion.
entity:minecraft:wolf.does: Tame it with bones, then have it follow or sit. Tamed wolves help defend their owner and can wear wolf armor.

entity:minecraft:xp_bottle.what: A bottle o' enchanting is a throwable item that releases experience.
entity:minecraft:xp_bottle.does: Throw it to create experience orbs for levels or suitable Mending equipment.

entity:minecraft:xp_orb.what: An experience orb is a small entity that players collect for experience.
entity:minecraft:xp_orb.does: It contributes toward experience levels or repairs suitable equipped Mending items.

entity:minecraft:zoglin.what: A zoglin is an undead hoglin variant created when a hoglin transforms outside the Nether.
entity:minecraft:zoglin.does: It is aggressive toward many nearby entities and cannot be bred like an ordinary hoglin.

entity:minecraft:zombie.what: A zombie is a hostile undead mob that attacks at close range.
entity:minecraft:zombie.does: It normally burns in direct sunlight unless protected and can transform into a drowned after suitable underwater conditions.

entity:minecraft:zombie_horse.what: A zombie horse is an undead horse variant.
entity:minecraft:zombie_horse.does: Its availability and riding rules depend on the game version and how it was obtained; do not assume ordinary horse breeding works.

entity:minecraft:zombie_nautilus.what: A zombie nautilus is an undead aquatic nautilus variant.
entity:minecraft:zombie_nautilus.does: It can carry riders and has taming and saddling interactions under suitable conditions. Its undead behavior differs from an ordinary nautilus.

entity:minecraft:zombie_pigman.what: A zombified piglin is a neutral undead Nether mob.
entity:minecraft:zombie_pigman.does: Attacking one can anger nearby zombified piglins. It does not barter like an ordinary piglin.

entity:minecraft:zombie_villager.what: A zombie villager is an undead villager variant.
entity:minecraft:zombie_villager.does: Apply the appropriate Weakness effect and use a golden apple to begin curing it under suitable conditions.

entity:minecraft:zombie_villager_v2.what: A zombie villager is an undead villager variant.
entity:minecraft:zombie_villager_v2.does: Apply the appropriate Weakness effect and use a golden apple to begin curing it under suitable conditions.

item:minecraft:acacia_boat.what: Acacia Boat is a rideable water vehicle.
item:minecraft:acacia_boat.does: Place it on water to carry players or compatible passengers along rivers and across other water routes.

item:minecraft:acacia_button.what: Acacia Button is a temporary redstone switch.
item:minecraft:acacia_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

item:minecraft:acacia_chest_boat.what: Acacia Chest Boat is a water vehicle with built-in storage.
item:minecraft:acacia_chest_boat.does: Use it to travel across water while carrying items in its chest. The storage replaces an extra passenger seat.

item:minecraft:acacia_door.what: Acacia Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
item:minecraft:acacia_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:acacia_fence.what: Acacia Fence is a connecting fence block.
item:minecraft:acacia_fence.does: Use it to enclose animals or mark boundaries. Many mobs cannot jump over an ordinary fence, and leads can be tied to suitable fence posts.

item:minecraft:acacia_fence_gate.what: Acacia Fence Gate is an openable gate that connects to fences.
item:minecraft:acacia_fence_gate.does: Use it to enter an enclosure while keeping a fence-style barrier when closed. It can be controlled by hand or redstone.

item:minecraft:acacia_hanging_sign.what: Acacia Hanging Sign is a suspended sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:acacia_hanging_sign.does: Hang it from a suitable support and write a message. Dye changes the text color and glow ink can make the writing brighter.

item:minecraft:acacia_leaves.what: Acacia Leaves is foliage used by a tree or large plant.
item:minecraft:acacia_leaves.does: Use it for landscaping and hedges. Harvesting the intact block normally needs shears or Silk Touch; some leaves can drop plant materials when they decay.

item:minecraft:acacia_log.what: Acacia Log is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
item:minecraft:acacia_log.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:acacia_planks.what: Acacia Planks is a processed wood building material.
item:minecraft:acacia_planks.does: Use it for construction and compatible recipes such as crafting tables, sticks, doors, and wooden components.

item:minecraft:acacia_pressure_plate.what: Acacia Pressure Plate is a switch activated when suitable entities stand on it.
item:minecraft:acacia_pressure_plate.does: Use it to trigger redstone mechanisms. Wooden and stone plates detect different kinds of entities.

item:minecraft:acacia_sapling.what: Acacia Sapling is a young plant that can grow into its corresponding tree.
item:minecraft:acacia_sapling.does: Plant it on suitable ground with enough space and appropriate conditions. Bone meal can speed up compatible growth.

item:minecraft:acacia_shelf.what: Acacia Shelf is a shelf block for displaying and storing items.
item:minecraft:acacia_shelf.does: Use it to organize items visibly on a wall or as part of a storage area.

item:minecraft:acacia_sign.what: Acacia Sign is a sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:acacia_sign.does: Place it on a suitable surface and enter a message. Use dye to recolor the text or glow ink to brighten it.

item:minecraft:acacia_slab.what: Acacia Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:acacia_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:acacia_stairs.what: Acacia Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:acacia_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:acacia_trapdoor.what: Acacia Trapdoor is a small hinged hatch.
item:minecraft:acacia_trapdoor.does: Use it for floor or ceiling openings and decorative details. Redstone can control it; iron trapdoors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:acacia_wood.what: Acacia Wood is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
item:minecraft:acacia_wood.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:activator_rail.what: An activator rail is a track that activates certain minecart functions when powered.
item:minecraft:activator_rail.does: It can eject riders, activate TNT minecarts, or change hopper minecart collection behavior.

item:minecraft:allay_spawn_egg.what: Allay Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:allay_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:allium.does: Plant it on suitable ground for decoration or use it in compatible dye, composting, or crafting recipes.

item:minecraft:allow.what: An allow block is an Education or mapmaking permission block.
item:minecraft:allow.does: In compatible worlds it allows building in the area above it despite certain restrictions.

item:minecraft:amethyst_block.what: An amethyst block is a purple crystal building block.
item:minecraft:amethyst_block.does: Use it for decoration and its musical sounds; it is different from budding amethyst, which grows crystals.

item:minecraft:amethyst_cluster.what: An amethyst cluster is the fully grown form of an amethyst crystal.
item:minecraft:amethyst_cluster.does: Harvest it for amethyst shards with an appropriate tool, or keep it intact using suitable harvesting methods.

item:minecraft:amethyst_shard.what: An amethyst shard is a material harvested from amethyst clusters.
item:minecraft:amethyst_shard.does: Use it in recipes such as spyglasses, tinted glass, and calibrated sculk sensors.

item:minecraft:ancient_debris.what: Ancient debris is a rare Nether material used to obtain netherite.
item:minecraft:ancient_debris.does: Mine it with an appropriate high-tier pickaxe and smelt it into netherite scrap.

item:minecraft:andesite.what: Andesite is a decorative stone building material.
item:minecraft:andesite.does: Use it for contrasting walls, floors, columns, and other architectural details.

item:minecraft:andesite_slab.what: Andesite Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:andesite_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:andesite_stairs.what: Andesite Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:andesite_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:andesite_wall.what: Andesite Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:andesite_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:angler_pottery_sherd.what: Angler Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:angler_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:anvil.what: An anvil is a workstation for repairing, combining, and renaming equipment.
item:minecraft:anvil.does: Spend experience levels to combine compatible enchantments or repair equipment. Anvils wear out with use and fall if unsupported.

item:minecraft:apple.what: An apple is a food item.
item:minecraft:apple.does: Eat it to restore hunger or use it in golden-apple recipes.

item:minecraft:archer_pottery_sherd.what: Archer Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:archer_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:armadillo_scute.what: An armadillo scute is a material obtained from armadillos.
item:minecraft:armadillo_scute.does: Use it to craft and repair wolf armor.

item:minecraft:armadillo_spawn_egg.what: Armadillo Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:armadillo_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:armor_stand.what: An armor stand is a display entity for equipment.
item:minecraft:armor_stand.does: Use it to display armor and compatible equipment; Bedrock armor stands support posing and additional held items.

item:minecraft:arms_up_pottery_sherd.what: Arms Up Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:arms_up_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:arrow.what: An arrow is ammunition for bows, crossbows, and dispensers.
item:minecraft:arrow.does: Fire it at a target to deal damage; tipped arrows can also apply effects.

item:minecraft:axolotl_bucket.what: Axolotl Bucket is a bucket carrying its named contents.
item:minecraft:axolotl_bucket.does: Use it to place or release the contents in a suitable location. Filled fish and axolotl buckets let you transport the animal alive.

item:minecraft:axolotl_spawn_egg.what: Axolotl Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:axolotl_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:azalea.what: Azalea is a small azalea plant.
item:minecraft:azalea.does: Use it for garden decoration or grow it with bone meal under suitable conditions to form an azalea tree.

item:minecraft:azalea_leaves.what: Azalea Leaves is foliage used by a tree or large plant.
item:minecraft:azalea_leaves.does: Use it for landscaping and hedges. Harvesting the intact block normally needs shears or Silk Touch; some leaves can drop plant materials when they decay.

item:minecraft:azalea_leaves_flowered.what: Azalea Leaves Flowered is foliage used by a tree or large plant.

item:minecraft:azure_bluet.what: Azure Bluet is a decorative flower.
item:minecraft:azure_bluet.does: Plant it on suitable ground for decoration or use it in compatible dye, composting, or crafting recipes.

item:minecraft:baked_potato.does: Eat it to restore hunger. Cooking meat and potatoes generally makes them more useful as food; exact hunger restoration depends on the food.

item:minecraft:bamboo.what: Bamboo is a fast-growing plant and building resource.
item:minecraft:bamboo.does: Use it in scaffolding, sticks, fuel, and compatible bamboo building recipes.

item:minecraft:bamboo_block.what: A bamboo block is compacted bamboo used as a building material.
item:minecraft:bamboo_block.does: Use it for construction or process it into compatible bamboo building products.

item:minecraft:banner.what: A banner is a tall decorative flag that can display dyed patterns.
item:minecraft:banner.does: Use a loom to add designs, then place it in your build.

item:minecraft:barrel.what: A barrel is a storage container that can open even with a solid block above it.
item:minecraft:barrel.does: Use it for compact storage. It also serves as a fisherman villager's job-site block.

item:minecraft:barrier.what: A barrier is an invisible solid block used in mapmaking.
item:minecraft:barrier.does: Use it with suitable commands or Creative permissions to block movement without a visible wall.

item:minecraft:basalt.what: Basalt is a dark volcanic-looking building block.
item:minecraft:basalt.does: Use it in columns and textured builds; its placement changes the direction of its visible grain.

item:minecraft:bat_spawn_egg.what: Bat Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:bat_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:beacon.what: A beacon is a block that can provide status effects to nearby players.
item:minecraft:beacon.does: Build a valid mineral-block pyramid beneath it, keep its beam path clear, and use its menu to select available effects.

item:minecraft:bed.what: A bed lets players sleep and set a respawn point in the Overworld.
item:minecraft:bed.does: Sleep to help skip the night when the world's sleep conditions are met. Attempting to sleep in the Nether or End causes an explosion.

item:minecraft:bedrock.what: Bedrock is the normally unbreakable block that forms boundaries in Minecraft worlds.
item:minecraft:bedrock.does: In ordinary Survival play it is a barrier rather than a harvestable building material.

item:minecraft:bee_nest.what: A bee nest is a naturally generated home for bees.
item:minecraft:bee_nest.does: It can fill with honey when bees use it. Harvest honey or honeycomb carefully to avoid angering the bees.

item:minecraft:bee_spawn_egg.what: Bee Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:bee_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:beef.what: Raw beef is food obtained from cows and similar sources.
item:minecraft:beef.does: Cook it into steak for more useful food, or use it in compatible animal-feeding interactions.

item:minecraft:beehive.what: A beehive is a crafted home for bees.
item:minecraft:beehive.does: Bees can store honey after visiting flowers. Harvest honey or honeycomb carefully; a properly placed campfire can keep bees calm during harvesting.

item:minecraft:beetroot.what: Beetroot is a crop grown from beetroot seeds.
item:minecraft:beetroot.does: Eat it or use it for beetroot soup and compatible dye recipes.

item:minecraft:beetroot_seeds.what: Beetroot seeds grow into beetroot crops on farmland.
item:minecraft:beetroot_seeds.does: Plant them, let the crop mature, and harvest beetroots and more seeds.

item:minecraft:beetroot_soup.what: Beetroot soup is a bowl-based food made from beetroots.
item:minecraft:beetroot_soup.does: Eat it to restore hunger; you keep the empty bowl afterward.

item:minecraft:bell.what: A bell is a village block that can be rung.
item:minecraft:bell.does: Ring it as a village signal; villagers react to bells and they can help during raids.

item:minecraft:big_dripleaf.what: A big dripleaf is a plant with a broad leaf that can temporarily support entities.
item:minecraft:big_dripleaf.does: Its leaf tilts after being stood on, making it useful for parkour and decorative platforms.

item:minecraft:black_candle.what: Black Candle is a small decorative light source.

item:minecraft:cherry_chest_boat.does: Use it to travel across water while carrying items in its chest. The storage replaces an extra passenger seat.

item:minecraft:cherry_door.what: Cherry Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
item:minecraft:cherry_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:cherry_fence.what: Cherry Fence is a connecting fence block.
item:minecraft:cherry_fence.does: Use it to enclose animals or mark boundaries. Many mobs cannot jump over an ordinary fence, and leads can be tied to suitable fence posts.

item:minecraft:cherry_fence_gate.what: Cherry Fence Gate is an openable gate that connects to fences.
item:minecraft:cherry_fence_gate.does: Use it to enter an enclosure while keeping a fence-style barrier when closed. It can be controlled by hand or redstone.

item:minecraft:cherry_hanging_sign.what: Cherry Hanging Sign is a suspended sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:cherry_hanging_sign.does: Hang it from a suitable support and write a message. Dye changes the text color and glow ink can make the writing brighter.

item:minecraft:cherry_leaves.what: Cherry Leaves is foliage used by a tree or large plant.
item:minecraft:cherry_leaves.does: Use it for landscaping and hedges. Harvesting the intact block normally needs shears or Silk Touch; some leaves can drop plant materials when they decay.

item:minecraft:cherry_log.what: Cherry Log is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
item:minecraft:cherry_log.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:cherry_planks.what: Cherry Planks is a processed wood building material.
item:minecraft:cherry_planks.does: Use it for construction and compatible recipes such as crafting tables, sticks, doors, and wooden components.

item:minecraft:cherry_pressure_plate.what: Cherry Pressure Plate is a switch activated when suitable entities stand on it.
item:minecraft:cherry_pressure_plate.does: Use it to trigger redstone mechanisms. Wooden and stone plates detect different kinds of entities.

item:minecraft:cherry_sapling.what: Cherry Sapling is a young plant that can grow into its corresponding tree.
item:minecraft:cherry_sapling.does: Plant it on suitable ground with enough space and appropriate conditions. Bone meal can speed up compatible growth.

item:minecraft:cherry_shelf.what: Cherry Shelf is a shelf block for displaying and storing items.
item:minecraft:cherry_shelf.does: Use it to organize items visibly on a wall or as part of a storage area.

item:minecraft:cherry_sign.what: Cherry Sign is a sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:cherry_sign.does: Place it on a suitable surface and enter a message. Use dye to recolor the text or glow ink to brighten it.

item:minecraft:cherry_slab.what: Cherry Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:cherry_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:cherry_stairs.what: Cherry Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:cherry_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:cherry_trapdoor.what: Cherry Trapdoor is a small hinged hatch.
item:minecraft:cherry_trapdoor.does: Use it for floor or ceiling openings and decorative details. Redstone can control it; iron trapdoors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:cherry_wood.what: Cherry Wood is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
item:minecraft:cherry_wood.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:chest.what: A chest is a container for storing items.
item:minecraft:chest.does: Open it to store or take items. Two compatible chests placed side by side can form a larger chest, and hoppers can move items into or out of it.

item:minecraft:chest_minecart.what: A chest minecart is a rail vehicle with item storage.
item:minecraft:chest_minecart.does: Use it to carry supplies along tracks and connect it to loading or unloading systems.

item:minecraft:chicken.what: Raw chicken is food obtained from chickens.
item:minecraft:chicken.does: Cook it before eating to avoid its chance of causing Hunger and to restore more hunger.

item:minecraft:chicken_spawn_egg.what: Chicken Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:chicken_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:chipped_anvil.what: A chipped anvil is an anvil that has already worn down.
item:minecraft:chipped_anvil.does: It still repairs, combines, and renames equipment, but is closer to breaking than an undamaged anvil.

item:minecraft:chiseled_bookshelf.what: A chiseled bookshelf stores individual books in visible slots.
item:minecraft:chiseled_bookshelf.does: Use it to store books and enchanted books. A comparator can detect which slot was last interacted with.

item:minecraft:chiseled_cinnabar.what: Chiseled cinnabar is a carved decorative cinnabar block.
item:minecraft:chiseled_cinnabar.does: Use it for patterned accents in cinnabar builds; it can be made from suitable cinnabar materials.

item:minecraft:chiseled_copper.what: Chiseled Copper is a copper building block.
item:minecraft:chiseled_copper.does: Use it for construction and decoration. Unwaxed copper can oxidize to a different color; honeycomb prevents further oxidation.

item:minecraft:chiseled_deepslate.what: Chiseled Deepslate is a decorative stone building material.
item:minecraft:chiseled_deepslate.does: Use it for contrasting walls, floors, columns, and other architectural details.

item:minecraft:chiseled_nether_bricks.what: Chiseled Nether Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:chiseled_nether_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:chiseled_polished_blackst.what: Chiseled polished blackstone is a carved decorative blackstone block.
item:minecraft:chiseled_polished_blackst.does: Use it for patterned details in dark stone construction.

item:minecraft:chiseled_quartz_block.what: Chiseled Quartz Block is a decorative stone building material.
item:minecraft:chiseled_quartz_block.does: Use it for contrasting walls, floors, columns, and other architectural details.

item:minecraft:chiseled_red_sandstone.what: Chiseled Red Sandstone is a decorative stone building material.
item:minecraft:chiseled_red_sandstone.does: Use it for contrasting walls, floors, columns, and other architectural details.

item:minecraft:chiseled_resin_bricks.what: Chiseled Resin Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:chiseled_resin_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:chiseled_sandstone.what: Chiseled Sandstone is a decorative stone building material.
item:minecraft:chiseled_sandstone.does: Use it for contrasting walls, floors, columns, and other architectural details.

item:minecraft:chiseled_stone_bricks.what: Chiseled Stone Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:chiseled_stone_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:chiseled_sulfur.what: Chiseled sulfur is a carved decorative sulfur block.
item:minecraft:chiseled_sulfur.does: Use it to add a patterned sulfur detail to builds, using the appropriate crafting or stonecutting recipe.

item:minecraft:chiseled_tuff.what: Chiseled Tuff is a decorative stone building material.
item:minecraft:chiseled_tuff.does: Use it for contrasting walls, floors, columns, and other architectural details.

item:minecraft:chiseled_tuff_bricks.what: Chiseled Tuff Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:chiseled_tuff_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:chorus_flower.what: A chorus flower is the growth tip used to grow chorus plants.
item:minecraft:chorus_flower.does: Plant it on suitable End stone with space for the plant to develop.

item:minecraft:chorus_fruit.what: Chorus fruit is food from chorus plants in the End.
item:minecraft:chorus_fruit.does: Eating it restores hunger and can teleport you a short distance. It can also be cooked into popped chorus fruit.

item:minecraft:chorus_plant.what: A chorus plant is a branching End plant.
item:minecraft:chorus_plant.does: Harvest it for chorus fruit and use chorus flowers to grow new plants on suitable End stone.

item:minecraft:cinnabar.what: Cinnabar is a mineral building block with several decorative forms.
item:minecraft:cinnabar.does: Use it in construction or turn it into compatible polished, brick, stair, slab, and wall forms.

item:minecraft:cinnabar_brick_slab.what: Cinnabar Brick Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:cinnabar_brick_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:cinnabar_brick_stairs.what: Cinnabar Brick Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:cinnabar_brick_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:cinnabar_brick_wall.what: Cinnabar Brick Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:cinnabar_brick_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:cinnabar_bricks.what: Cinnabar Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:cinnabar_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:cinnabar_slab.what: Cinnabar Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:cinnabar_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:cinnabar_stairs.what: Cinnabar Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:cinnabar_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:cinnabar_wall.what: Cinnabar Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:cinnabar_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:clay.what: Clay is a soft block often found in wet areas.
item:minecraft:clay.does: Break it for clay balls, or smelt the whole block into terracotta.

item:minecraft:clay_ball.what: A clay ball is a material obtained from clay.
item:minecraft:clay_ball.does: Smelt it into a brick, or combine clay balls into a clay block.

item:minecraft:clock.what: A clock shows the time of day in dimensions with a normal day-night cycle.
item:minecraft:clock.does: Use it to estimate daylight while underground in the Overworld.

item:minecraft:closed_eyeblossom.what: A closed eyeblossom is the daytime form of an eyeblossom flower.
item:minecraft:closed_eyeblossom.does: Use it for decoration and compatible dye or stew recipes. It opens at night under suitable conditions.

item:minecraft:clownfish.what: A tropical fish item is a caught fish used as food or an ingredient in certain interactions.
item:minecraft:clownfish.does: It is not the same as a live tropical fish in a bucket; axolotl breeding needs the bucket form.

item:minecraft:coal.what: Coal is a fuel and crafting material obtained from coal ore and certain other sources.
item:minecraft:coal.does: Use it in furnaces or to craft torches and coal blocks.

item:minecraft:coal_block.what: A coal block is compact coal storage and a strong furnace fuel.
item:minecraft:coal_block.does: Craft it from coal, use it as fuel, or convert it back into coal.

item:minecraft:coal_ore.what: Coal Ore is a rock containing coal.
item:minecraft:coal_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

item:minecraft:coarse_dirt.what: Coarse dirt is a soil block that does not turn grassy like ordinary dirt.
item:minecraft:coarse_dirt.does: Use it for paths and landscaping; a hoe can turn it back into dirt before further tilling.

item:minecraft:coast_armor_trim_smithing.what: Coast Armor Trim Smithing Template is a template used at a smithing table.
item:minecraft:coast_armor_trim_smithing.does: Combine it with compatible equipment and the required material. Upgrade templates improve equipment; armor-trim templates add a decorative pattern.

item:minecraft:cobbled_deepslate.what: Cobbled deepslate is the rough material obtained from mining deepslate.
item:minecraft:cobbled_deepslate.does: Use it in stone-tool recipes and to make dark building shapes and polished blocks.

item:minecraft:cobbled_deepslate_slab.what: Cobbled Deepslate Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:cobbled_deepslate_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:cobbled_deepslate_stairs.what: Cobbled Deepslate Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:cobbled_deepslate_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:cobbled_deepslate_wall.what: Cobbled Deepslate Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:cobbled_deepslate_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:cobblestone.what: Cobblestone is a rough stone building and crafting material.
item:minecraft:cobblestone.does: Use it for basic stone tools, furnaces, and construction, or smelt it into stone.

item:minecraft:cobblestone_slab.what: Cobblestone Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:cobblestone_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:cobblestone_wall.what: Cobblestone Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:cobblestone_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:cocoa_beans.what: Cocoa beans are a food-crafting and dye ingredient grown on jungle logs.
item:minecraft:cocoa_beans.does: Plant them on suitable jungle logs, harvest mature pods, and use the beans in cookies or compatible brown-dye recipes.

item:minecraft:cod.what: Raw cod is fish used as food and in compatible animal interactions.
item:minecraft:cod.does: Cook it for better food, or use it for suitable cat, ocelot, or dolphin interactions.

item:minecraft:cod_bucket.what: Cod Bucket is a bucket carrying its named contents.
item:minecraft:cod_bucket.does: Use it to place or release the contents in a suitable location. Filled fish and axolotl buckets let you transport the animal alive.

item:minecraft:cod_spawn_egg.what: Cod Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:cod_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:command_block.what: A command block runs commands when activated under its configured conditions.
item:minecraft:command_block.does: Use it for mapmaking and automation in worlds where command blocks and the required permissions are enabled.

item:minecraft:command_block_minecart.what: A command block minecart is a rail vehicle that can run commands.
item:minecraft:command_block_minecart.does: Use it in mapmaking systems with the appropriate permissions and powered activator-rail setup.

item:minecraft:comparator.what: A redstone comparator measures or compares redstone signal strengths.
item:minecraft:comparator.does: Use it to read container fullness, compare two signals, or subtract a side input from the main input.

item:minecraft:compass.what: A compass is a navigation item that normally points toward world spawn in the Overworld.
item:minecraft:compass.does: Use it for orientation or link one to a lodestone for a chosen destination.

item:minecraft:composter.what: A composter converts suitable plant and food items into bone meal.
item:minecraft:composter.does: Add compostable items until it fills, then collect the bone meal. It is also a farmer villager's job-site block.

item:minecraft:conduit.what: A conduit is an underwater block that can provide Conduit Power.
item:minecraft:conduit.does: Activate it with the correct prismarine-type frame and water arrangement to help nearby players breathe, see, and mine underwater.

item:minecraft:cooked_beef.does: Eat it to restore hunger. Cooking meat and potatoes generally makes them more useful as food; exact hunger restoration depends on the food.

item:minecraft:cooked_chicken.does: Eat it to restore hunger. Cooking meat and potatoes generally makes them more useful as food; exact hunger restoration depends on the food.

item:minecraft:cooked_cod.does: Eat it to restore hunger. Cooking meat and potatoes generally makes them more useful as food; exact hunger restoration depends on the food.

item:minecraft:cooked_fish.does: Eat it to restore hunger. Cooking meat and potatoes generally makes them more useful as food; exact hunger restoration depends on the food.

item:minecraft:cooked_mutton.does: Eat it to restore hunger. Cooking meat and potatoes generally makes them more useful as food; exact hunger restoration depends on the food.

item:minecraft:cooked_porkchop.does: Eat it to restore hunger. Cooking meat and potatoes generally makes them more useful as food; exact hunger restoration depends on the food.

item:minecraft:cooked_rabbit.does: Eat it to restore hunger. Cooking meat and potatoes generally makes them more useful as food; exact hunger restoration depends on the food.

item:minecraft:cooked_salmon.does: Eat it to restore hunger. Cooking meat and potatoes generally makes them more useful as food; exact hunger restoration depends on the food.

item:minecraft:cookie.what: A cookie is a food made from wheat and cocoa beans.
item:minecraft:cookie.does: Eat it to restore a little hunger. Never feed cookies to parrots because they are poisonous to them.

item:minecraft:copper_axe.what: Copper Axe is a tool for chopping wood and other axe-suitable blocks.
item:minecraft:copper_axe.does: Use it to harvest logs efficiently and strip suitable logs. It can also be used as a melee weapon.

item:minecraft:copper_bars.what: Copper Bars is a thin copper building decoration.
item:minecraft:copper_bars.does: Use it for grilles, hanging details, and copper-themed construction; copper oxidation changes compatible unwaxed forms.

item:minecraft:copper_block.what: Copper Block is a compact mineral or metal storage block.
item:minecraft:copper_block.does: Use it for construction or convert compatible storage blocks back into crafting materials. Some mineral blocks also work in beacon bases.

item:minecraft:copper_boots.what: Copper Boots is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:copper_boots.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:copper_bulb.what: Copper Bulb is a copper light block switched by redstone pulses.
item:minecraft:copper_bulb.does: A pulse changes its on/off state, and its oxidation affects its brightness. Waxing stops further oxidation.

item:minecraft:copper_chain.what: Copper Chain is a thin copper building decoration.
item:minecraft:copper_chain.does: Use it for grilles, hanging details, and copper-themed construction; copper oxidation changes compatible unwaxed forms.

item:minecraft:copper_chest.what: A copper chest is a storage block associated with copper golem item sorting.
item:minecraft:copper_chest.does: Use it as an input container for a suitable copper-golem sorting arrangement.

item:minecraft:copper_chestplate.what: Copper Chestplate is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:copper_chestplate.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:copper_door.what: Copper Door is an openable copper doorway or hatch.
item:minecraft:copper_door.does: Use it by hand or with redstone. Its appearance changes with oxidation unless it is waxed.

item:minecraft:copper_golem_spawn_egg.what: Copper Golem Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:copper_golem_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:copper_golem_statue.what: A copper golem statue is a decorative statue form associated with copper golems and oxidation.
item:minecraft:copper_golem_statue.does: Use it as decoration; waxing and oxidation affect copper forms and their interactions.

item:minecraft:copper_grate.what: Copper Grate is a copper mesh building block.
item:minecraft:copper_grate.does: Use it for grilles and decorative structures. Copper oxidation changes its appearance unless it is waxed.

item:minecraft:copper_helmet.what: Copper Helmet is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:copper_helmet.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:copper_hoe.what: Copper Hoe is a farming tool.
item:minecraft:copper_hoe.does: Use it to prepare suitable soil as farmland and to harvest certain plant-based blocks more efficiently.

item:minecraft:copper_horse_armor.what: Copper Horse Armor is protective equipment for a compatible horse.
item:minecraft:copper_horse_armor.does: Equip it on the horse to add armor protection. It is not player armor.

item:minecraft:copper_ingot.what: A copper ingot is a crafting material made from copper.
item:minecraft:copper_ingot.does: Use it for copper blocks, lightning rods, spyglasses, and other compatible recipes.

item:minecraft:copper_lantern.what: Copper Lantern is a copper-colored light source.
item:minecraft:copper_lantern.does: Use it for lighting and decorative copper-themed builds.

item:minecraft:copper_leggings.what: Copper Leggings is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:copper_leggings.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:copper_nautilus_armor.what: Copper Nautilus Armor is protective equipment for a compatible nautilus mount.
item:minecraft:copper_nautilus_armor.does: Equip it on a suitable nautilus rather than in a player armor slot.

item:minecraft:copper_nugget.what: Copper Nugget is a small metal crafting piece.
item:minecraft:copper_nugget.does: Combine compatible nuggets into an ingot or use them in recipes that need smaller metal pieces.

item:minecraft:copper_ore.what: Copper Ore is a rock containing copper.
item:minecraft:copper_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

item:minecraft:copper_pickaxe.what: Copper Pickaxe is a mining tool for rock and ore blocks.
item:minecraft:copper_pickaxe.does: Use it to mine compatible blocks faster and obtain their drops. Some ores require a stronger material tier; not every pickaxe can harvest everything.

item:minecraft:copper_shovel.what: Copper Shovel is a digging tool for loose ground materials.
item:minecraft:copper_shovel.does: Use it to dig dirt, sand, gravel, snow, and similar blocks faster, or make paths from suitable ground.

item:minecraft:copper_spear.what: Copper Spear is a reach-oriented melee weapon.
item:minecraft:copper_spear.does: Use it to attack from farther away than ordinary close-contact weapons; its attack behavior differs from a sword.

item:minecraft:copper_sword.what: Copper Sword is a melee weapon.
item:minecraft:copper_sword.does: Use it to attack targets at close range. Material and enchantments affect its damage and durability.

item:minecraft:copper_torch.what: Copper Torch is a copper-colored light source.
item:minecraft:copper_torch.does: Use it for lighting and decorative copper-themed builds.

item:minecraft:copper_trapdoor.what: Copper Trapdoor is an openable copper doorway or hatch.
item:minecraft:copper_trapdoor.does: Use it by hand or with redstone. Its appearance changes with oxidation unless it is waxed.

item:minecraft:cornflower.does: Plant it on suitable ground for decoration or use it in compatible dye, composting, or crafting recipes.

item:minecraft:cow_spawn_egg.what: Cow Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:cow_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:cracked_deepslate_bricks.what: Cracked Deepslate Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:cracked_deepslate_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:cracked_deepslate_tiles.what: Cracked Deepslate Tiles is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:cracked_deepslate_tiles.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:cracked_nether_bricks.what: Cracked Nether Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:cracked_nether_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:cracked_polished_blacksto.what: Cracked polished blackstone bricks are a weathered-looking masonry block.
item:minecraft:cracked_polished_blacksto.does: Use them to give blackstone walls and ruins a damaged appearance.

item:minecraft:cracked_stone_bricks.what: Cracked Stone Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:cracked_stone_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:crafter.what: A crafter is a crafting block that can make items automatically when triggered by redstone.
item:minecraft:crafter.does: Supply ingredients, configure its slots, and send a redstone pulse. It outputs a matching recipe, making it useful in automated crafting systems.

item:minecraft:crafting_table.what: A crafting table is a workstation for making items with larger recipes.
item:minecraft:crafting_table.does: Use its crafting menu and recipe book to combine ingredients into tools, equipment, and building materials.

item:minecraft:creaking_heart.what: A creaking heart is a special block linked to the creaking mob.
item:minecraft:creaking_heart.does: In a suitable pale-oak-log arrangement it can create a linked creaking. Removing the heart deals with its linked mob.

item:minecraft:creaking_spawn_egg.what: Creaking Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:creaking_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:creeper_banner_pattern.what: Creeper Banner Pattern is a special banner design item.
item:minecraft:creeper_banner_pattern.does: Use it in a loom with a banner and dye to apply the corresponding pattern.

item:minecraft:creeper_head.what: Creeper Head is a mob-head decoration.
item:minecraft:creeper_head.does: Display it, wear compatible heads, or use it in a matching recipe or mechanism. Wither skeleton skulls are also used in summoning the Wither.

item:minecraft:creeper_spawn_egg.what: Creeper Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:creeper_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:crimson_button.what: Crimson Button is a temporary redstone switch.
item:minecraft:crimson_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

item:minecraft:crimson_door.what: Crimson Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
item:minecraft:crimson_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:crimson_fence.what: Crimson Fence is a connecting fence block.
