item:minecraft:diorite_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:diorite_wall.what: Diorite Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:diorite_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:dirt.what: Dirt is a common soil block.
item:minecraft:dirt.does: Use it for building, landscaping, and as a base for many plants. A hoe can turn suitable dirt into farmland.

item:minecraft:dirt_with_roots.what: Rooted dirt is soil tangled with roots.
item:minecraft:dirt_with_roots.does: Use it in natural-looking ground; certain interactions remove its roots or grow hanging roots underneath.

item:minecraft:disc_fragment_5.what: A disc fragment is a piece used to assemble music disc 5.
item:minecraft:disc_fragment_5.does: Collect enough fragments and combine them in the matching recipe to make the disc.

item:minecraft:dispenser.what: A dispenser is a redstone-operated block that uses or fires compatible items.
item:minecraft:dispenser.does: A redstone pulse can make it shoot arrows, use buckets, or perform other item-specific actions. It behaves differently from a dropper.

item:minecraft:dolphin_spawn_egg.what: Dolphin Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:dolphin_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:donkey_spawn_egg.what: Donkey Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:donkey_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:dragon_breath.what: Dragon's breath is a brewing ingredient collected from an Ender Dragon effect cloud.
item:minecraft:dragon_breath.does: Use a glass bottle to collect it safely when possible, then brew compatible splash potions into lingering potions.

item:minecraft:dragon_egg.what: The dragon egg is a rare trophy associated with defeating the Ender Dragon.
item:minecraft:dragon_egg.does: Display it as a trophy; ordinary interaction makes it teleport rather than hatch into a dragon pet.

item:minecraft:dragon_head.what: Dragon Head is a mob-head decoration.
item:minecraft:dragon_head.does: Display it, wear compatible heads, or use it in a matching recipe or mechanism. Wither skeleton skulls are also used in summoning the Wither.

item:minecraft:dried_ghast.what: A dried ghast is a block that can develop into a ghastling when hydrated.
item:minecraft:dried_ghast.does: Place it in suitable water and give it time; the resulting ghastling can grow into a happy ghast.

item:minecraft:dried_kelp.does: Eat it to restore hunger. Cooking meat and potatoes generally makes them more useful as food; exact hunger restoration depends on the food.

item:minecraft:dried_kelp_block.what: A dried kelp block is compacted dried kelp and a furnace fuel.
item:minecraft:dried_kelp_block.does: Use it as fuel, for storage, or as a textured building block.

item:minecraft:dripstone_block.what: A dripstone block is a cave building block associated with pointed dripstone.
item:minecraft:dripstone_block.does: Use it for cave decoration and as part of compatible pointed-dripstone growth setups.

item:minecraft:dropper.what: A dropper is a redstone-operated block that moves items out of its inventory.
item:minecraft:dropper.does: A pulse pushes an item into a facing container, or drops it into the world when no suitable container is there.

item:minecraft:drowned_spawn_egg.what: Drowned Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:drowned_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:dune_armor_trim_smithing_.what: Dune Armor Trim Smithing Template is a template used at a smithing table.
item:minecraft:dune_armor_trim_smithing_.does: Combine it with compatible equipment and the required material. Upgrade templates improve equipment; armor-trim templates add a decorative pattern.

item:minecraft:echo_shard.what: An echo shard is a rare material associated with ancient-city loot.
item:minecraft:echo_shard.does: Use it to craft a recovery compass.

item:minecraft:egg.what: An egg is an item laid by chickens that can also be thrown as a projectile.
item:minecraft:egg.does: Use it in food recipes or throw it for a chance of hatching a chicken.

item:minecraft:elder_guardian_spawn_egg.what: Elder Guardian Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:elder_guardian_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:elytra.what: Elytra are wearable wings that let a player glide.
item:minecraft:elytra.does: Equip them in the chest slot and deploy them while airborne. Firework rockets without explosion effects are commonly used for propulsion.

item:minecraft:emerald.what: An emerald is the main currency for villager trading.
item:minecraft:emerald.does: Trade it with villagers and wandering traders, or use it in compatible crafting and beacon-base blocks.

item:minecraft:emerald_block.what: Emerald Block is a compact mineral or metal storage block.
item:minecraft:emerald_block.does: Use it for construction or convert compatible storage blocks back into crafting materials. Some mineral blocks also work in beacon bases.

item:minecraft:emerald_ore.what: Emerald Ore is a rock containing emerald.
item:minecraft:emerald_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

item:minecraft:empty_map.what: An empty map is an item used to start mapping an area.
item:minecraft:empty_map.does: Use it to create a map; locator-map behavior depends on the map type and how it was made.

item:minecraft:enchanted_book.what: An enchanted book stores one or more enchantments.
item:minecraft:enchanted_book.does: Use it at an anvil to apply compatible enchantments to equipment, paying the required experience cost.

item:minecraft:enchanted_golden_apple.what: An enchanted golden apple is a rare food with strong protective effects.
item:minecraft:enchanted_golden_apple.does: Eat it for powerful temporary benefits. It is not normally craftable in modern Bedrock Survival.

item:minecraft:enchanting_table.what: An enchanting table adds enchantments to compatible equipment.
item:minecraft:enchanting_table.does: Use lapis lazuli and experience levels. Properly placed bookshelves improve the available enchantment levels.

item:minecraft:end_brick_stairs.what: End Brick Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:end_brick_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:end_bricks.what: End Bricks is a decorative stone building material.
item:minecraft:end_bricks.does: Use it for contrasting walls, floors, columns, and other architectural details.

item:minecraft:end_crystal.what: An End crystal is an explosive crystal that can heal the Ender Dragon.
item:minecraft:end_crystal.does: It is used in the dragon-respawning arrangement. Breaking or attacking it causes a dangerous explosion.

item:minecraft:end_portal_frame.what: An End portal frame is a special block surrounding an End portal.
item:minecraft:end_portal_frame.does: Find the correct frame arrangement and add the required eyes of ender to activate it. Ordinary Survival players cannot harvest the frame block.

item:minecraft:end_rod.what: An End rod is a slim decorative light source.
item:minecraft:end_rod.does: Attach it to suitable surfaces to illuminate builds and make thin supports or details.

item:minecraft:end_stone.what: End stone is the pale rock that forms much of the End.
item:minecraft:end_stone.does: Use it for construction and to craft End stone bricks.

item:minecraft:end_stone_brick_slab.what: End Stone Brick Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:end_stone_brick_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:end_stone_brick_wall.what: End Stone Brick Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:end_stone_brick_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:ender_chest.what: An ender chest accesses storage that belongs to each player, rather than to that particular chest.
item:minecraft:ender_chest.does: Your items are accessible from other ender chests, including across dimensions. Another player opening the same chest sees their own items.

item:minecraft:ender_dragon_spawn_egg.what: Ender Dragon Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:ender_dragon_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:ender_eye.what: An eye of ender is an item used to locate and activate the route to the End.
item:minecraft:ender_eye.does: Throw it to help locate a stronghold, or place it into an End portal frame. Thrown eyes can break.

item:minecraft:ender_pearl.what: An ender pearl is a throwable teleportation item.
item:minecraft:ender_pearl.does: Throw it to teleport to its landing location, usually taking teleportation damage. It is also used to craft eyes of ender.

item:minecraft:enderman_spawn_egg.what: Enderman Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:enderman_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:endermite_spawn_egg.what: Endermite Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:endermite_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:evoker_spawn_egg.what: Evoker Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:evoker_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:experience_bottle.what: A bottle o' enchanting is a throwable item that releases experience.
item:minecraft:experience_bottle.does: Throw it to create experience orbs for levels or suitable Mending equipment.

item:minecraft:explorer_pottery_sherd.what: Explorer Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:explorer_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:exposed_chiseled_copper.what: Exposed Chiseled Copper is a copper building block.
item:minecraft:exposed_chiseled_copper.does: Use it for construction and decoration. Unwaxed copper can oxidize to a different color; honeycomb prevents further oxidation.

item:minecraft:exposed_copper.what: Exposed Copper is a copper building block.
item:minecraft:exposed_copper.does: Use it for construction and decoration. Unwaxed copper can oxidize to a different color; honeycomb prevents further oxidation.

item:minecraft:exposed_copper_bars.what: Exposed Copper Bars is a thin copper building decoration.
item:minecraft:exposed_copper_bars.does: Use it for grilles, hanging details, and copper-themed construction; copper oxidation changes compatible unwaxed forms.

item:minecraft:exposed_copper_bulb.what: Exposed Copper Bulb is a copper light block switched by redstone pulses.
item:minecraft:exposed_copper_bulb.does: A pulse changes its on/off state, and its oxidation affects its brightness. Waxing stops further oxidation.

item:minecraft:exposed_copper_chain.what: Exposed Copper Chain is a thin copper building decoration.
item:minecraft:exposed_copper_chain.does: Use it for grilles, hanging details, and copper-themed construction; copper oxidation changes compatible unwaxed forms.

item:minecraft:exposed_copper_chest.what: Exposed Copper Chest is a copper storage container.
item:minecraft:exposed_copper_chest.does: Store items in it or use it as part of a suitable copper-golem item-sorting arrangement.

item:minecraft:exposed_copper_door.what: Exposed Copper Door is an openable copper doorway or hatch.
item:minecraft:exposed_copper_door.does: Use it by hand or with redstone. Its appearance changes with oxidation unless it is waxed.

item:minecraft:exposed_copper_golem_stat.what: Exposed Copper Golem Statue is a copper golem statue decoration.
item:minecraft:exposed_copper_golem_stat.does: Use it for decoration; its copper condition controls compatible oxidation and waxing interactions.

item:minecraft:exposed_copper_grate.what: Exposed Copper Grate is a copper mesh building block.
item:minecraft:exposed_copper_grate.does: Use it for grilles and decorative structures. Copper oxidation changes its appearance unless it is waxed.

item:minecraft:exposed_copper_lantern.what: Exposed Copper Lantern is a copper-colored light source.
item:minecraft:exposed_copper_lantern.does: Use it for lighting and decorative copper-themed builds.

item:minecraft:exposed_copper_trapdoor.what: Exposed Copper Trapdoor is an openable copper doorway or hatch.
item:minecraft:exposed_copper_trapdoor.does: Use it by hand or with redstone. Its appearance changes with oxidation unless it is waxed.

item:minecraft:exposed_cut_copper.what: Exposed Cut Copper is a copper building block.
item:minecraft:exposed_cut_copper.does: Use it for construction and decoration. Unwaxed copper can oxidize to a different color; honeycomb prevents further oxidation.

item:minecraft:exposed_cut_copper_slab.what: Exposed Cut Copper Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:exposed_cut_copper_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:exposed_cut_copper_stairs.what: Exposed Cut Copper Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:exposed_cut_copper_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:exposed_lightning_rod.what: Exposed Lightning Rod is a copper lightning rod.
item:minecraft:exposed_lightning_rod.does: Use it to attract nearby lightning strikes toward a chosen location and obtain a short redstone signal when struck.

item:minecraft:eye_armor_trim_smithing_t.what: Eye Armor Trim Smithing Template is a template used at a smithing table.
item:minecraft:eye_armor_trim_smithing_t.does: Combine it with compatible equipment and the required material. Upgrade templates improve equipment; armor-trim templates add a decorative pattern.

item:minecraft:farmland.what: Farmland is soil prepared with a hoe for growing crops.
item:minecraft:farmland.does: Plant suitable seeds or crops on it and keep water nearby to hydrate it. Trampling can turn it back into dirt.

item:minecraft:feather.what: A feather is a lightweight crafting material commonly obtained from chickens.
item:minecraft:feather.does: Use it for arrows, books and quills, and compatible recipes.

item:minecraft:fence_gate.what: An oak fence gate is an openable entrance for a fence enclosure.
item:minecraft:fence_gate.does: Open it by hand or redstone while keeping a fence-style barrier when closed.

item:minecraft:fermented_spider_eye.what: A fermented spider eye is a brewing ingredient.
item:minecraft:fermented_spider_eye.does: Use it to corrupt certain potions into different effects.

item:minecraft:fern.what: Fern is decorative ground or hanging vegetation.
item:minecraft:fern.does: Use it for natural landscaping on suitable surfaces. Harvesting and planting requirements depend on the plant.

item:minecraft:field_masoned_banner_patt.what: Field Masoned Banner Pattern is a special banner design item.
item:minecraft:field_masoned_banner_patt.does: Use it in a loom with a banner and dye to apply the corresponding pattern.

item:minecraft:filled_map.what: A filled map records explored terrain in a mapped area.
item:minecraft:filled_map.does: Hold it while exploring to fill it in, or display it in an item frame.

item:minecraft:fire_charge.what: A fire charge is a consumable fire-starting ingredient or projectile.
item:minecraft:fire_charge.does: Use it to ignite suitable targets or load it into a dispenser; it is also used in fireworks crafting.

item:minecraft:fire_coral.what: Fire Coral is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
item:minecraft:fire_coral.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

item:minecraft:fire_coral_block.what: Fire Coral Block is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
item:minecraft:fire_coral_block.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

item:minecraft:fire_coral_fan.what: Fire Coral Fan is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
item:minecraft:fire_coral_fan.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

item:minecraft:firefly_bush.what: A firefly bush is a decorative bush associated with firefly-like ambient particles.
item:minecraft:firefly_bush.does: Use it to add natural atmosphere to a garden or waterside build.

item:minecraft:firework_rocket.what: A firework rocket is a launched firework entity.
item:minecraft:firework_rocket.does: It can display crafted firework effects or propel a player gliding with elytra, depending on how it was made and used.

item:minecraft:firework_star.what: A firework star defines the explosion effect of a crafted firework.
item:minecraft:firework_star.does: Combine it into a firework-rocket recipe to give the rocket its decorative burst.

item:minecraft:fish.what: Raw cod is fish used as food and in compatible animal interactions.
item:minecraft:fish.does: Cook it for better food, or use it for suitable cat, ocelot, or dolphin interactions.

item:minecraft:fishing_rod.what: A fishing rod is a tool for catching fish and other fishing loot.
item:minecraft:fishing_rod.does: Cast its hook into suitable water and reel in when a fish bites. It can also hook certain entities.

item:minecraft:fletching_table.what: A fletching table is a job-site block for fletcher villagers.
item:minecraft:fletching_table.does: Place it for an eligible unemployed villager to become a fletcher. It does not provide a normal player crafting interface.

item:minecraft:flint.what: Flint is a material that can be obtained when gravel breaks.
item:minecraft:flint.does: Use it to craft arrows, flint and steel, and other compatible items.

item:minecraft:flint_and_steel.what: Flint and steel is a tool that starts fire.
item:minecraft:flint_and_steel.does: Use it to ignite suitable surfaces, activate Nether portals, or light TNT. Keep it away from flammable builds.

item:minecraft:flow_armor_trim_smithing_.what: Flow Armor Trim Smithing Template is a template used at a smithing table.
item:minecraft:flow_armor_trim_smithing_.does: Combine it with compatible equipment and the required material. Upgrade templates improve equipment; armor-trim templates add a decorative pattern.

item:minecraft:flow_banner_pattern.what: Flow Banner Pattern is a special banner design item.
item:minecraft:flow_banner_pattern.does: Use it in a loom with a banner and dye to apply the corresponding pattern.

item:minecraft:flow_pottery_sherd.what: Flow Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:flow_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:flower_banner_pattern.what: Flower Banner Pattern is a special banner design item.
item:minecraft:flower_banner_pattern.does: Use it in a loom with a banner and dye to apply the corresponding pattern.

item:minecraft:flower_pot.what: A flower pot holds a small plant for decoration.
item:minecraft:flower_pot.does: Place a compatible flower, sapling, fungus, or other small plant in it.

item:minecraft:flowering_azalea.what: Flowering Azalea is a small azalea plant.
item:minecraft:flowering_azalea.does: Use it for garden decoration or grow it with bone meal under suitable conditions to form an azalea tree.

item:minecraft:fox_spawn_egg.what: Fox Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:fox_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:frame.what: An item frame is a display for an item or map.
item:minecraft:frame.does: Attach it to a suitable surface and place an item inside, then rotate the displayed item as needed.

item:minecraft:friend_pottery_sherd.what: Friend Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:friend_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:frog_spawn.what: Frogspawn is a floating cluster of frog eggs.
item:minecraft:frog_spawn.does: It develops into tadpoles in suitable water after frogs breed.

item:minecraft:frog_spawn_egg.what: Frog Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:frog_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:frosted_ice.what: Frosted ice is temporary ice created by the Frost Walker enchantment.
item:minecraft:frosted_ice.does: Walk across suitable water while wearing the enchantment to create it; it eventually breaks or melts away rather than becoming permanent packed ice.

item:minecraft:furnace.what: A furnace is a workstation that smelts or cooks items using fuel.
item:minecraft:furnace.does: Put a suitable item in its input and fuel in its fuel slot to make products such as iron ingots, glass, or cooked food.

item:minecraft:ghast_spawn_egg.what: Ghast Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:ghast_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:ghast_tear.what: A ghast tear is a material dropped by ghasts.
item:minecraft:ghast_tear.does: Use it in Regeneration brewing and End crystal crafting.

item:minecraft:gilded_blackstone.what: Gilded blackstone is a dark Nether block with gold-colored inclusions.
item:minecraft:gilded_blackstone.does: Use it in decoration; mining it can yield gold nuggets under suitable drop conditions.

item:minecraft:glass.what: Glass is a transparent building block made by smelting sand.
item:minecraft:glass.does: Use it for windows and enclosures. Harvesting the intact block normally requires Silk Touch.

item:minecraft:glass_bottle.what: A glass bottle is a container used for brewing and collecting certain liquids.
item:minecraft:glass_bottle.does: Fill it with water for brewing, collect honey from a full hive, or use it for other compatible interactions.

item:minecraft:glass_pane.what: A glass pane is a thin transparent building block.
item:minecraft:glass_pane.does: Use connected panes for windows and dividers that take up less space than full glass blocks.

item:minecraft:glistering_melon_slice.what: A glistering melon slice is a brewing ingredient made with melon and gold.
item:minecraft:glistering_melon_slice.does: Use it for compatible Healing potions. It is not eaten like an ordinary melon slice.

item:minecraft:globe_banner_pattern.what: Globe Banner Pattern is a special banner design item.
item:minecraft:globe_banner_pattern.does: Use it in a loom with a banner and dye to apply the corresponding pattern.

item:minecraft:glow_berries.what: Glow berries are food that can grow on hanging cave vines.
item:minecraft:glow_berries.does: Use them for eating, growing cave vines, and natural-looking light sources.

item:minecraft:glow_frame.what: A glow item frame is an item frame whose displayed contents appear bright.
item:minecraft:glow_frame.does: Use it to display items or maps clearly in dark rooms. It does not light nearby blocks like a lamp.

item:minecraft:glow_ink_sac.what: A glow ink sac is a material obtained from glow squid.
item:minecraft:glow_ink_sac.does: Use it to brighten sign writing or craft glow item frames. It does not turn an ordinary block into a light source.

item:minecraft:glow_lichen.what: Glow lichen is a thin plant-like growth that emits light.
item:minecraft:glow_lichen.does: Place it on suitable surfaces for subtle natural lighting and spread it with bone meal.

item:minecraft:glow_squid_spawn_egg.what: Glow Squid Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:glow_squid_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:glowstone.what: Glowstone is a bright block associated with the Nether.
item:minecraft:glowstone.does: Use it for lighting or break it to obtain glowstone dust.

item:minecraft:glowstone_dust.what: Glowstone dust is a crafting and brewing material.
item:minecraft:glowstone_dust.does: Use it to make glowstone or strengthen certain potions, usually at the cost of duration.

item:minecraft:goat_horn.what: A goat horn is a reusable musical item.
item:minecraft:goat_horn.does: Use it to play its horn sound; different horns have different calls.

item:minecraft:goat_spawn_egg.what: Goat Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:goat_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:gold_block.what: Gold Block is a compact mineral or metal storage block.
item:minecraft:gold_block.does: Use it for construction or convert compatible storage blocks back into crafting materials. Some mineral blocks also work in beacon bases.

item:minecraft:gold_ingot.what: A gold ingot is a metal crafting and trading material.
item:minecraft:gold_ingot.does: Use it in equipment and crafting, or barter with piglins under suitable conditions.

item:minecraft:gold_nugget.what: Gold Nugget is a small metal crafting piece.
item:minecraft:gold_nugget.does: Combine compatible nuggets into an ingot or use them in recipes that need smaller metal pieces.

item:minecraft:gold_ore.what: Gold Ore is a rock containing gold.
item:minecraft:gold_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

item:minecraft:golden_apple.what: A golden apple is a food that grants beneficial effects.
item:minecraft:golden_apple.does: Eat it for recovery and absorption, or use it as part of curing a suitably weakened zombie villager.

item:minecraft:golden_axe.what: Golden Axe is a tool for chopping wood and other axe-suitable blocks.
item:minecraft:golden_axe.does: Use it to harvest logs efficiently and strip suitable logs. It can also be used as a melee weapon.

item:minecraft:golden_boots.what: Golden Boots is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:golden_boots.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:golden_carrot.what: A golden carrot is a high-saturation food and a brewing ingredient.
item:minecraft:golden_carrot.does: Eat it for long-lasting hunger recovery or use it in compatible brewing and horse-breeding interactions.

item:minecraft:golden_chestplate.what: Golden Chestplate is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:golden_chestplate.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:golden_dandelion.what: A golden dandelion is a special flower used in baby-animal growth interactions.
item:minecraft:golden_dandelion.does: Use it on supported baby animals to control their growth; support depends on the animal.

item:minecraft:golden_helmet.what: Golden Helmet is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:golden_helmet.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:golden_hoe.what: Golden Hoe is a farming tool.
item:minecraft:golden_hoe.does: Use it to prepare suitable soil as farmland and to harvest certain plant-based blocks more efficiently.

item:minecraft:golden_horse_armor.what: Golden Horse Armor is protective equipment for a compatible horse.
item:minecraft:golden_horse_armor.does: Equip it on the horse to add armor protection. It is not player armor.

item:minecraft:golden_leggings.what: Golden Leggings is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:golden_leggings.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:golden_spear.what: Golden Spear is a reach-oriented melee weapon.
item:minecraft:golden_spear.does: Use it to attack from farther away than ordinary close-contact weapons; its attack behavior differs from a sword.

item:minecraft:golden_sword.what: Golden Sword is a melee weapon.
item:minecraft:golden_sword.does: Use it to attack targets at close range. Material and enchantments affect its damage and durability.

item:minecraft:granite.what: Granite is a decorative stone building material.

item:minecraft:granite_slab.what: Granite Slab is a half-height building block.

item:minecraft:granite_stairs.what: Granite Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:granite_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:granite_wall.what: Granite Wall is a connecting wall block.

item:minecraft:grass_block.what: A grass block is dirt with a grassy surface.

item:minecraft:grass_path.what: A dirt path is a lowered soil block used for walkways.
item:minecraft:grass_path.does: Use a shovel on suitable soil to make paths through gardens and villages.

item:minecraft:gravel.what: Gravel is a loose block that falls when unsupported.

item:minecraft:gray_concrete_stairs.what: Gray Concrete Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.

item:minecraft:gray_cushion.what: Gray Cushion is a colored seat decoration.

item:minecraft:gray_dye.what: Gray Dye is a coloring ingredient.

item:minecraft:gray_glazed_terracotta.what: Gray Glazed Terracotta is a patterned ceramic building block.

item:minecraft:gray_shulker_box.what: Gray Shulker Box is a portable storage container.
item:minecraft:gray_shulker_box.does: Store items inside, break the box, and carry it with its contents preserved. You cannot put a shulker box inside another shulker box.

item:minecraft:gray_stained_glass.what: Gray Stained Glass is a colored transparent building block.

item:minecraft:grindstone.does: Use it to combine compatible equipment or recover some experience from unwanted enchantments. It does not remove curses and is a weaponsmith villager's job-site block.

item:minecraft:guardian_spawn_egg.what: Guardian Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:guardian_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:gunpowder.what: Gunpowder is a crafting and brewing ingredient.
item:minecraft:gunpowder.does: Use it for TNT and fireworks, or to turn suitable potions into splash potions at a brewing stand.

item:minecraft:guster_banner_pattern.what: Guster Banner Pattern is a special banner design item.
item:minecraft:guster_banner_pattern.does: Use it in a loom with a banner and dye to apply the corresponding pattern.

item:minecraft:guster_pottery_sherd.what: Guster Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:guster_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:hanging_roots.what: Hanging Roots is decorative ground or hanging vegetation.
item:minecraft:hanging_roots.does: Use it for natural landscaping on suitable surfaces. Harvesting and planting requirements depend on the plant.

item:minecraft:happy_ghast_spawn_egg.what: Happy Ghast Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:happy_ghast_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:hardened_clay.what: Terracotta is hardened clay used as a building material.
item:minecraft:hardened_clay.does: Use it in construction or dye it to create colored terracotta.

item:minecraft:hay_block.what: A hay bale is a block of compacted wheat.
item:minecraft:hay_block.does: Use it for storage, decoration, certain animal interactions, or to reduce fall damage when landing on it.

item:minecraft:heart_of_the_sea.what: A heart of the sea is a rare material found in buried treasure.
item:minecraft:heart_of_the_sea.does: Combine it with nautilus shells to craft a conduit.

item:minecraft:heart_pottery_sherd.what: Heart Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:heart_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:heartbreak_pottery_sherd.what: Heartbreak Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:heartbreak_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:heavy_core.what: A heavy core is a rare component used to make a mace.
item:minecraft:heavy_core.does: Combine it with a breeze rod in the appropriate recipe.

item:minecraft:heavy_weighted_pressure_p.what: A heavy weighted pressure plate is an iron plate that measures how many entities are on it.
item:minecraft:heavy_weighted_pressure_p.does: It produces a redstone signal whose strength increases with larger groups of entities. Its weighting differs from the light weighted plate.

item:minecraft:hoglin_spawn_egg.what: Hoglin Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:hoglin_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:honey_block.what: A honey block is a sticky block that slows movement and can be pushed by pistons.
item:minecraft:honey_block.does: Use it in moving machines and sliding mechanisms; it does not stick to slime blocks.

item:minecraft:honey_bottle.what: A honey bottle is a drink collected from a full bee nest or hive.
item:minecraft:honey_bottle.does: Drink it to restore hunger and remove poison, or use it in compatible crafting recipes.

item:minecraft:honeycomb.what: Honeycomb is a material harvested from a full bee nest or beehive.
item:minecraft:honeycomb.does: Use it to craft beehives and candles or wax compatible copper blocks to stop further oxidation.

item:minecraft:honeycomb_block.what: A honeycomb block is a decorative block made from honeycomb.
item:minecraft:honeycomb_block.does: Use it for golden-orange textures in builds. It does not produce honey like a hive.

item:minecraft:hopper.what: A hopper is a block that collects and moves items automatically.
item:minecraft:hopper.does: It picks up dropped items above it, pulls items from a container above it, and transfers items into the container its spout points toward. Power it with redstone to lock its transfers. It is useful for automatic storage, furnaces, and collection systems.

item:minecraft:hopper_minecart.what: A hopper minecart is a rail vehicle that collects items.
item:minecraft:hopper_minecart.does: Use it to gather dropped items and move them along tracks, often underneath farms. A powered activator rail changes its collection state.

item:minecraft:horn_coral.what: Horn Coral is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
item:minecraft:horn_coral.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

item:minecraft:horn_coral_block.what: Horn Coral Block is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
item:minecraft:horn_coral_block.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

item:minecraft:horn_coral_fan.what: Horn Coral Fan is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
item:minecraft:horn_coral_fan.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

item:minecraft:howl_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:husk_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:ice.does: Use it for transport and cold-themed builds. Ordinary ice can melt under suitable conditions.

item:minecraft:infested_chiseled_stone_b.does: Disturbing it can release hostile silverfish, so take care when mining suspicious stone in affected areas.

item:minecraft:infested_cobblestone.what: Infested Cobblestone is a block containing silverfish.
item:minecraft:infested_cobblestone.does: Disturbing it can release hostile silverfish, so take care when mining suspicious stone in affected areas.

item:minecraft:ink_sac.what: An ink sac is a material commonly obtained from squid.

item:minecraft:iron_bars.does: Use it for barriers, supports, hanging details, and decorative metalwork.

item:minecraft:iron_golem_spawn_egg.what: Iron Golem Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:iron_golem_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:iron_helmet.what: Iron Helmet is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:iron_helmet.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:iron_hoe.what: Iron Hoe is a farming tool.
item:minecraft:iron_hoe.does: Use it to prepare suitable soil as farmland and to harvest certain plant-based blocks more efficiently.

item:minecraft:iron_horse_armor.what: Iron Horse Armor is protective equipment for a compatible horse.
item:minecraft:iron_horse_armor.does: Equip it on the horse to add armor protection. It is not player armor.

item:minecraft:iron_ingot.what: An iron ingot is a metal crafting material.
item:minecraft:iron_ingot.does: Use it for iron tools, armor, buckets, hoppers, rails, and many machines.

item:minecraft:iron_nugget.does: Combine compatible nuggets into an ingot or use them in recipes that need smaller metal pieces.

item:minecraft:iron_ore.what: Iron Ore is a rock containing iron.
item:minecraft:iron_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

item:minecraft:iron_trapdoor.does: Use it for floor or ceiling openings and decorative details. Redstone can control it; iron trapdoors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:jigsaw.what: A jigsaw block is a world-generation and structure-connection tool.
item:minecraft:jigsaw.does: It is used in structure systems and mapmaking, rather than ordinary Survival crafting.

item:minecraft:jukebox.what: A jukebox is a block that plays music discs.
item:minecraft:jukebox.does: Insert a compatible disc to play its music, then remove it when you want to change the track.

item:minecraft:jungle_boat.what: Jungle Boat is a rideable water vehicle.
item:minecraft:jungle_boat.does: Place it on water to carry players or compatible passengers along rivers and across other water routes.

item:minecraft:jungle_button.what: Jungle Button is a temporary redstone switch.
item:minecraft:jungle_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

item:minecraft:jungle_chest_boat.what: Jungle Chest Boat is a water vehicle with built-in storage.
item:minecraft:jungle_chest_boat.does: Use it to travel across water while carrying items in its chest. The storage replaces an extra passenger seat.

item:minecraft:jungle_door.what: Jungle Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
item:minecraft:jungle_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:jungle_fence.what: Jungle Fence is a connecting fence block.
item:minecraft:jungle_fence.does: Use it to enclose animals or mark boundaries. Many mobs cannot jump over an ordinary fence, and leads can be tied to suitable fence posts.

item:minecraft:jungle_fence_gate.what: Jungle Fence Gate is an openable gate that connects to fences.
item:minecraft:jungle_fence_gate.does: Use it to enter an enclosure while keeping a fence-style barrier when closed. It can be controlled by hand or redstone.

item:minecraft:jungle_hanging_sign.what: Jungle Hanging Sign is a suspended sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:jungle_hanging_sign.does: Hang it from a suitable support and write a message. Dye changes the text color and glow ink can make the writing brighter.

item:minecraft:jungle_leaves.what: Jungle Leaves is foliage used by a tree or large plant.
item:minecraft:jungle_leaves.does: Use it for landscaping and hedges. Harvesting the intact block normally needs shears or Silk Touch; some leaves can drop plant materials when they decay.

item:minecraft:jungle_log.what: Jungle Log is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
item:minecraft:jungle_log.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:jungle_planks.what: Jungle Planks is a processed wood building material.
item:minecraft:jungle_planks.does: Use it for construction and compatible recipes such as crafting tables, sticks, doors, and wooden components.

item:minecraft:jungle_pressure_plate.what: Jungle Pressure Plate is a switch activated when suitable entities stand on it.
item:minecraft:jungle_pressure_plate.does: Use it to trigger redstone mechanisms. Wooden and stone plates detect different kinds of entities.

item:minecraft:jungle_sapling.what: Jungle Sapling is a young plant that can grow into its corresponding tree.
item:minecraft:jungle_sapling.does: Plant it on suitable ground with enough space and appropriate conditions. Bone meal can speed up compatible growth.

item:minecraft:jungle_shelf.what: Jungle Shelf is a shelf block for displaying and storing items.
item:minecraft:jungle_shelf.does: Use it to organize items visibly on a wall or as part of a storage area.

item:minecraft:jungle_sign.what: Jungle Sign is a sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:jungle_sign.does: Place it on a suitable surface and enter a message. Use dye to recolor the text or glow ink to brighten it.

item:minecraft:jungle_slab.what: Jungle Slab is a half-height building block.

item:minecraft:jungle_stairs.what: Jungle Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:jungle_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:kelp.does: Grow it in water, cook it into dried kelp, or use compatible kelp products as food and fuel.

item:minecraft:mangrove_boat.what: Mangrove Boat is a rideable water vehicle.
item:minecraft:mangrove_boat.does: Place it on water to carry players or compatible passengers along rivers and across other water routes.

item:minecraft:mangrove_button.what: Mangrove Button is a temporary redstone switch.
item:minecraft:mangrove_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

item:minecraft:mangrove_chest_boat.what: Mangrove Chest Boat is a water vehicle with built-in storage.
item:minecraft:mangrove_chest_boat.does: Use it to travel across water while carrying items in its chest. The storage replaces an extra passenger seat.

item:minecraft:mangrove_door.what: Mangrove Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
item:minecraft:mangrove_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:mangrove_fence.what: Mangrove Fence is a connecting fence block.
item:minecraft:mangrove_fence.does: Use it to enclose animals or mark boundaries. Many mobs cannot jump over an ordinary fence, and leads can be tied to suitable fence posts.

item:minecraft:mangrove_fence_gate.what: Mangrove Fence Gate is an openable gate that connects to fences.
item:minecraft:mangrove_fence_gate.does: Use it to enter an enclosure while keeping a fence-style barrier when closed. It can be controlled by hand or redstone.

item:minecraft:mangrove_hanging_sign.what: Mangrove Hanging Sign is a suspended sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:mangrove_hanging_sign.does: Hang it from a suitable support and write a message. Dye changes the text color and glow ink can make the writing brighter.

item:minecraft:mangrove_leaves.what: Mangrove Leaves is foliage used by a tree or large plant.
item:minecraft:mangrove_leaves.does: Use it for landscaping and hedges. Harvesting the intact block normally needs shears or Silk Touch; some leaves can drop plant materials when they decay.

item:minecraft:mangrove_log.what: Mangrove Log is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
item:minecraft:mangrove_log.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:mangrove_planks.what: Mangrove Planks is a processed wood building material.
item:minecraft:mangrove_planks.does: Use it for construction and compatible recipes such as crafting tables, sticks, doors, and wooden components.

item:minecraft:mangrove_pressure_plate.what: Mangrove Pressure Plate is a switch activated when suitable entities stand on it.
item:minecraft:mangrove_pressure_plate.does: Use it to trigger redstone mechanisms. Wooden and stone plates detect different kinds of entities.

item:minecraft:mangrove_propagule.what: A mangrove propagule is a young mangrove plant that can grow into a mangrove tree.
item:minecraft:mangrove_propagule.does: Plant it on suitable ground, including suitable underwater locations, to grow mangroves.

item:minecraft:mangrove_roots.what: Mangrove roots are tangled blocks found around mangrove trees.
item:minecraft:mangrove_roots.does: Use them for root-like decorations and natural swamp builds.

item:minecraft:mangrove_shelf.what: Mangrove Shelf is a shelf block for displaying and storing items.
item:minecraft:mangrove_shelf.does: Use it to organize items visibly on a wall or as part of a storage area.

item:minecraft:mangrove_sign.what: Mangrove Sign is a sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:mangrove_sign.does: Place it on a suitable surface and enter a message. Use dye to recolor the text or glow ink to brighten it.

item:minecraft:mangrove_slab.what: Mangrove Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:mangrove_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:mangrove_stairs.what: Mangrove Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:mangrove_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:mangrove_trapdoor.what: Mangrove Trapdoor is a small hinged hatch.
item:minecraft:mangrove_trapdoor.does: Use it for floor or ceiling openings and decorative details. Redstone can control it; iron trapdoors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:mangrove_wood.what: Mangrove Wood is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
item:minecraft:mangrove_wood.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:medium_amethyst_bud.what: Medium Amethyst Bud is a developing amethyst crystal.
item:minecraft:medium_amethyst_bud.does: Leave it on budding amethyst so it can continue growing into a cluster. An immature bud is not a full-grown shard harvest.

item:minecraft:melon.what: A melon slice is food obtained from melon blocks.
item:minecraft:melon.does: Eat it, turn it into melon seeds, or use it in compatible glistering-melon crafting.

item:minecraft:melon_block.what: A melon is a farmable fruit block.
item:minecraft:melon_block.does: Break it for melon slices or grow more melons using melon seeds and stems.

item:minecraft:melon_seeds.what: Melon seeds grow into melon stems on farmland.
item:minecraft:melon_seeds.does: Give the stem a suitable adjacent space to produce melon blocks.

item:minecraft:melon_slice.what: A melon slice is food obtained from melon blocks.
item:minecraft:melon_slice.does: Eat it, turn it into melon seeds, or use it in compatible glistering-melon crafting.

item:minecraft:milk_bucket.what: A milk bucket contains milk collected from a suitable animal.
item:minecraft:milk_bucket.does: Drink it to remove status effects, including beneficial ones, or use it in recipes such as cake.

item:minecraft:minecart.what: A minecart is a rail vehicle for transporting entities.
item:minecraft:minecart.does: Place it on rails and use powered track or other mechanisms to move riders along a route.

item:minecraft:miner_pottery_sherd.what: Miner Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:miner_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:mob_spawner.what: A monster spawner is a cage-like block that creates its configured mob when spawning conditions are met.
item:minecraft:mob_spawner.does: Use care around it or build a farm that respects its activation distance, light requirements, and nearby-mob limits.

item:minecraft:mojang_banner_pattern.what: Mojang Banner Pattern is a special banner design item.
item:minecraft:mojang_banner_pattern.does: Use it in a loom with a banner and dye to apply the corresponding pattern.

item:minecraft:mooshroom_spawn_egg.what: Mooshroom Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:mooshroom_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:moss_block.what: A moss block is a green plant-covered ground block.
item:minecraft:moss_block.does: Use bone meal to spread moss over suitable nearby blocks and create natural ground cover.

item:minecraft:moss_carpet.what: Moss Carpet is a thin floor covering.
item:minecraft:moss_carpet.does: Use it for decorating floors and some spawn-proofing setups. A carpet is not the same as a full wool block.

item:minecraft:mossy_cobblestone.what: Mossy cobblestone is cobblestone with a moss-covered appearance.
item:minecraft:mossy_cobblestone.does: Use it for old ruins, garden walls, and natural-looking construction.

item:minecraft:mossy_cobblestone_slab.what: Mossy Cobblestone Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:mossy_cobblestone_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:mossy_cobblestone_stairs.what: Mossy Cobblestone Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:mossy_cobblestone_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:mossy_cobblestone_wall.what: Mossy Cobblestone Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:mossy_cobblestone_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:mossy_stone_brick_slab.what: Mossy Stone Brick Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:mossy_stone_brick_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:mossy_stone_brick_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:mossy_stone_brick_wall.what: Mossy Stone Brick Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:mossy_stone_brick_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:mossy_stone_bricks.what: Mossy Stone Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:mossy_stone_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:mourner_pottery_sherd.what: Mourner Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:mourner_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:mud.what: Mud is a wet soil block.
item:minecraft:mud.does: Use it in construction, turn it into packed mud, or dry it into clay using a suitable pointed-dripstone arrangement.

item:minecraft:muddy_mangrove_roots.what: Muddy mangrove roots combine mangrove roots with mud.
item:minecraft:muddy_mangrove_roots.does: Use them for swamp-themed construction and textured ground.

item:minecraft:mule_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:mushroom_stem.what: A mushroom stem is the stalk block of a huge mushroom.
item:minecraft:mushroom_stem.does: Use it for mushroom-themed construction. Harvesting the intact block requires a suitable Silk Touch tool.

item:minecraft:mushroom_stew.what: Mushroom stew is a bowl-based food made with red and brown mushrooms.
item:minecraft:mushroom_stew.does: Eat it to restore hunger or collect it from a suitable mooshroom using a bowl.

item:minecraft:mutton.what: Raw mutton is food obtained from sheep.
item:minecraft:mutton.does: Cook it into cooked mutton for better food.

item:minecraft:muttonCooked.does: Eat it to restore hunger. Cooking meat and potatoes generally makes them more useful as food; exact hunger restoration depends on the food.

item:minecraft:muttonRaw.what: Raw mutton is food obtained from sheep.
item:minecraft:muttonRaw.does: Cook it into cooked mutton for better food.

item:minecraft:mycelium.what: Mycelium is the fungus-covered soil found in mushroom fields.
item:minecraft:mycelium.does: Use it for mushroom-themed landscaping; it can spread to suitable nearby dirt.

item:minecraft:name_tag.what: A name tag is an item used to name a mob.
item:minecraft:name_tag.does: Rename it at an anvil, then use it on a compatible mob. Naming can also prevent many ordinary mobs from despawning.

item:minecraft:nautilus_shell.what: A nautilus shell is a material used in conduit crafting.
item:minecraft:nautilus_shell.does: Combine shells with a heart of the sea to make a conduit.

item:minecraft:nautilus_spawn_egg.what: Nautilus Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:nautilus_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:nether_brick.what: Nether Brick is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:nether_brick.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:nether_brick_fence.what: Nether Brick Fence is a connecting fence block.
item:minecraft:nether_brick_fence.does: Use it to enclose animals or mark boundaries. Many mobs cannot jump over an ordinary fence, and leads can be tied to suitable fence posts.

item:minecraft:nether_brick_slab.what: Nether Brick Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:nether_brick_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:nether_brick_stairs.what: Nether Brick Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:nether_brick_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:nether_brick_wall.what: Nether Brick Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:nether_brick_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:nether_gold_ore.what: Nether Gold Ore is a rock containing gold.
item:minecraft:nether_gold_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

item:minecraft:nether_sprouts.what: Nether sprouts are small decorative plants from warped forests.
item:minecraft:nether_sprouts.does: Use them for Nether-themed ground cover.

item:minecraft:nether_star.what: A Nether star is a rare material dropped by the Wither.
item:minecraft:nether_star.does: Use it as the central ingredient in crafting a beacon.

item:minecraft:nether_wart.what: Nether wart is a fungus-like crop grown on soul sand.
item:minecraft:nether_wart.does: Use it to brew awkward potions, which are the starting point for many useful potions.

item:minecraft:nether_wart_block.what: A Nether wart block is a red organic-looking decorative block.
item:minecraft:nether_wart_block.does: Use it for Nether-style builds. Unlike many storage blocks, it cannot simply be crafted back into Nether wart.

item:minecraft:netherbrick.what: A Nether brick is a material made by smelting netherrack.
item:minecraft:netherbrick.does: Combine it into Nether brick building blocks and related recipes.

item:minecraft:netherite_axe.what: Netherite Axe is a tool for chopping wood and other axe-suitable blocks.
item:minecraft:netherite_axe.does: Use it to harvest logs efficiently and strip suitable logs. It can also be used as a melee weapon.

item:minecraft:netherite_block.what: Netherite Block is a compact mineral or metal storage block.
item:minecraft:netherite_block.does: Use it for construction or convert compatible storage blocks back into crafting materials. Some mineral blocks also work in beacon bases.

item:minecraft:netherite_boots.what: Netherite Boots is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:netherite_boots.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:netherite_chestplate.what: Netherite Chestplate is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:netherite_chestplate.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:netherite_helmet.what: Netherite Helmet is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:netherite_helmet.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:netherite_hoe.what: Netherite Hoe is a farming tool.
item:minecraft:netherite_hoe.does: Use it to prepare suitable soil as farmland and to harvest certain plant-based blocks more efficiently.

item:minecraft:netherite_horse_armor.what: Netherite Horse Armor is advanced protective equipment for a compatible horse.
item:minecraft:netherite_horse_armor.does: Equip it on a suitable horse rather than on a player.

item:minecraft:netherite_ingot.what: A netherite ingot is an advanced equipment-upgrade material.
item:minecraft:netherite_ingot.does: Use it with the required netherite upgrade template and diamond equipment at a smithing table.

item:minecraft:netherite_leggings.what: Netherite Leggings is wearable armor for its matching equipment slot.
item:minecraft:netherite_leggings.does: Equip it to reduce suitable incoming damage. Its material and enchantments affect protection and durability.

item:minecraft:netherite_nautilus_armor.what: Netherite Nautilus Armor is protective equipment for a compatible nautilus mount.
item:minecraft:netherite_nautilus_armor.does: Equip it on a suitable nautilus rather than in a player armor slot.

item:minecraft:netherite_pickaxe.what: Netherite Pickaxe is a mining tool for rock and ore blocks.
item:minecraft:netherite_pickaxe.does: Use it to mine compatible blocks faster and obtain their drops. Some ores require a stronger material tier; not every pickaxe can harvest everything.

item:minecraft:netherite_scrap.what: Netherite scrap is a material made by smelting ancient debris.
item:minecraft:netherite_scrap.does: Combine it with gold ingots to make netherite ingots.

item:minecraft:netherite_shovel.what: Netherite Shovel is a digging tool for loose ground materials.
item:minecraft:netherite_shovel.does: Use it to dig dirt, sand, gravel, snow, and similar blocks faster, or make paths from suitable ground.

item:minecraft:netherite_spear.what: Netherite Spear is a reach-oriented melee weapon.
item:minecraft:netherite_spear.does: Use it to attack from farther away than ordinary close-contact weapons; its attack behavior differs from a sword.

item:minecraft:netherite_sword.what: Netherite Sword is a melee weapon.
item:minecraft:netherite_sword.does: Use it to attack targets at close range. Material and enchantments affect its damage and durability.

item:minecraft:netherite_upgrade_smithin.what: Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template is a template used at a smithing table.
item:minecraft:netherite_upgrade_smithin.does: Combine it with compatible equipment and the required material. Upgrade templates improve equipment; armor-trim templates add a decorative pattern.

item:minecraft:netherrack.what: Netherrack is a common rock in the Nether.
item:minecraft:netherrack.does: Use it as a building material or smelt it into nether bricks. Fire on top of it can keep burning.

item:minecraft:normal_stone_slab.what: Normal Stone Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:normal_stone_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:normal_stone_stairs.what: Normal Stone Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:normal_stone_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:noteblock.what: A note block plays a musical note when used or triggered by redstone.
item:minecraft:noteblock.does: Tune it by interacting with it; the block underneath affects the instrument.

item:minecraft:oak_boat.what: Oak Boat is a rideable water vehicle.
item:minecraft:oak_boat.does: Place it on water to carry players or compatible passengers along rivers and across other water routes.

item:minecraft:oak_chest_boat.what: Oak Chest Boat is a water vehicle with built-in storage.
item:minecraft:oak_chest_boat.does: Use it to travel across water while carrying items in its chest. The storage replaces an extra passenger seat.

item:minecraft:oak_fence.does: Use it to enclose animals or mark boundaries. Many mobs cannot jump over an ordinary fence, and leads can be tied to suitable fence posts.

item:minecraft:oak_hanging_sign.does: Hang it from a suitable support and write a message. Dye changes the text color and glow ink can make the writing brighter.

item:minecraft:oak_planks.does: Use it for construction and compatible recipes such as crafting tables, sticks, doors, and wooden components.

item:minecraft:oak_sapling.what: Oak Sapling is a young plant that can grow into its corresponding tree.
item:minecraft:oak_sapling.does: Plant it on suitable ground with enough space and appropriate conditions. Bone meal can speed up compatible growth.

item:minecraft:oak_shelf.what: Oak Shelf is a shelf block for displaying and storing items.
item:minecraft:oak_shelf.does: Use it to organize items visibly on a wall or as part of a storage area.

item:minecraft:oak_sign.what: Oak Sign is a sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:oak_sign.does: Place it on a suitable surface and enter a message. Use dye to recolor the text or glow ink to brighten it.

item:minecraft:oak_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:oak_stairs.what: Oak Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:oak_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:oak_wood.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:observer.what: An observer detects changes in the block it faces.
item:minecraft:observer.does: It sends a short redstone pulse from its back when it detects a change, which is useful in automatic farms and machines.

item:minecraft:obsidian.what: Obsidian is a very tough block formed in certain water-and-lava interactions.

item:minecraft:red_stained_glass.does: Use it for tinted windows, decorative enclosures, or to color a beacon beam passing through it.

item:minecraft:red_stained_glass_pane.does: Use connected panes for tinted windows and dividers. It is not a full glass block.

item:minecraft:red_terracotta.what: Red Terracotta is a colored hardened-clay building block.
item:minecraft:red_terracotta.does: Use it for construction and decorative color palettes, or smelt compatible colored terracotta into its glazed form.

item:minecraft:red_tulip.what: Red Tulip is a decorative flower.
item:minecraft:red_tulip.does: Plant it on suitable ground for decoration or use it in compatible dye, composting, or crafting recipes.

item:minecraft:red_wool.what: Red Wool is a soft fabric building block.
item:minecraft:red_wool.does: Use it for decoration, beds, and compatible crafting recipes. Wool also helps block certain sculk vibration paths.

item:minecraft:red_wool_slab.what: Red Wool Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:red_wool_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:red_wool_stairs.what: Red Wool Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:red_wool_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:redstone.what: Redstone dust is a material used to connect redstone mechanisms.
item:minecraft:redstone.does: Place it as wiring to carry signals between switches and machines. It is also used in crafting and some brewing recipes.

item:minecraft:redstone_block.what: Redstone Block is a compact mineral or metal storage block.
item:minecraft:redstone_block.does: Use it for construction or convert compatible storage blocks back into crafting materials. Some mineral blocks also work in beacon bases.

item:minecraft:redstone_lamp.what: A redstone lamp is a light block controlled by redstone.
item:minecraft:redstone_lamp.does: Power it to turn the light on and remove power to turn it off.

item:minecraft:redstone_ore.what: Redstone Ore is a rock containing redstone.
item:minecraft:redstone_ore.does: Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain its mineral resource. Tool requirements and drops depend on the ore and enchantments.

item:minecraft:redstone_torch.what: A redstone torch is a small redstone power source that also emits light.
item:minecraft:redstone_torch.does: It usually powers nearby connections, but turns off when its attached block receives power, making it useful in logic circuits.

item:minecraft:reinforced_deepslate.what: Reinforced deepslate is an unusually tough decorative block associated with ancient cities.
item:minecraft:reinforced_deepslate.does: It forms part of ancient-city structures and is not normally obtainable as a block in ordinary Survival.

item:minecraft:repeater.what: A redstone repeater passes a redstone signal in one direction.
item:minecraft:repeater.does: It refreshes signal strength and adds an adjustable delay. A correctly placed side signal can lock it.

item:minecraft:repeating_command_block.what: A repeating command block runs its command repeatedly while active.
item:minecraft:repeating_command_block.does: Use it for mapmaking systems, keeping its activation conditions and performance cost in mind.

item:minecraft:resin_block.what: A resin block is a building and storage block made from resin clumps.
item:minecraft:resin_block.does: Use it for orange construction or convert it into suitable resin materials.

item:minecraft:resin_clump.does: Collect it for resin building and crafting recipes.

item:minecraft:respawn_anchor.what: A respawn anchor lets a player set a respawn point in the Nether.
item:minecraft:respawn_anchor.does: Charge it with glowstone. Trying to use it as a respawn point in an unsuitable dimension causes an explosion.

item:minecraft:rib_armor_trim_smithing_t.what: Rib Armor Trim Smithing Template is a template used at a smithing table.
item:minecraft:rib_armor_trim_smithing_t.does: Combine it with compatible equipment and the required material. Upgrade templates improve equipment; armor-trim templates add a decorative pattern.

item:minecraft:rose_bush.what: Rose Bush is a decorative flower.
item:minecraft:rose_bush.does: Plant it on suitable ground for decoration or use it in compatible dye, composting, or crafting recipes.

item:minecraft:rotten_flesh.what: Rotten flesh is food commonly dropped by zombies.
item:minecraft:rotten_flesh.does: Eating it can cause Hunger, so it is a risky food source. It also has uses in wolf feeding and villager trading.

item:minecraft:saddle.what: A saddle is equipment used to ride certain animals.
item:minecraft:saddle.does: Equip it on a suitable rideable animal; steering and taming requirements depend on the animal.

item:minecraft:salmon.what: Raw salmon is fish used as food and in compatible animal interactions.
item:minecraft:salmon.does: Cook it for better food or use it in suitable animal-feeding and taming interactions.

item:minecraft:salmon_bucket.what: Salmon Bucket is a bucket carrying its named contents.
item:minecraft:salmon_bucket.does: Use it to place or release the contents in a suitable location. Filled fish and axolotl buckets let you transport the animal alive.

item:minecraft:salmon_spawn_egg.what: Salmon Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:salmon_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:sand.what: Sand is a loose block that falls when unsupported.
item:minecraft:sand.does: Smelt it into glass or use it in crafting and landscaping. It also supports certain plants, such as cactus.

item:minecraft:sandstone.what: Sandstone is a decorative stone building material.
item:minecraft:sandstone.does: Use it for contrasting walls, floors, columns, and other architectural details.

item:minecraft:sandstone_slab.what: Sandstone Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:sandstone_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:sandstone_stairs.what: Sandstone Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:sandstone_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:sandstone_wall.what: Sandstone Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:sandstone_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:scaffolding.what: Scaffolding is a temporary building structure that helps players climb and work at height.
item:minecraft:scaffolding.does: Place connected scaffolding to extend a platform or climb it, then remove its support to take down connected sections.

item:minecraft:scrape_pottery_sherd.what: Scrape Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:scrape_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:sculk.what: Sculk is a dark block associated with the deep dark.
item:minecraft:sculk.does: Use it in dark-themed builds; harvesting it without Silk Touch can release experience.

item:minecraft:sculk_catalyst.what: A sculk catalyst spreads sculk using experience from nearby deaths.
item:minecraft:sculk_catalyst.does: Use it in sculk-growth and experience-related setups, remembering that the growth consumes the experience involved.

item:minecraft:sculk_sensor.what: A sculk sensor detects nearby vibrations and produces redstone signals.
item:minecraft:sculk_sensor.does: Use it for wireless detection, but remember that nearby movement and other actions can trigger it. Wool can block certain vibration paths.

item:minecraft:sculk_shrieker.what: A sculk shrieker is a block that responds to certain sculk-related activations with a loud shriek.
item:minecraft:sculk_shrieker.does: Naturally generated shriekers with the appropriate properties can contribute to Warden spawning, so avoid triggering them carelessly.

item:minecraft:sculk_vein.what: A sculk vein is a thin sculk growth that attaches to block surfaces.
item:minecraft:sculk_vein.does: Use it for dark decoration and sculk-themed builds.

item:minecraft:sea_lantern.what: A sea lantern is a bright block often associated with ocean monuments.
item:minecraft:sea_lantern.does: Use it for underwater and decorative lighting.

item:minecraft:sea_pickle.what: A sea pickle is a small underwater organism that can emit light.
item:minecraft:sea_pickle.does: Use living sea pickles underwater for natural lighting and in compatible lime-dye production.

item:minecraft:seagrass.does: Use it for aquatic decoration and turtle breeding; harvest it intact using suitable tools such as shears.

item:minecraft:sentry_armor_trim_smithin.what: Sentry Armor Trim Smithing Template is a template used at a smithing table.

item:minecraft:shears.what: Shears are a tool for harvesting wool and certain plant materials.
item:minecraft:shears.does: Use them on sheep or compatible blocks such as leaves and vines; some blocks give different drops when sheared.

item:minecraft:sheep_spawn_egg.what: Sheep Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:sheep_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:shelf_mushroom.what: A shelf mushroom is a mushroom material with a shelf-like growth form.
item:minecraft:shelf_mushroom.does: Use it for suitable mushroom decoration and compatible food recipes, including rabbit stew.

item:minecraft:shelter_pottery_sherd.what: Shelter Pottery Sherd is an archaeology material for decorating pots.
item:minecraft:shelter_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:shield.what: A shield is defensive equipment used to block suitable attacks.

item:minecraft:short_dry_grass.what: Short Dry Grass is decorative ground or hanging vegetation.

item:minecraft:skull_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:slime.what: A slime block is a bouncy block made from slimeballs.

item:minecraft:slime_spawn_egg.what: Slime Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.

item:minecraft:small_dripleaf_block.what: A small dripleaf is a water-associated plant.
item:minecraft:small_dripleaf_block.does: Use it in lush-cave decoration or grow it into big dripleaf with bone meal under suitable conditions.

item:minecraft:smithing_table.what: A smithing table upgrades or decorates compatible equipment.
item:minecraft:smithing_table.does: Use the appropriate smithing template and materials for netherite upgrades or armor trims. It is a toolsmith villager's job-site block.

item:minecraft:smoker.what: A smoker is a workstation that cooks food faster than a regular furnace.
item:minecraft:smoker.does: Use it with fuel for compatible food recipes. It is also a butcher villager's job-site block.

item:minecraft:smooth_basalt.does: Use it for dark stone walls, floors, and geode-themed builds.

item:minecraft:smooth_stone_slab.what: Smooth Stone Slab is a half-height building block.

item:minecraft:sniffer_egg.what: A sniffer egg hatches into a young sniffer.
item:minecraft:sniffer_egg.does: Place it in a suitable location and wait; a moss block helps it hatch faster.

item:minecraft:sniffer_spawn_egg.what: Sniffer Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:sniffer_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.
