item:minecraft:snort_pottery_sherd.does: Use it in a decorated-pot recipe to put its design on a side of the pot.

item:minecraft:snout_armor_trim_smithing.what: Snout Armor Trim Smithing Template is a template used at a smithing table.
item:minecraft:snout_armor_trim_smithing.does: Combine it with compatible equipment and the required material. Upgrade templates improve equipment; armor-trim templates add a decorative pattern.

item:minecraft:snow.what: Snow is a full block made from snowballs.
item:minecraft:snow.does: Use it for snowy builds and making snow golems with the other required block.

item:minecraft:snow_golem_spawn_egg.what: Snow Golem Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:snow_golem_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:snow_layer.what: Snow layers are thin coverings of snow.
item:minecraft:snow_layer.does: Use them to create snowy ground and varying snow depths; heat can melt them.

item:minecraft:snowball.what: A snowball is a throwable item and projectile.
item:minecraft:snowball.does: Throw it to knock or distract suitable targets; it also has special interactions with some mobs, including blazes.

item:minecraft:soul_campfire.what: A soul campfire is a blue-flamed campfire.
item:minecraft:soul_campfire.does: It cooks food and produces smoke like a campfire, while also being dangerous to touch.

item:minecraft:soul_lantern.what: A soul lantern is a hanging or standing light source with a blue flame.
item:minecraft:soul_lantern.does: Use it for dimmer blue lighting and to help keep piglins away.

item:minecraft:soul_sand.what: Soul sand is a Nether block that slows entities walking on it.
item:minecraft:soul_sand.does: Use it to grow Nether wart, build parts of a Wither-summoning structure, or create upward bubble columns in source water.

item:minecraft:soul_soil.what: Soul soil is a Nether ground block associated with soul fire.
item:minecraft:soul_soil.does: Use it in soul-fire constructions and certain basalt-generation arrangements. It is not the same as soul sand for bubble columns.

item:minecraft:soul_torch.what: A soul torch is a blue-flamed light source.
item:minecraft:soul_torch.does: Use it for lighting and decoration; its soul-fire light also repels piglins.

item:minecraft:spider_eye.what: A spider eye is a brewing ingredient that can also be eaten.
item:minecraft:spider_eye.does: Use it in compatible potion recipes; eating it poisons the player.

item:minecraft:spider_spawn_egg.what: Spider Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:spider_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:spire_armor_trim_smithing.what: Spire Armor Trim Smithing Template is a template used at a smithing table.
item:minecraft:spire_armor_trim_smithing.does: Combine it with compatible equipment and the required material. Upgrade templates improve equipment; armor-trim templates add a decorative pattern.

item:minecraft:splash_potion.what: A splash potion is a throwable potion.
item:minecraft:splash_potion.does: Throw it to apply its effect around the impact point; the effect depends on the potion's contents.

item:minecraft:sponge.what: A sponge is a block that absorbs nearby water.
item:minecraft:sponge.does: Place it to help drain an area; once wet, it must be dried before it can absorb water again.

item:minecraft:spore_blossom.what: A spore blossom is a hanging flower from lush caves.
item:minecraft:spore_blossom.does: Place it on the underside of a suitable block for decoration and drifting particles.

item:minecraft:spruce_boat.what: Spruce Boat is a rideable water vehicle.
item:minecraft:spruce_boat.does: Place it on water to carry players or compatible passengers along rivers and across other water routes.

item:minecraft:spruce_button.what: Spruce Button is a temporary redstone switch.
item:minecraft:spruce_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

item:minecraft:spruce_chest_boat.what: Spruce Chest Boat is a water vehicle with built-in storage.
item:minecraft:spruce_chest_boat.does: Use it to travel across water while carrying items in its chest. The storage replaces an extra passenger seat.

item:minecraft:spruce_door.what: Spruce Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
item:minecraft:spruce_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:spruce_fence.what: Spruce Fence is a connecting fence block.
item:minecraft:spruce_fence.does: Use it to enclose animals or mark boundaries. Many mobs cannot jump over an ordinary fence, and leads can be tied to suitable fence posts.

item:minecraft:spruce_fence_gate.what: Spruce Fence Gate is an openable gate that connects to fences.
item:minecraft:spruce_fence_gate.does: Use it to enter an enclosure while keeping a fence-style barrier when closed. It can be controlled by hand or redstone.

item:minecraft:spruce_hanging_sign.what: Spruce Hanging Sign is a suspended sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:spruce_hanging_sign.does: Hang it from a suitable support and write a message. Dye changes the text color and glow ink can make the writing brighter.

item:minecraft:spruce_leaves.what: Spruce Leaves is foliage used by a tree or large plant.
item:minecraft:spruce_leaves.does: Use it for landscaping and hedges. Harvesting the intact block normally needs shears or Silk Touch; some leaves can drop plant materials when they decay.

item:minecraft:spruce_log.what: Spruce Log is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
item:minecraft:spruce_log.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:spruce_planks.what: Spruce Planks is a processed wood building material.
item:minecraft:spruce_planks.does: Use it for construction and compatible recipes such as crafting tables, sticks, doors, and wooden components.

item:minecraft:spruce_pressure_plate.what: Spruce Pressure Plate is a switch activated when suitable entities stand on it.
item:minecraft:spruce_pressure_plate.does: Use it to trigger redstone mechanisms. Wooden and stone plates detect different kinds of entities.

item:minecraft:spruce_sapling.what: Spruce Sapling is a young plant that can grow into its corresponding tree.
item:minecraft:spruce_sapling.does: Plant it on suitable ground with enough space and appropriate conditions. Bone meal can speed up compatible growth.

item:minecraft:spruce_shelf.what: Spruce Shelf is a shelf block for displaying and storing items.
item:minecraft:spruce_shelf.does: Use it to organize items visibly on a wall or as part of a storage area.

item:minecraft:spruce_sign.what: Spruce Sign is a sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:spruce_sign.does: Place it on a suitable surface and enter a message. Use dye to recolor the text or glow ink to brighten it.

item:minecraft:spruce_slab.what: Spruce Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:spruce_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:spruce_stairs.what: Spruce Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:spruce_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:spruce_trapdoor.what: Spruce Trapdoor is a small hinged hatch.
item:minecraft:spruce_trapdoor.does: Use it for floor or ceiling openings and decorative details. Redstone can control it; iron trapdoors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:spruce_wood.what: Spruce Wood is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
item:minecraft:spruce_wood.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:spyglass.what: A spyglass is a tool that zooms your view toward distant objects.
item:minecraft:spyglass.does: Hold and use it to look farther away without moving closer.

item:minecraft:squid_spawn_egg.what: Squid Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:squid_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:stick.what: A stick is a basic crafting component usually made from wooden planks.
item:minecraft:stick.does: Use it in tools, weapons, torches, ladders, and many other recipes.

item:minecraft:sticky_piston.what: A sticky piston pushes blocks and can pull a block back when it retracts.
item:minecraft:sticky_piston.does: Use it for retracting doors and other moving mechanisms. Bedrock piston behavior differs from Java in some situations.

item:minecraft:stone.what: Stone is a common solid rock found throughout the Overworld.
item:minecraft:stone.does: Mine it for building materials; without Silk Touch it normally drops cobblestone. It is used in many construction and crafting recipes.

item:minecraft:stone_axe.what: Stone Axe is a tool for chopping wood and other axe-suitable blocks.
item:minecraft:stone_axe.does: Use it to harvest logs efficiently and strip suitable logs. It can also be used as a melee weapon.

item:minecraft:stone_brick_slab.what: Stone Brick Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:stone_brick_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:stone_brick_stairs.what: Stone Brick Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:stone_brick_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:stone_brick_wall.what: Stone Brick Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:stone_brick_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:stone_bricks.what: Stone Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:stone_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:stone_button.what: Stone Button is a temporary redstone switch.
item:minecraft:stone_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

item:minecraft:stone_hoe.what: Stone Hoe is a farming tool.
item:minecraft:stone_hoe.does: Use it to prepare suitable soil as farmland and to harvest certain plant-based blocks more efficiently.

item:minecraft:stone_pickaxe.what: Stone Pickaxe is a mining tool for rock and ore blocks.
item:minecraft:stone_pickaxe.does: Use it to mine compatible blocks faster and obtain their drops. Some ores require a stronger material tier; not every pickaxe can harvest everything.

item:minecraft:stone_pressure_plate.what: Stone Pressure Plate is a switch activated when suitable entities stand on it.
item:minecraft:stone_pressure_plate.does: Use it to trigger redstone mechanisms. Wooden and stone plates detect different kinds of entities.

item:minecraft:stone_shovel.what: Stone Shovel is a digging tool for loose ground materials.
item:minecraft:stone_shovel.does: Use it to dig dirt, sand, gravel, snow, and similar blocks faster, or make paths from suitable ground.

item:minecraft:stone_spear.what: Stone Spear is a reach-oriented melee weapon.
item:minecraft:stone_spear.does: Use it to attack from farther away than ordinary close-contact weapons; its attack behavior differs from a sword.

item:minecraft:stone_stairs.what: Stone Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:stone_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:stone_sword.what: Stone Sword is a melee weapon.
item:minecraft:stone_sword.does: Use it to attack targets at close range. Material and enchantments affect its damage and durability.

item:minecraft:stonecutter_block.what: A stonecutter turns compatible stone into building shapes.
item:minecraft:stonecutter_block.does: Use its menu for efficient stone stairs, slabs, and other shapes. It is also a mason villager's job-site block.

item:minecraft:straw_bed.what: Straw Bed is a colored bed for sleeping and setting an Overworld respawn point.
item:minecraft:straw_bed.does: Use it when the world's sleep conditions are met. Trying to sleep in the Nether or End causes an explosion.

item:minecraft:stray_spawn_egg.what: Stray Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:stray_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:strider_spawn_egg.what: Strider Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:strider_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:string.what: String is a crafting and redstone material.
item:minecraft:string.does: Use it for bows, fishing rods, wool, and tripwire lines.

item:minecraft:stripped_acacia_log.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:stripped_acacia_wood.what: Stripped Acacia Wood is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
item:minecraft:stripped_acacia_wood.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:stripped_bamboo_block.what: A stripped bamboo block is a bamboo block with its outer surface removed.
item:minecraft:stripped_bamboo_block.does: Use it for smooth bamboo-colored construction and compatible crafting.

item:minecraft:structure_block.what: A structure block is a mapmaking tool for saving and loading structures.
item:minecraft:structure_block.does: Use it with the required world permissions to copy and place selected builds.

item:minecraft:structure_void.what: A structure void marks space that should not overwrite existing blocks when loading a structure.
item:minecraft:structure_void.does: Use it in structure editing and mapmaking rather than as a normal Survival material.

item:minecraft:sugar.what: Sugar is a crafting and brewing ingredient.
item:minecraft:sugar.does: Use it in foods such as cake or in compatible potion recipes such as Swiftness.

item:minecraft:sugar_cane.what: Sugar cane is a tall plant that grows beside water.
item:minecraft:sugar_cane.does: Harvest it for paper and sugar while leaving the bottom segment to regrow.

item:minecraft:sulfur.what: Sulfur is a mineral block with several building variants.
item:minecraft:sulfur.does: Use it in construction or craft compatible polished, chiseled, stair, slab, and wall forms.

item:minecraft:sulfur_brick_slab.what: Sulfur Brick Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:sulfur_brick_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:sulfur_brick_stairs.what: Sulfur Brick Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:sulfur_brick_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:sulfur_brick_wall.what: Sulfur Brick Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:sulfur_brick_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:sulfur_bricks.what: Sulfur Bricks is a shaped masonry building block.
item:minecraft:sulfur_bricks.does: Use it for walls, floors, roofs, and detailed construction with a brick or tile pattern.

item:minecraft:sulfur_cube_bucket.what: Sulfur Cube Bucket is a bucket carrying its named contents.
item:minecraft:sulfur_cube_bucket.does: Use it to place or release the contents in a suitable location. Filled fish and axolotl buckets let you transport the animal alive.

item:minecraft:sulfur_cube_spawn_egg.what: Sulfur Cube Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:sulfur_cube_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:sulfur_slab.what: Sulfur Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:sulfur_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:sulfur_spike.what: A sulfur spike is a pointed sulfur formation.
item:minecraft:sulfur_spike.does: It is different from the ordinary flat sulfur building block. I still need to learn its special interactions.

item:minecraft:sulfur_stairs.what: Sulfur Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:sulfur_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:sulfur_wall.what: Sulfur Wall is a connecting wall block.
item:minecraft:sulfur_wall.does: Use it as a boundary or decorative support. Walls are taller for collision than they look, helping keep many ordinary mobs contained.

item:minecraft:sunflower.does: Plant it on suitable ground for decoration or use it in compatible dye, composting, or crafting recipes.

item:minecraft:suspicious_gravel.what: Suspicious gravel is a fragile archaeology block containing a hidden item.
item:minecraft:suspicious_gravel.does: Use a brush rather than an ordinary mining tool to uncover the hidden item.

item:minecraft:suspicious_sand.what: Suspicious sand is a fragile archaeology block containing a hidden item.
item:minecraft:suspicious_sand.does: Use a brush to uncover the item; breaking it normally destroys the chance to recover the contents.

item:minecraft:suspicious_stew.what: Suspicious stew is food whose extra effect depends on its ingredients or source.
item:minecraft:suspicious_stew.does: Eat it to restore hunger, but its hidden effect can be helpful or harmful.

item:minecraft:sweet_berries.what: Sweet berries are food harvested from sweet berry bushes.
item:minecraft:sweet_berries.does: Eat them or plant them to grow a bush. The bush can slow and hurt entities moving through it.

item:minecraft:tadpole_bucket.what: Tadpole Bucket is a bucket carrying its named contents.
item:minecraft:tadpole_bucket.does: Use it to place or release the contents in a suitable location. Filled fish and axolotl buckets let you transport the animal alive.

item:minecraft:tadpole_spawn_egg.what: Tadpole Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:tadpole_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:tall_dry_grass.what: Tall Dry Grass is decorative ground or hanging vegetation.
item:minecraft:tall_dry_grass.does: Use it for natural landscaping on suitable surfaces. Harvesting and planting requirements depend on the plant.

item:minecraft:tall_grass.what: Tall Grass is decorative ground or hanging vegetation.
item:minecraft:tall_grass.does: Use it for natural landscaping on suitable surfaces. Harvesting and planting requirements depend on the plant.

item:minecraft:target.what: A target block detects hits from suitable projectiles.
item:minecraft:target.does: It produces a redstone signal, with stronger output for hits closer to the center of its target face.

item:minecraft:tide_armor_trim_smithing_.what: Tide Armor Trim Smithing Template is a template used at a smithing table.
item:minecraft:tide_armor_trim_smithing_.does: Combine it with compatible equipment and the required material. Upgrade templates improve equipment; armor-trim templates add a decorative pattern.

item:minecraft:tinted_glass.what: Tinted glass is transparent-looking glass that blocks light transmission.
item:minecraft:tinted_glass.does: Use it to see into dark spaces while keeping them dark for suitable farms or decorative effects.

item:minecraft:tnt.what: TNT is an explosive block that becomes a primed explosive entity when ignited.
item:minecraft:tnt.does: Use it for controlled explosions, keeping people, pets, and important builds well away from the blast.

item:minecraft:tnt_minecart.what: A TNT minecart is an explosive rail vehicle.
item:minecraft:tnt_minecart.does: Certain activations and impacts can trigger it. Use it only where an explosion is intended.

item:minecraft:torch.what: A torch is a placeable light source.
item:minecraft:torch.does: Use it to light paths and rooms and reduce normal hostile-mob spawning in dark areas.

item:minecraft:torchflower.what: A torchflower is an ancient decorative flower grown from seeds found by sniffers.
item:minecraft:torchflower.does: Use it for decoration and compatible crafting. Despite its name, it does not light up nearby blocks like a torch.

item:minecraft:torchflower_seeds.what: Torchflower seeds are ancient seeds dug up by sniffers.
item:minecraft:torchflower_seeds.does: Plant them on farmland to grow torchflowers or use them for compatible sniffer breeding.

item:minecraft:totem_of_undying.what: A totem of undying can rescue its holder from many otherwise fatal hits.
item:minecraft:totem_of_undying.does: Hold it in the main hand or off-hand so it can activate, consume itself, and provide recovery effects. It does not protect from every possible death.

item:minecraft:trader_llama_spawn_egg.what: Trader Llama Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:trader_llama_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:trapdoor.what: An oak trapdoor is a small hinged wooden hatch.
item:minecraft:trapdoor.does: Open it by hand or redstone for floor and ceiling access or decorative details.

item:minecraft:trapped_chest.what: A trapped chest is a storage container that sends a redstone signal while players open it.
item:minecraft:trapped_chest.does: Use it to trigger a mechanism when someone opens the chest. It does not automatically harm anyone.

item:minecraft:trial_key.what: A trial key unlocks a compatible ordinary vault.
item:minecraft:trial_key.does: Earn it from trial-chamber encounters and use it on an appropriate vault; an ominous vault needs a different key.

item:minecraft:trial_spawner.what: A trial spawner is a combat encounter block found in trial chambers.
item:minecraft:trial_spawner.does: It spawns waves of mobs for nearby players and awards rewards after the trial. Ominous conditions change the encounter.

item:minecraft:trident.what: A trident is a weapon usable in melee or as a thrown projectile.
item:minecraft:trident.does: Attack directly or throw it; its enchantments can change recovery and movement behavior.

item:minecraft:tripwire_hook.what: A tripwire hook forms a tripwire detector when connected to another hook by string.
item:minecraft:tripwire_hook.does: Entities touching the connecting string trigger a redstone signal.

item:minecraft:tropical_fish.what: A tropical fish item is a caught fish used as food or an ingredient in certain interactions.
item:minecraft:tropical_fish.does: It is not the same as a live tropical fish in a bucket; axolotl breeding needs the bucket form.

item:minecraft:tropical_fish_bucket.what: Tropical Fish Bucket is a bucket carrying its named contents.
item:minecraft:tropical_fish_bucket.does: Use it to place or release the contents in a suitable location. Filled fish and axolotl buckets let you transport the animal alive.

item:minecraft:tropical_fish_spawn_egg.what: Tropical Fish Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:tropical_fish_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:tube_coral.what: Tube Coral is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
item:minecraft:tube_coral.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

item:minecraft:tube_coral_block.what: Tube Coral Block is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
item:minecraft:tube_coral_block.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

item:minecraft:tube_coral_fan.what: Tube Coral Fan is a living coral decoration associated with warm oceans.
item:minecraft:tube_coral_fan.does: Use it in underwater builds and keep the required water nearby so it does not turn into dead coral.

item:minecraft:tuff.what: Tuff is a gray volcanic-looking stone.
item:minecraft:tuff.does: Use it for construction and compatible decorative tuff building shapes.

item:minecraft:turtle_egg.what: A turtle egg is laid by turtles on sand.
item:minecraft:turtle_egg.does: Keep it safe from trampling and hostile mobs while it develops and hatches into a baby turtle.

item:minecraft:turtle_helmet.what: A turtle shell is a helmet made from turtle scutes.
item:minecraft:turtle_helmet.does: Wear it for armor and a short Water Breathing benefit when entering water.

item:minecraft:turtle_scute.what: A turtle scute is a material shed when a baby turtle grows into an adult.
item:minecraft:turtle_scute.does: Use it to craft a turtle shell helmet.

item:minecraft:turtle_spawn_egg.what: Turtle Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:turtle_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:twisting_vines.what: Twisting vines are blue Nether vines that grow upward.
item:minecraft:twisting_vines.does: Use them for climbing and warped-forest decoration.

item:minecraft:undyed_shulker_box.what: Undyed Shulker Box is a portable storage container.
item:minecraft:undyed_shulker_box.does: Store items inside, break the box, and carry it with its contents preserved. You cannot put a shulker box inside another shulker box.

item:minecraft:vault.what: A vault is a trial-chamber block that gives rewards when unlocked with a matching key.
item:minecraft:vault.does: Use the correct key; rewards are tracked per player, so a vault is not a chest you can repeatedly empty by reopening it.

item:minecraft:verdant_froglight.what: Verdant Froglight is a light-emitting block produced when a frog eats a small magma cube.
item:minecraft:verdant_froglight.does: Use it for bright decorative lighting. The frog variant determines the froglight color.

item:minecraft:vex_armor_trim_smithing_t.what: Vex Armor Trim Smithing Template is a template used at a smithing table.
item:minecraft:vex_armor_trim_smithing_t.does: Combine it with compatible equipment and the required material. Upgrade templates improve equipment; armor-trim templates add a decorative pattern.

item:minecraft:vex_spawn_egg.what: Vex Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:vex_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:vine.what: Vines are climbing plants attached to suitable surfaces.
item:minecraft:vine.does: Use them for climbing and overgrown decoration; they can spread down nearby surfaces.

item:minecraft:wandering_trader_spawn_eg.what: Wandering Trader Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.

item:minecraft:warden_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:warped_button.what: Warped Button is a temporary redstone switch.
item:minecraft:warped_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

item:minecraft:warped_door.what: Warped Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
item:minecraft:warped_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:warped_fence.what: Warped Fence is a connecting fence block.
item:minecraft:warped_fence.does: Use it to enclose animals or mark boundaries. Many mobs cannot jump over an ordinary fence, and leads can be tied to suitable fence posts.

item:minecraft:warped_fence_gate.what: Warped Fence Gate is an openable gate that connects to fences.
item:minecraft:warped_fence_gate.does: Use it to enter an enclosure while keeping a fence-style barrier when closed. It can be controlled by hand or redstone.

item:minecraft:warped_fungus.what: A warped fungus is a Nether fungus that can grow into a huge warped fungus.
item:minecraft:warped_fungus.does: Grow it under suitable conditions, use it in strider-related interactions, or place it to help repel hoglins.

item:minecraft:warped_fungus_on_a_stick.what: A warped fungus on a stick is a steering tool for a saddled strider.
item:minecraft:warped_fungus_on_a_stick.does: Hold it while riding to guide the strider across suitable terrain, including lava.

item:minecraft:warped_hanging_sign.what: Warped Hanging Sign is a suspended sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:warped_hanging_sign.does: Hang it from a suitable support and write a message. Dye changes the text color and glow ink can make the writing brighter.

item:minecraft:warped_hyphae.what: Warped Hyphae is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
item:minecraft:warped_hyphae.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:warped_nylium.what: Warped nylium is the living surface block of a warped forest.
item:minecraft:warped_nylium.does: Use it to grow compatible Nether fungi and plants with bone meal.

item:minecraft:warped_planks.what: Warped Planks is a processed wood building material.
item:minecraft:warped_planks.does: Use it for construction and compatible recipes such as crafting tables, sticks, doors, and wooden components.

item:minecraft:warped_pressure_plate.what: Warped Pressure Plate is a switch activated when suitable entities stand on it.
item:minecraft:warped_pressure_plate.does: Use it to trigger redstone mechanisms. Wooden and stone plates detect different kinds of entities.

item:minecraft:warped_roots.what: Warped roots are small plants from warped Nether environments.
item:minecraft:warped_roots.does: Use them for decorative ground cover or compatible composting.

item:minecraft:warped_shelf.what: Warped Shelf is a shelf block for displaying and storing items.
item:minecraft:warped_shelf.does: Use it to organize items visibly on a wall or as part of a storage area.

item:minecraft:warped_sign.what: Warped Sign is a sign for displaying written text.
item:minecraft:warped_sign.does: Place it on a suitable surface and enter a message. Use dye to recolor the text or glow ink to brighten it.

item:minecraft:warped_slab.what: Warped Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:warped_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:warped_stairs.what: Warped Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:warped_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:warped_stem.what: Warped Stem is a tree or giant-fungus building material.
item:minecraft:warped_stem.does: Use it for natural-looking construction or turn suitable wood into planks. Unstripped forms can often be stripped with an axe.

item:minecraft:warped_trapdoor.what: Warped Trapdoor is a small hinged hatch.
item:minecraft:warped_trapdoor.does: Use it for floor or ceiling openings and decorative details. Redstone can control it; iron trapdoors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:warped_wart_block.what: A warped wart block is a blue-green decorative block from huge warped fungi.
item:minecraft:warped_wart_block.does: Use it for Nether-style foliage and building accents.

item:minecraft:water_bucket.what: A water bucket carries a water source.
item:minecraft:water_bucket.does: Place it to move water, help with farming, or create water-based mechanisms.

item:minecraft:waterlily.what: A lily pad is a flat plant that floats on water.
item:minecraft:waterlily.does: Use it for pond decoration and as a small surface to stand on.

item:minecraft:waxed_chiseled_copper.what: Waxed Chiseled Copper is a copper building block.
item:minecraft:waxed_chiseled_copper.does: Use it for construction and decoration. Unwaxed copper can oxidize to a different color; honeycomb prevents further oxidation.

item:minecraft:waxed_copper.what: Waxed Copper is a copper building block.
item:minecraft:waxed_copper.does: Use it for construction and decoration. Unwaxed copper can oxidize to a different color; honeycomb prevents further oxidation.

item:minecraft:waxed_copper_bars.what: Waxed Copper Bars is a thin copper building decoration.
item:minecraft:waxed_copper_bars.does: Use it for grilles, hanging details, and copper-themed construction; copper oxidation changes compatible unwaxed forms.

item:minecraft:waxed_copper_bulb.what: Waxed Copper Bulb is a copper light block switched by redstone pulses.
item:minecraft:waxed_copper_bulb.does: A pulse changes its on/off state, and its oxidation affects its brightness. Waxing stops further oxidation.

item:minecraft:waxed_copper_door.does: Use it by hand or with redstone. Its appearance changes with oxidation unless it is waxed.

item:minecraft:weathered_cut_copper_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:weathered_cut_copper_stai.what: Weathered Cut Copper Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:weathered_cut_copper_stai.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:weathered_lightning_rod.what: Weathered Lightning Rod is a copper lightning rod.
item:minecraft:weathered_lightning_rod.does: Use it to attract nearby lightning strikes toward a chosen location and obtain a short redstone signal when struck.

item:minecraft:web.what: A cobweb is a block that greatly slows entities moving through it.
item:minecraft:web.does: Use it for traps or decoration, or harvest it with suitable tools to obtain string or the intact web.

item:minecraft:weeping_vines.what: Weeping vines are red Nether vines that hang downward.
item:minecraft:weeping_vines.does: Use them for climbing and crimson-forest decoration.

item:minecraft:wet_sponge.what: A wet sponge is a sponge that has already absorbed water.
item:minecraft:wet_sponge.does: Dry it in a furnace, or use the Nether's drying behavior, so it can absorb water again.

item:minecraft:wheat.what: Wheat is a crop harvested from mature wheat plants.
item:minecraft:wheat.does: Use it for bread and other recipes or to feed and breed compatible farm animals such as cows and sheep.

item:minecraft:wheat_seeds.what: Wheat seeds are planted on farmland to grow wheat.
item:minecraft:wheat_seeds.does: Use them for farming or to feed compatible animals such as chickens.

item:minecraft:white_bundle.what: White Bundle is a portable container for combining small stacks of items.
item:minecraft:white_bundle.does: Use it to organize inventory space; its capacity is based on the stack sizes of the items inside.

item:minecraft:white_candle.what: White Candle is a small decorative light source.
item:minecraft:white_candle.does: Place candles on a suitable surface and light them with a fire-starting tool. Compatible candles can share a block space.

item:minecraft:white_carpet.what: White Carpet is a thin floor covering.
item:minecraft:white_carpet.does: Use it for decorating floors and some spawn-proofing setups. A carpet is not the same as a full wool block.

item:minecraft:white_concrete.what: White Concrete is a solid colored building block.
item:minecraft:white_concrete.does: Use it for vivid walls, floors, sculptures, and other decorative builds.

item:minecraft:white_concrete_powder.what: White Concrete Powder is a gravity-affected building material.
item:minecraft:white_concrete_powder.does: Place it in contact with suitable water to turn it into solid concrete, or use it as colored falling material.

item:minecraft:white_concrete_slab.what: White Concrete Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:white_concrete_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:white_concrete_stairs.what: White Concrete Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:white_concrete_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:white_cushion.what: White Cushion is a colored seat decoration.
item:minecraft:white_cushion.does: Place it as a seat in compatible builds and use its sitting interaction.

item:minecraft:white_dye.what: White Dye is a coloring ingredient.
item:minecraft:white_dye.does: Use it to color compatible wool, glass, banners, leather equipment, and other craftable or dyeable objects.

item:minecraft:white_glazed_terracotta.what: White Glazed Terracotta is a patterned ceramic building block.
item:minecraft:white_glazed_terracotta.does: Use its directional placement to create repeating floor and wall designs.

item:minecraft:white_harness.what: White Harness is equipment for riding a happy ghast.
item:minecraft:white_harness.does: Equip a suitable happy ghast to use it for aerial transport; different colors change the harness appearance.

item:minecraft:white_shulker_box.what: White Shulker Box is a portable storage container.
item:minecraft:white_shulker_box.does: Store items inside, break the box, and carry it with its contents preserved. You cannot put a shulker box inside another shulker box.

item:minecraft:white_stained_glass.what: White Stained Glass is a colored transparent building block.
item:minecraft:white_stained_glass.does: Use it for tinted windows, decorative enclosures, or to color a beacon beam passing through it.

item:minecraft:white_stained_glass_pane.what: White Stained Glass Pane is a thin colored glass block.
item:minecraft:white_stained_glass_pane.does: Use connected panes for tinted windows and dividers. It is not a full glass block.

item:minecraft:white_terracotta.what: White Terracotta is a colored hardened-clay building block.
item:minecraft:white_terracotta.does: Use it for construction and decorative color palettes, or smelt compatible colored terracotta into its glazed form.

item:minecraft:white_tulip.what: White Tulip is a decorative flower.
item:minecraft:white_tulip.does: Plant it on suitable ground for decoration or use it in compatible dye, composting, or crafting recipes.

item:minecraft:white_wool.what: White Wool is a soft fabric building block.
item:minecraft:white_wool.does: Use it for decoration, beds, and compatible crafting recipes. Wool also helps block certain sculk vibration paths.

item:minecraft:white_wool_slab.what: White Wool Slab is a half-height building block.
item:minecraft:white_wool_slab.does: Use it for steps, layered floors, and detailed builds. Two matching slabs can form a full-height block. Bottom slabs differ from top slabs for normal mob spawning.

item:minecraft:white_wool_stairs.what: White Wool Stairs is a stair-shaped building block.
item:minecraft:white_wool_stairs.does: Use it to change elevation without jumping or to make roofs, corners, and decorative shapes.

item:minecraft:wild_armor_trim_smithing_.what: Wild Armor Trim Smithing Template is a template used at a smithing table.
item:minecraft:wild_armor_trim_smithing_.does: Combine it with compatible equipment and the required material. Upgrade templates improve equipment; armor-trim templates add a decorative pattern.

item:minecraft:wildflowers.what: Wildflowers are a decorative spread of small flowers.
item:minecraft:wildflowers.does: Place them on suitable ground for natural-looking flower patches.

item:minecraft:wind_charge.what: A wind charge is a throwable item that produces a gust on impact.
item:minecraft:wind_charge.does: Use it for movement boosts and compatible redstone interactions, taking care with the resulting landing.

item:minecraft:witch_spawn_egg.what: Witch Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:witch_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:wither_rose.what: A wither rose is a dark flower that harms many entities touching it.
item:minecraft:wither_rose.does: Use it carefully for decoration, black-dye production, or suitable farm mechanisms.

item:minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull.what: Wither Skeleton Skull is a mob-head decoration.
item:minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull.does: Display it, wear compatible heads, or use it in a matching recipe or mechanism. Wither skeleton skulls are also used in summoning the Wither.

item:minecraft:wither_skeleton_spawn_egg.what: Wither Skeleton Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:wither_skeleton_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:wither_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:wolf_armor.what: Wolf armor is protection for a tamed wolf.
item:minecraft:wolf_armor.does: Equip it on your wolf and repair it with armadillo scutes to help protect your companion.

item:minecraft:wolf_spawn_egg.what: Wolf Spawn Egg is a spawn egg for creating its named mob.
item:minecraft:wolf_spawn_egg.does: Use it on a suitable surface in Creative or another mode where you have the egg. Different mobs may need suitable space or water.

item:minecraft:wooden_axe.what: Wooden Axe is a tool for chopping wood and other axe-suitable blocks.
item:minecraft:wooden_axe.does: Use it to harvest logs efficiently and strip suitable logs. It can also be used as a melee weapon.

item:minecraft:wooden_button.what: Wooden Button is a temporary redstone switch.
item:minecraft:wooden_button.does: Press it to send a short redstone signal. Wooden buttons can also be triggered by suitable projectiles, while material affects timing and interaction rules.

item:minecraft:wooden_door.what: Wooden Door is a two-block-high openable doorway.
item:minecraft:wooden_door.does: Use it to control entry into rooms. Redstone can control it; iron doors require redstone rather than hand opening.

item:minecraft:wooden_hoe.what: Wooden Hoe is a farming tool.
item:minecraft:wooden_hoe.does: Use it to prepare suitable soil as farmland and to harvest certain plant-based blocks more efficiently.

item:minecraft:wooden_pickaxe.what: Wooden Pickaxe is a mining tool for rock and ore blocks.
item:minecraft:wooden_pickaxe.does: Use it to mine compatible blocks faster and obtain their drops. Some ores require a stronger material tier; not every pickaxe can harvest everything.

item:minecraft:wooden_pressure_plate.what: Wooden Pressure Plate is a switch activated when suitable entities stand on it.
item:minecraft:wooden_pressure_plate.does: Use it to trigger redstone mechanisms. Wooden and stone plates detect different kinds of entities.

item:minecraft:wooden_shovel.what: Wooden Shovel is a digging tool for loose ground materials.
item:minecraft:wooden_shovel.does: Use it to dig dirt, sand, gravel, snow, and similar blocks faster, or make paths from suitable ground.

item:minecraft:wooden_spear.what: Wooden Spear is a reach-oriented melee weapon.
item:minecraft:wooden_spear.does: Use it to attack from farther away than ordinary close-contact weapons; its attack behavior differs from a sword.

item:minecraft:wooden_sword.what: Wooden Sword is a melee weapon.
item:minecraft:wooden_sword.does: Use it to attack targets at close range. Material and enchantments affect its damage and durability.

item:minecraft:writable_book.what: A book and quill is an item for writing pages.
item:minecraft:writable_book.does: Write your own notes or stories, then sign it when you want to turn it into a written book.
